代.zh: 因为年龄代沟，他和父亲很难沟通。
代.en: Because of the generation gap, he finds it hard to communicate with his father.

理论.en: What is the basis of your theory?

理论.zh: 他提出的理论在科学界引起了很多讨论。
理论.en: The theory he proposed sparked a lot of discussion in the scientific community.

理论.zh: 我不同意这个理论，因为它没有实际证据。
理论.en: I disagree with this theory because it lacks practical evidence.

理论.zh: 学习理论很重要，但实践更关键。
理论.en: Learning theory is important, but practice is more crucial.

网络.en: The network signal here is not very good.

网络.zh: 他通过网络找到了很多朋友。
网络.en: He found many friends through the internet.

网络.zh: 现在的网络非常发达，我们很容易获取信息。
网络.en: The internet is very developed now, so we can easily get information.

网络.zh: 虽然网络很方便，但也要注意安全。
网络.en: Although the internet is convenient, you also need to pay attention to safety.

式.en: What method do you use to study?
This new type of phone is very easy to use.

式.zh: 他的做事方式很奇怪，但很有效。
式.en: His way of doing things is strange, but very effective.

宣布.en: The company announced next Wednesday off.

宣布.zh: 校长宣布了比赛的结果。
宣布.en: The principal announced the results of the competition.

宣布.zh: 政府宣布将提高最低工资，很多人很高兴。
宣布.en: The government announced it will raise the minimum wage, and many people are happy.

宣布.zh: 我们还在等他们正式宣布。
宣布.en: We are still waiting for them to officially announce.

创造.zh: 我们要创造更好的未来。
创造.en: We need to create a better future.

创造.zh: 科学家创造了新的材料。
只有不断努力，才能创造奇迹。
创造.en: Only by continuous effort can we create miracles.

创造.zh: 这个公司创造了大量的就业机会。
创造.en: This company has created a large number of job opportunities.

调.en: Please turn the volume down a bit.
The air conditioner is broken; we need to get someone to fix it.

调.zh: 我们调一下时间，明天早点出发。
调.en: Let's adjust the time and leave earlier tomorrow.

队伍.zh: 大家在排队，队伍很整齐。
队伍.en: Everyone is queuing up, and the line is very orderly.

队伍.zh: 领导需要管理好整个队伍。
队伍.en: The leader needs to manage the entire team well.

队伍.zh: 这支队伍由年轻人组成，很有活力。
队伍.en: This team is made up of young people and is very energetic.

命.en: Life is very important; you should cherish it.

命.zh: 我不信命，只信自己努力。
命.en: I don't believe in fate; I only believe in my own efforts.

命.zh: 他奉命去完成这项任务。
命.en: He was ordered to complete this mission.

烧.en: This piece of paper got burned.

烧.zh: 森林大火烧了三天三夜。
烧.en: The forest fire burned for three days and three nights.

事故.zh: 这个事故造成了三人受伤。
由于操作不当，发生了严重事故。
事故.en: Due to improper operation, a serious accident occurred.

事故.zh: 事故发生后，他们立刻报警。
事故.en: After the accident happened, they immediately called the police.

数据.zh: 因为数据出了问题，所以我们要重新检查。
数据.en: Because there was a problem with the data, we need to recheck it.

数据.zh: 这些数据是从网上收集来的。
数据.en: This data was collected from the internet.

数据.zh: 他每天都要分析很多数据。
数据.en: He has to analyze a lot of data every day.

安.en: He installed a new air conditioner.
We installed a camera at home.

安.zh: 因为没安好，所以机器出问题了。
安.en: Because it wasn't installed properly, the machine broke down.

思想.en: We need to change old ways of thinking.

思想.zh: 这本书讲的是现代思想。
思想.en: This book talks about modern thought.

思想.zh: 虽然他的思想很先进，但没人理解。
思想.en: Although his ideas are advanced, nobody understands them.

破坏.zh: 他故意破坏了我们的计划。
因为有人破坏，所以比赛取消了。
破坏.en: Because someone sabotaged it, the match was canceled.

消失.en: This kind of bird is slowly disappearing.

消失.zh: 因为信号不好，他的声音消失了。
消失.en: Because the signal was bad, his voice disappeared.
The smile disappeared from her face.

稳定.zh: 我们需要一个稳定的网络。
稳定.en: We need a stable internet connection.

稳定.zh: 虽然收入不高，但很稳定。
稳定.en: Although the income is low, it's very stable.

巨大.zh: 因为任务巨大，所以我们得加班。
巨大.en: Because the task is huge, we have to work overtime.

巨大.zh: 这个决定带来了巨大的变化。

藏.en: What good stuff did you hide?
This book is hidden on the bookshelf.

藏.zh: 因为怕被看到，他把礼物藏在床底下。
藏.en: Because he was afraid of being seen, he hid the gift under the bed.
Don't hide anymore, come out quickly.

龙.en: This year is the Year of the Dragon.
He has a dragon tattoo on his back.

龙.zh: 虽然龙是传说动物，但很多人喜欢。
龙.en: Although dragons are legendary animals, many people like them.
This dragon drawing is really beautiful.

协议.zh: 协议的内容需要仔细看。
协议.en: The content of the agreement needs careful reading.

协议.zh: 因为双方不同意，协议没签成。
协议.en: Because both sides disagreed, the agreement wasn't signed.
He violated the terms of the agreement.

满足.en: I am very content with my current life.

满足.zh: 虽然工作很累，但是我对收入很满足。
满足.en: Although work is tiring, I am satisfied with the income.

满足.zh: 你只要好好学习，就能满足父母的要求。
满足.en: As long as you study hard, you can meet your parents' requirements.

满足.zh: 因为餐厅菜量很大，所以我们都吃得很满足。
满足.en: Because the restaurant portions are large, we all ate till we were satisfied.

满足.zh: 这个玩具不能满足孩子的需求。
满足.en: This toy cannot meet the child's needs.

配.zh: 这条裙子配白色鞋子好看。
配.en: This dress looks good with white shoes.

配.zh: 我觉得你配得上这份工作，别担心。
配.en: I think you deserve this job, don't worry.

配.zh: 虽然他很有钱，但是我觉得他配不上她。
配.en: Although he is rich, I think he is not worthy of her.

配.zh: 你需要配一副新眼镜了。
配.en: You need to get a new pair of glasses.

配.zh: 这个颜色和你的肤色很配。
配.en: This color matches your skin tone well.

土地.zh: 这块土地非常适合种蔬菜和水果。
土地.en: This piece of land is very suitable for growing vegetables and fruits.

土地.zh: 因为城市扩张，很多土地被用来盖房子了。
土地.en: Because of urban expansion, much land is used for building houses.

土地.zh: 保护土地资源是我们的责任。
土地.en: Protecting land resources is our responsibility.
This land used to be a forest.

威胁.zh: 他威胁我说如果不说实话就打我。
威胁.en: He threatened me that he would hit me if I didn't tell the truth.

威胁.zh: 虽然敌人很强大，但是他们的威胁并不可怕。
威胁.en: Although the enemy is strong, their threat is not scary.

威胁.zh: 这种疾病对老年人威胁很大。
威胁.en: This disease poses a great threat to the elderly.
Don't threaten me with breaking up.

老婆.zh: 他老婆每天都会打电话问他几点回家。
老婆.en: His wife calls him every day to ask what time he'll come home.

老婆.zh: 虽然我老婆很唠叨，但是她很关心我。
老婆.en: Although my wife is naggy, she cares about me a lot.

老婆.zh: 你老婆是不是又在生气？
他娶了一个漂亮又善良的老婆。
老婆.en: He married a beautiful and kind wife.

等待.en: I am waiting for your answer.

等待.zh: 在机场等待了三个小时，飞机终于起飞了。
等待.en: After waiting three hours at the airport, the plane finally took off.

等待.zh: 如果你愿意等待，结果可能会更好。
等待.en: If you are willing to wait, the result might be better.

等待.zh: 不要着急，耐心等待机会。
等待.en: Don't rush, patiently wait for the opportunity.
Waiting is a kind of torment.

挑战.zh: 他决定挑战自己，去爬那座最高的山。
挑战.en: He decided to challenge himself and climb the highest mountain.

挑战.zh: 虽然这是一个巨大的挑战，但是我相信我们能成功。
挑战.en: Although this is a huge challenge, I believe we can succeed.
Only by facing challenges can we make progress.

挑战.zh: 你敢不敢接受我的挑战？
挑战.en: Do you dare to accept my challenge?

占.zh: 这个座位已经有人占了。
吃饭占了我每月开销的一大部分。
占.en: Eating out accounts for a large part of my monthly expenses.

占.zh: 因为要占位置，所以我们提前半小时到了。
占.en: Because we needed to save seats, we arrived half an hour early.
He took advantage and acted innocent.

占.zh: 这个区域被军队占领了。
占.en: This area is occupied by the military.

小姐.zh: 这位小姐，请问您需要什么？
在餐厅里，小姐很热情地为我们介绍菜单。
小姐.en: In the restaurant, the waitress enthusiastically introduced the menu to us.

小姐.zh: 因为小姐服务态度好，所以我们给了她小费。
小姐.en: Because the waitress had good service attitude, we gave her a tip.

小姐.zh: 她是一位很有礼貌的小姐。
小姐.en: She is a very polite young lady.

小姐.zh: 那位小姐看起来有点眼熟。
小姐.en: That young lady looks a bit familiar.

秘密.en: This is a secret between us.

秘密.zh: 他偷偷告诉我一个秘密，关于他喜欢的人。
秘密.en: He secretly told me a secret about the person he likes.

秘密.zh: 虽然我想知道答案，但是那个秘密她不肯说。
秘密.en: Although I want to know the answer, she refuses to tell that secret.

秘密.zh: 每个人都有自己的小秘密。
秘密.en: Everyone has their own little secrets.

秘密.zh: 不要到处说别人的秘密。
秘密.en: Don't go around telling other people's secrets.

超级.zh: 这家店的蛋糕超级好吃。
超级.en: The cake at this shop is super delicious.

超级.zh: 他超级喜欢打篮球，每天都要打。
超级.en: He super loves playing basketball and plays every day.

超级.zh: 昨天那部电影超级无聊，我差点睡着。
超级.en: That movie yesterday was super boring; I almost fell asleep.

超级.zh: 她超级聪明，但是有时候太粗心了。
超级.en: She is super smart, but sometimes too careless.

超级.zh: 这个游戏超级难，我打了三天都没过关。
超级.en: This game is super hard; I've played for three days and still haven't passed.

猪.en: He eats as much as a pig.
There are ten pigs raised on the farm.

猪.zh: 你别懒成猪了，快起来运动。
猪.en: Don't be as lazy as a pig; get up and exercise.

猪.zh: 猪在泥里打滚是为了降温。
猪.en: Pigs roll in mud to cool down.

设备.zh: 工厂里的设备需要定期维护。
设备.en: The equipment in the factory needs regular maintenance.

设备.zh: 我们公司新买了一批医疗设备。
设备.en: Our company just bought a batch of medical equipment.

设备.zh: 如果设备坏了，请马上联系维修部。
设备.en: If the equipment breaks down, please contact the maintenance department immediately.

设备.zh: 虽然价格贵，但这款设备的质量确实好。
设备.en: Although the price is high, the quality of this equipment is indeed good.

意味着.zh: 下雨意味着不能去打球了。
意味着.en: Rain means we can't go play ball.

意味着.zh: 他迟到通常意味着路上堵车。
意味着.en: His being late usually means there is a traffic jam.

意味着.zh: 这个结果意味着我们的努力没有白费。
意味着.en: This result means our efforts were not in vain.

意味着.zh: 签了合同就意味着你要承担责任。
意味着.en: Signing the contract means you have to take responsibility.

保.en: I can't guarantee you on this matter.

保.zh: 他买了保险，所以不用担心。
保.en: He bought insurance, so there's no need to worry.

保.zh: 我们得想办法保住这份工作。
保.en: We have to find a way to keep this job.

保.zh: 虽然困难，但他保证能完成任务。
保.en: Although it's difficult, he guarantees he can complete the task.

团.zh: 他报名参加了一个旅行团。
团.en: He signed up for a tour group.

团.zh: 这个社团活动很有意思。
团.en: This club activity is very interesting.

团.zh: 公司组织了一个团建活动。
团.en: The company organized a team-building activity.

团.zh: 一团棉花掉在地上，你捡起来吧。
团.en: A clump of cotton fell on the floor; please pick it up.

制造.zh: 中国制造的产品卖到全世界。
制造.en: Products made in China are sold worldwide.

制造.zh: 他故意制造麻烦，让大家不开心。
制造.en: He deliberately created trouble to make everyone unhappy.

制造.zh: 这个公司专门制造高端汽车零件。
制造.en: This company specializes in manufacturing high-end car parts.

制造.zh: 谣言会制造恐慌，所以不要随便传。
制造.en: Rumors can create panic, so don't spread them casually.

紧.zh: 最近手头紧，没法出去玩。
紧.en: I'm short on money lately, so I can't go out to play.

紧.zh: 绳子要拉紧，不然会松掉。
紧.en: Pull the rope tight, or it will loosen.

抽.en: I need to pull out a tissue.

抽.zh: 别抽太多烟，对身体不好。
抽.en: Don't smoke too much; it's bad for your health.
The teacher called on me to answer a question.
He took time to go to the supermarket.
Let's draw lots to decide who goes first.

对手.en: The opponent in this match is very strong.

对手.zh: 遇到厉害的对手才能进步。
对手.en: Only by meeting strong opponents can you improve.

对手.zh: 虽然他是对手，但我很尊重他。
对手.en: Although he is an opponent, I respect him very much.

对手.zh: 在这件事上，我们没有真正的对手。
对手.en: In this matter, we have no real competitors.

想象.zh: 想象一下，如果明天放假你会做什么？
想象.en: Imagine, if tomorrow is a day off, what would you do?

想象.zh: 我很难想象他一个人住那么大的房子。
想象.en: I can hardly imagine him living alone in such a big house.

想象.zh: 他总喜欢想象自己是个超级英雄。
想象.en: He always likes to imagine himself as a superhero.

想象.zh: 现实和想象之间有很大的差距，所以别太天真了。
想象.en: There is a big gap between reality and imagination, so don't be too naive.

想象.zh: 你想象过十年后的自己是什么样子吗？
想象.en: Have you ever imagined what you will be like ten years from now?

当地.zh: 这家餐厅的菜很有当地特色。
当地.en: The dishes at this restaurant have a lot of local characteristics.

当地.zh: 我们最好问问当地人哪里好玩。
当地.en: We'd better ask the locals where to have fun.

当地.zh: 当地的天气变化很大，记得带件外套。
当地.en: The local weather changes a lot; remember to bring a jacket.

当地.zh: 他去旅行时总是喜欢和当地居民聊天，了解他们的生活。
当地.en: When he travels, he always likes to chat with local residents to learn about their lives.

当地.zh: 这个风俗是当地独有的，别的地方看不到。
当地.en: This custom is unique to the local area; you can't see it elsewhere.

需.zh: 这个工作需要耐心和细心。
需.en: This job requires patience and carefulness.
Does he need to make a reservation in advance?

需.zh: 我们需在三天内完成报告，所以得抓紧时间。
需.en: We need to finish the report in three days, so we have to hurry up.

需.zh: 做这道菜需半小时，不算太久。
需.en: Cooking this dish takes half an hour, not too long.

特殊.zh: 她因为特殊原因迟到了。
特殊.en: She was late for special reasons.

特殊.zh: 这家店有特殊的服务，比如免费送货上门。
特殊.en: This store has special services, like free home delivery.

特殊.zh: 没有什么特殊的，就是普通的一天。
特殊.en: Nothing special, just an ordinary day.

特殊.zh: 他对这个项目有特殊的感情，毕竟做了三年。
特殊.en: He has special feelings for this project, after all, he has been working on it for three years.

具体.en: I'm not clear about the specific time yet.

具体.zh: 具体问题要具体分析，不能一概而论。
具体.en: Specific problems need specific analysis; you can't generalize.

具体.zh: 请把具体的地址发给我，我导航过去。
具体.en: Please send me the specific address, and I'll navigate there.

具体.zh: 他要求我们写一份具体的计划书，包括预算和时间表。
具体.en: He asked us to write a specific plan, including budget and schedule.

合.en: This piece of clothing fits very well.
The two of us have compatible personalities.

合.zh: 这张桌子和那把椅子不太合适。
合.en: This table and that chair don't match well.

合.zh: 他唱歌时总合不上节拍，有点尴尬。
合.en: He always can't keep up with the beat when singing; it's a bit awkward.

合.zh: 大家合个影吧，记录这一刻。
合.en: Let's take a group photo to record this moment.

风格.zh: 这个作家的风格很独特。
风格.en: This writer's style is very unique.

风格.zh: 装修时我选了北欧风格，看起来清爽。
风格.en: I chose a Scandinavian style for decoration; it looks refreshing.

风格.zh: 每个人的穿衣风格都不一样，尊重就好。
风格.en: Everyone's dressing style is different; just respect it.

风格.zh: 她的教学风格很轻松，学生们都喜欢。
风格.en: Her teaching style is very relaxed; students all like it.

建筑.zh: 这个建筑有上百年的历史。
建筑.en: This building has a history of over a hundred years.

建筑.zh: 我喜欢现代建筑，简单大方。
建筑.en: I like modern architecture, simple and elegant.

建筑.zh: 城市的建筑越来越高了。
建筑.en: The buildings in the city are getting taller and taller.

建筑.zh: 这座建筑的设计很特别，吸引了很多游客。
建筑.en: The design of this building is very special, attracting many tourists.

建筑.zh: 古代建筑和现代建筑各有各的美，你觉得呢？
建筑.en: Ancient architecture and modern architecture each have their own beauty; what do you think?

角色.zh: 他在电影里演反派角色。
角色.en: He plays the villain role in the movie.

角色.zh: 每个队员都有自己的角色。
角色.en: Each team member has their own role.

角色.zh: 她的角色是负责沟通和协调。
角色.en: Her role is to be responsible for communication and coordination.

角色.zh: 在工作中，你扮演什么角色？是领导还是执行？
角色.en: At work, what role do you play? A leader or an executor?

角色.zh: 这个游戏里你可以选择不同的角色，体验不同的故事。
角色.en: In this game, you can choose different characters and experience different stories.

疯狂.en: He has been working too crazily lately.
Don't be so crazy; calm down a bit.

疯狂.zh: 球迷们疯狂地庆祝胜利。
疯狂.en: The fans celebrated the victory crazily.

疯狂.zh: 她疯狂地喜欢那个歌手，每场演唱会都去。
疯狂.en: She is crazy about that singer and goes to every concert.

彻底.en: I will thoroughly clean the room.

彻底.zh: 他彻底改变了生活方式，开始健康饮食。
彻底.en: He completely changed his lifestyle and started eating healthy.

彻底.zh: 这个问题必须彻底解决才能安心。
彻底.en: This problem must be thoroughly resolved before we can feel at ease.

彻底.zh: 昨天我把家里彻底收拾了一遍。
彻底.en: Yesterday I cleaned the house thoroughly.

彻底.zh: 虽然有点难，但我决定彻底放弃这个计划。
彻底.en: Although it's a bit difficult, I decided to completely abandon this plan.

表达.en: She knows how to express herself.

表达.zh: 我不知道怎么表达感谢，因为心里很激动。
表达.en: I don't know how to express my gratitude because I'm so excited.

表达.zh: 他用画画来表达内心的感受，效果很好。
表达.en: He uses painting to express his inner feelings, and it works very well.

表达.zh: 有时候一个微笑就能表达很多东西。
表达.en: Sometimes a smile alone can express a lot.

讲话.zh: 他讲话很有道理，大家都听。
讲话.en: He speaks very sensibly, everyone listens.

讲话.zh: 虽然我不喜欢他，但他讲话很幽默。
讲话.en: Even though I don't like him, he is very funny when he speaks.

讲话.zh: 开会的时候，别随便讲话。
讲话.en: Don't chat casually during the meeting.

之外.zh: 除此之外，我没什么要说的。
之外.en: Apart from that, I have nothing else to say.

之外.zh: 除了你之外，没人知道这事。
之外.en: No one knows about this except you.

之外.zh: 工作之外，我喜欢跑步和看书。
之外.en: Outside of work, I like running and reading.

之外.zh: 除了价格之外，这款手机其他都很好。
之外.en: Apart from the price, this phone is great in every other aspect.

之外.zh: 除了这些书之外，还有几本在包里。
之外.en: Besides these books, there are a few more in the bag.

紧急.zh: 情况很紧急，快叫救护车！
紧急.en: The situation is urgent, call an ambulance quickly!

紧急.zh: 这不是紧急的事，明天再说吧。
紧急.en: This isn't urgent, let's talk about it tomorrow.

紧急.zh: 紧急出口在右边，请走那边。
紧急.en: The emergency exit is on the right, please go that way.

紧急.zh: 因为天气紧急，航班全部取消了。
紧急.en: Because of the emergency weather, all flights have been canceled.

紧急.zh: 一旦有紧急情况，马上按这个按钮。
紧急.en: In case of an emergency, press this button immediately.

宣传.en: They are promoting the new product.

宣传.zh: 这个活动宣传得很到位。
宣传.en: This event has been very well publicized.

宣传.zh: 宣传单上写着打折信息。
宣传.en: The flyer has the discount information on it.

宣传.zh: 虽然宣传做得很好，但产品一般。
宣传.en: Although the promotion was done well, the product is just so-so.

宣传.zh: 他们通过社交媒体宣传环保理念。
宣传.en: They promote environmental concepts through social media.

撞.zh: 我走路时不小心撞了人。
撞.en: I accidentally bumped into someone while walking.

撞.zh: 他俩的想法撞在一起了。
撞.en: Their ideas clashed with each other.

撞.zh: 因为没看路，他撞上了玻璃门。
撞.en: Because he wasn't looking where he was going, he walked into the glass door.

撞.zh: 别跑太快，小心撞到小朋友。
撞.en: Don't run too fast, be careful not to bump into the kids.

优势.en: Our advantage is the low price.

优势.zh: 他在身高上有明显优势。
优势.en: He has a clear advantage in height.

优势.zh: 发挥你的优势，别担心缺点。
优势.en: Play to your strengths and don't worry about your weaknesses.

优势.zh: 虽然对手很强，但我们有团队优势。
优势.en: Although the opponent is strong, we have the advantage of teamwork.

优势.zh: 这种材料的优势在于轻便耐用。
优势.en: The advantage of this material is that it's lightweight and durable.

随时.en: Feel free to ask me anytime if you have questions.
You can come over to my place anytime.
Keep your phone on at all times.

随时.zh: 虽然现在没空，但你可以随时找我。
随时.en: Even though I'm busy now, you can reach out to me anytime.

随时.zh: 出门记得带伞，随时可能下雨。
随时.en: Remember to bring an umbrella when you go out; it could rain at any moment.

付出.en: His efforts were not in vain.

付出.zh: 虽然付出了很多，但结果值得。
付出.en: Although we paid a lot, the result was worth it.
Only by giving can you get something back.

付出.zh: 为了这个项目，我们付出了太多时间。
付出.en: We spent too much time on this project.

付出.zh: 你付出的一切我们都看在眼里。
付出.en: We see everything you have given.

时期.zh: 她正处于学习的重要时期。
时期.en: She is in an important period of study.

时期.zh: 虽然那个时期很苦，但我们都坚持下来了。
时期.en: Although that period was hard, we all persisted.
I was very happy during that period.

哎.zh: 哎，这事儿我真的没办法。
哎.en: Ah, I really can't do anything about this.

哎.zh: 哎，既然你来了，就一起吃饭吧。
哎.en: Hey, since you're here, let's eat together.

哎.zh: 哎，我都说了好几遍了，你还是不听。
哎.en: Sigh, I've said it several times, but you still don't listen.

好运.zh: 这次考试，祝你好运连连。
好运.en: May you have lots of good luck on this exam.

好运.zh: 虽然准备不充分，但希望有好运。
好运.en: Although I'm not fully prepared, I hope for good luck.

好运.zh: 好运不会一直跟着你，要努力。
好运.en: Good luck won't always be with you; you have to work hard.

治.zh: 医生正在想办法治他的病。
治.en: The doctor is trying to find a way to treat his illness.

治.zh: 如果早点治，就不会这么严重了。
治.en: If we had treated it earlier, it wouldn't have gotten this serious.

治.zh: 感冒通常需要一周才能治好。
治.en: A cold usually takes a week to cure.
Treating the symptoms but not the root cause.

措施.zh: 政府采取了严格的防疫措施。
措施.en: The government adopted strict epidemic prevention measures.

措施.zh: 虽然措施很严格，但很有效。
措施.en: Although the measures are strict, they are effective.

措施.zh: 这些安全措施不能忽视。
措施.en: These safety measures cannot be ignored.

措施.zh: 措施到位了，问题就解决了。
措施.en: Once the measures are in place, the problem is solved.

导演.zh: 导演在片场指挥所有演员。
导演.en: The director directs all the actors on set.

导演.zh: 因为导演要求高，所以电影拍得很好。
导演.en: Because the director has high standards, the movie turned out great.

导演.zh: 他梦想成为一名电影导演。
导演.en: He dreams of becoming a film director.
The director said we could start filming.

利益.zh: 我们要维护自己的利益。
利益.en: We must protect our own interests.

利益.zh: 不能为了个人利益损害集体。
利益.en: You cannot harm the collective for personal benefit.

利益.zh: 虽然利益很大，但风险也不小。
利益.en: Although the benefits are great, the risks are also considerable.

利益.zh: 双方都考虑自己的利益。
利益.en: Both sides consider their own interests.
Conflicts of interest are hard to resolve.

生物.zh: 海洋里有很多奇特的生物。
生物.en: There are many strange creatures in the ocean.

生物.zh: 因为环境污染，很多生物濒临灭绝。
生物.en: Because of environmental pollution, many living things are on the verge of extinction.
Humans are also a type of living thing.

生物.zh: 这个实验室研究微生物。

评价.zh: 大家对这部电影评价很高。
评价.en: Everyone speaks highly of this movie.

评价.zh: 老师对学生的表现做出了公正评价。
评价.en: The teacher gave a fair evaluation of the students' performance.

评价.zh: 虽然评价有好有坏，但整体不错。
评价.en: Although the reviews are mixed, overall it's good.

评价.zh: 你不能只听一个人的评价。
评价.en: You can't just listen to one person's opinion.

迷.zh: 我是个电影迷，每周都看新片。
迷.en: I am a movie fan and watch new films every week.

迷.zh: 他迷上了那款游戏，连饭都不想吃。
迷.en: He became obsessed with that game and doesn't even want to eat.

迷.zh: 别迷路，跟着地图走就行。
迷.en: Don't get lost, just follow the map.

迷.zh: 她迷上了健身，每天都要去健身房。
迷.en: She's hooked on fitness and goes to the gym every day.

迷.zh: 如果迷路了，你可以用手机导航。
迷.en: If you get lost, you can use your phone's navigation.

形象.en: He pays a lot of attention to his image.

形象.zh: 这个品牌需要提升形象。
形象.en: This brand needs to improve its image.

形象.zh: 你今天的形象很适合面试。
形象.en: Your look today is very suitable for the interview.

形象.zh: 他作为公众人物，形象非常重要。
形象.en: As a public figure, his image is very important.

形象.zh: 为了维护公司形象，他们加强了管理。
形象.en: To maintain the company's image, they strengthened management.

方案.zh: 这个方案我们讨论一下。
我们需要一个更详细的方案。
方案.en: We need a more detailed plan.

方案.zh: 如果这个方案不行，我们还有备用方案。
方案.en: If this plan doesn't work, we have a backup plan.

方案.zh: 他们提出了几种不同的方案来解决问题。
方案.en: They proposed several different plans to solve the problem.

欠.en: He owes the bank a lot of money.

欠.zh: 别欠债太多，不然以后麻烦。
欠.en: Don't owe too much debt, or you'll have trouble later.

主题.zh: 这个派对的主题是海洋。
主题.en: The party's theme is the ocean.

主题.zh: 我们还没确定会议的主题。
主题.en: We haven't determined the meeting's theme yet.

主题.zh: 这篇文章的主题很深刻。
主题.en: The theme of this article is very profound.

主题.zh: 你要围绕主题写，不要跑题。
主题.en: You need to write around the theme, don't stray off topic.

商业.en: This is a business district, very lively.

商业.zh: 他从事商业活动很多年了。
商业.en: He has been engaged in business activities for many years.

商业.zh: 商业谈判需要技巧和耐心。
商业.en: Business negotiations require skill and patience.

商业.zh: 这里的商业环境越来越好。
商业.en: The business environment here is getting better and better.

商业.zh: 他开了一家商业咨询公司。
商业.en: He opened a business consulting company.

到达.en: The train is about to arrive at Beijing Station.

到达.zh: 她到达机场后给我打了电话。
到达.en: She called me after arriving at the airport.

到达.zh: 由于天气原因，航班到达时间推迟了。
到达.en: Due to weather, the flight arrival time was delayed.

到达.zh: 你到达目的地后记得报平安。
到达.en: Remember to let us know you're safe after arriving at your destination.

主任.en: The director is not in the office today.

主任.zh: 我们主任很严厉，但也很公道。
主任.en: Our director is strict but also fair.

主任.zh: 主任让我把这个文件交给你。
主任.en: The director asked me to give you this document.
The new director is very experienced.

主任.zh: 主任在开会，你等一会儿再来吧。
主任.en: The director is in a meeting, please come back later.

功能.zh: 新软件增加了搜索功能。
功能.en: The new software added a search function.

功能.zh: 每个按钮都有不同的功能。
功能.en: Each button has a different function.

功能.zh: 这款手表不仅有计时功能，还能测心率。
功能.en: This watch not only has a timekeeping function but can also measure heart rate.

避免.zh: 出门前涂防晒可以避免晒伤。
避免.en: Apply sunscreen before going out to avoid sunburn.

避免.zh: 我们尽量避免在高峰期出行。
避免.en: We try to avoid traveling during peak hours.

避免.zh: 为了避免误会，你最好说清楚。
避免.en: To avoid misunderstanding, you'd better explain clearly.

避免.zh: 他选择搬家，避免每天坐两小时地铁。
避免.en: He chose to move to avoid taking two hours of subway every day.

生产.zh: 这家工厂主要生产汽车零件。
生产.en: This factory mainly produces car parts.

生产.zh: 我们公司去年生产了十万台手机。
生产.en: Our company produced 100,000 phones last year.

生产.zh: 因为订单太多，生产速度跟不上了。
生产.en: Because there are too many orders, the production speed can't keep up.

生产.zh: 生产这种产品需要很多原材料。
生产.en: Producing this product requires a lot of raw materials.

生产.zh: 虽然设备很新，但是生产效率还是不高。
生产.en: Although the equipment is very new, the production efficiency is still not high.

试验.en: They are doing a chemical experiment.

试验.zh: 这个新药经过了很多次临床试验。
试验.en: This new drug has undergone many clinical trials.

试验.zh: 为了确保安全，我们先做一个小试验。
试验.en: To ensure safety, we'll first do a small test.

试验.zh: 试验失败了，不过我们找到了原因。
试验.en: The experiment failed, but we found the reason.

试验.zh: 如果这次试验成功，我们就可以开始生产了。
试验.en: If this experiment succeeds, we can start production.

成长.zh: 这个城市在这十年里成长了很多。
成长.en: This city has grown a lot in the past ten years.

成长.zh: 父母的陪伴对孩子的成长很重要。
成长.en: Parents' companionship is very important for a child's growth.

成长.zh: 虽然过程很辛苦，但是我的成长很明显。
成长.en: Although the process was hard, my growth is very obvious.

成长.zh: 她在公司里一步步成长，现在已经是经理了。
成长.en: She grew step by step in the company, and now she is already a manager.

闹.en: Little kids throw a tantrum when they don't want to eat.
Those two had a conflict again.
Stop messing around, let's talk properly.

闹.zh: 昨天夜里楼下闹得很厉害，我没睡好。
闹.en: Last night there was a big noise downstairs, and I didn't sleep well.

闹.zh: 虽然只是小事，但他非闹到领导那里去。
闹.en: Although it was just a small matter, he insisted on making a fuss all the way to the leader.

彼此.en: We understand each other very well.

彼此.zh: 大家彼此帮助，事情就好办多了。
彼此.en: If everyone helps each other, things will be much easier.

彼此.zh: 他们彼此之间很少说话。
彼此.en: They rarely speak to each other.

彼此.zh: 既然选择了在一起，就要彼此信任。
彼此.en: Since we chose to be together, we must trust each other.

彼此.zh: 我觉得一段好的关系需要彼此尊重和包容。
彼此.en: I think a good relationship requires mutual respect and tolerance.

推荐.en: Can you recommend a good book?

推荐.zh: 朋友推荐我来这家餐厅吃饭。
推荐.en: A friend recommended I eat at this restaurant.

推荐.zh: 这部电影很好看，我推荐大家都去看。
推荐.en: This movie is very good, I recommend everyone to go see it.

推荐.zh: 如果你喜欢辣味的，我推荐你试试这个菜。
推荐.en: If you like spicy flavors, I recommend you try this dish.

推荐.zh: 老板推荐他负责这个项目，因为他的经验很丰富。
推荐.en: The boss recommended him to be in charge of this project because he has rich experience.

指导.zh: 老师正在指导学生写作文。
指导.en: The teacher is guiding the students to write essays.

指导.zh: 没有你的指导，我肯定做不好。
指导.en: Without your guidance, I definitely couldn't do it well.

指导.zh: 在教练的指导下，他的技术进步很快。
指导.en: Under the coach's guidance, his skills improved rapidly.

指导.zh: 虽然她是新手，但有人指导就不怕。
指导.en: Although she is a beginner, there's no fear if someone guides her.

指导.zh: 这个项目需要有经验的专家来指导我们。
指导.en: This project requires experienced experts to guide us.

品牌.zh: 这个品牌的衣服质量很好。
品牌.en: This brand's clothes are of good quality.

品牌.zh: 很多年轻人喜欢买知名品牌的手机。
品牌.en: Many young people like to buy well-known brand phones.

品牌.zh: 我们公司正在努力打造自己的品牌。
品牌.en: Our company is working hard to build our own brand.

品牌.zh: 虽然价格贵一些，但是大品牌让人放心。
品牌.en: Although the price is a bit higher, big brands give people peace of mind.

品牌.zh: 一个好的品牌需要长期的口碑积累。
品牌.en: A good brand requires long-term accumulation of reputation.

盖.en: Cover the pot with the lid.
This building was only finished last year.

盖.zh: 睡觉前记得把被子盖好。
盖.en: Remember to cover yourself with the blanket before sleeping.

盖.zh: 他们在村子旁边盖了一所新学校。
盖.en: They built a new school next to the village.

盖.zh: 因为天气冷，她出门时盖了一条围巾。
盖.en: Because the weather was cold, she covered herself with a scarf when going out.

原则.en: One must have principles in life.
He sticks to principles when handling matters.

原则.zh: 我原则上是同意的，但是细节还要商量。
原则.en: In principle I agree, but the details still need to be discussed.

原则.zh: 虽然利益很大，但我们不能违反原则。
原则.en: Although the benefits are huge, we cannot violate our principles.

原则.zh: 她的原则是从来不在背后说别人的坏话。
原则.en: Her principle is to never speak ill of others behind their backs.

联合.zh: 虽然他们两家公司联合了，但效果一般。
联合.en: Although the two companies united, the result was so-so.

联合.zh: 联合国的决议大家都得遵守。
联合.en: UN resolutions must be followed by everyone.

联合.zh: 如果大家能联合行动，事情会容易很多。
联合.en: If everyone can act jointly, things will be much easier.

联合.zh: 他们联合创办了一所学校。

炒.zh: 他最近在炒股票，赚了不少钱。
炒.en: He's been speculating in stocks recently and made quite a bit of money.

炒.zh: 因为菜炒得太咸了，所以我没吃几口。
炒.en: Because the dish was stir-fried too salty, I only ate a few bites.

炒.zh: 这家网红店是炒出来的，味道一般。
炒.en: This internet-famous store is hyped up; the taste is just average.

录.zh: 我忘了录会议内容，现在很后悔。
录.en: I forgot to record the meeting content, now I regret it.

录.zh: 虽然我没录全，但关键部分都在。
录.en: Although I didn't record everything, the key parts are there.

录.zh: 她的歌声被录进了专辑。
录.en: Her singing was recorded into the album.

录.zh: 你用手机录一下这段视频，然后发给我。
录.en: Use your phone to record this video and then send it to me.

微笑.zh: 不管遇到什么困难，他都保持微笑。
微笑.en: No matter what difficulties he encounters, he keeps smiling.

微笑.zh: 虽然她心里很难过，但脸上依然带着微笑。
微笑.en: Although she felt very sad inside, she still wore a smile on her face.

微笑.zh: 微笑能拉近人与人之间的距离。
服务员对我微笑了一下，我就没那么紧张了。
微笑.en: The waiter gave me a smile, and I became less nervous.

组合.zh: 他们三人的组合配合得非常好。
组合.en: The combination of the three of them coordinated very well.

组合.zh: 因为颜色组合太奇怪，所以我不喜欢这件衣服。
组合.en: Because the color combination is too weird, I don't like this dress.

组合.zh: 我们需要重新组合一下队伍。
组合.en: We need to reorganize the team.

组合.zh: 这个家具是模块化组合的，可以随意拆装。
组合.en: This furniture is modularly combined and can be disassembled and assembled freely.

观点.en: I don't agree with your viewpoint.

观点.zh: 在讨论中，每个人都可以表达自己的观点。
观点.en: In a discussion, everyone can express their own viewpoint.

观点.zh: 虽然我们的观点不同，但可以互相尊重。
观点.en: Although our viewpoints differ, we can respect each other.

观点.zh: 他从不同角度分析问题，最后得出了新的观点。
观点.en: He analyzed the problem from different angles and finally reached a new viewpoint.

惊喜.en: This is really a pleasant surprise!

惊喜.zh: 没想到你会来，太惊喜了。
惊喜.en: I didn't expect you would come, what a pleasant surprise.

惊喜.zh: 因为她准备了惊喜派对，所以大家都开心得不得了。
惊喜.en: Because she prepared a surprise party, everyone was extremely happy.

惊喜.zh: 生日那天我收到了很多惊喜。
惊喜.en: On my birthday I received many surprises.

惊喜.zh: 这份礼物给了我很大的惊喜，我很喜欢。
惊喜.en: This gift gave me a great pleasant surprise; I like it very much.

强烈.zh: 他有强烈的愿望去国外留学。
强烈.en: He has a strong desire to study abroad.

强烈.zh: 虽然天气不好，但他强烈要求去爬山。
强烈.en: Although the weather was bad, he strongly demanded to go hiking.

强烈.zh: 观众的反应非常强烈，掌声持续了五分钟。
强烈.en: The audience's reaction was very strong; applause lasted five minutes.

争取.zh: 他努力争取这次升职的机会。
争取.en: He worked hard to strive for this promotion opportunity.

酒吧.en: The music in this bar is very nice.

酒吧.zh: 他在酒吧认识了一位朋友。
酒吧.en: He met a friend at the bar.

酒吧.zh: 因为酒吧太吵，我们换了家安静的。
酒吧.en: Because the bar was too noisy, we switched to a quieter one.

酒吧.zh: 周末晚上酒吧门口排了很长的队。
酒吧.en: On weekend nights, there's a long line outside the bar.

胃.en: My stomach feels a bit uncomfortable.

胃.zh: 你胃疼的话，最好喝点热水。
胃.en: If you have a stomachache, you'd better drink some hot water.

胃.zh: 他因为胃不好，所以很少吃辣的。
胃.en: He rarely eats spicy food because his stomach is weak.

胃.zh: 胃是消化食物的主要器官。
胃.en: The stomach is the main organ for digesting food.

胃.zh: 吃完饭别马上运动，对胃不好。
胃.en: Don't exercise right after eating, it's bad for the stomach.

成就.zh: 取得这样的成就很不容易。
成就.en: Achieving such an accomplishment is not easy.

成就.zh: 虽然很辛苦，但看到成果就觉得很有成就感。
成就.en: Although it's hard, seeing results gives a sense of achievement.

成就.zh: 她通过努力获得了事业上的成就。
成就.en: She achieved career success through hard work.

成就.zh: 这个项目是我们团队共同成就的结果。
成就.en: This project is the result of our team's collective achievement.

激烈.zh: 他们激烈地争论了一个小时。
激烈.en: They argued fiercely for an hour.

激烈.zh: 因为竞争太激烈，他决定放弃。
激烈.en: Because the competition was too fierce, he decided to give up.

激烈.zh: 这场球赛打得很激烈，观众都看呆了。
激烈.en: This ball game was so intense that the audience was mesmerized.

激烈.zh: 面对激烈的市场竞争，我们得想办法改善。
激烈.en: Facing fierce market competition, we need to find ways to improve.

想念.zh: 出国以后，我特别想念家乡的美食。
想念.en: After going abroad, I especially miss the food from my hometown.

想念.zh: 虽然分开才几天，但我已经开始想念他了。
想念.en: Although we've only been apart a few days, I already miss him.

想念.zh: 每次看到这张照片，我都会想念过去的日子。
想念.en: Every time I see this photo, I miss the old days.

想念.zh: 你不在的时候，我们都很想念你。
想念.en: When you were not here, we all missed you.

之内.zh: 这个价格之内，你随便选。
之内.en: Within this price range, you can choose anything.

之内.zh: 我们必须在规定时间之内提交报告。
之内.en: We must submit the report within the specified time.

之内.zh: 他承诺在两个月之内把欠款还清。
之内.en: He promised to pay off the debt within two months.

预测.zh: 天气预报预测明天会下雨。
预测.en: The weather forecast predicts rain tomorrow.

预测.zh: 专家预测经济会慢慢回暖。
预测.en: Experts predict the economy will slowly recover.

预测.zh: 虽然很难预测结果，但我们还是想试试。
预测.en: Although it's hard to predict the outcome, we still want to try.

预测.zh: 没有人能准确预测未来的市场走向。
预测.en: No one can accurately predict the future market trend.

预测.zh: 根据数据，我们预测下个季度销量会增长。
预测.en: Based on the data, we predict sales will increase next quarter.

固定.en: He doesn't have a fixed job.

固定.zh: 我们每个月都有固定的支出。
固定.en: We have fixed expenses every month.

固定.zh: 这个支架需要固定好，不然会倒。
固定.en: This bracket needs to be fixed firmly, otherwise it will fall.

固定.zh: 因为收入不固定，他生活压力很大。
固定.en: Because his income is not stable, he has a lot of life pressure.

固定.zh: 你可以用胶带把线固定在墙上。
固定.en: You can use tape to fix the wire on the wall.

勇气.zh: 我佩服你敢于承认错误的勇气。
勇气.en: I admire your courage to admit mistakes.

勇气.zh: 面对困难的时候，我们需要勇气。
勇气.en: When facing difficulties, we need courage.
She didn't have the courage to tell the truth.

勇气.zh: 虽然害怕，但他还是鼓起勇气上台演讲。
勇气.en: Although afraid, he still gathered the courage to go on stage and give a speech.

注册.zh: 注册会员可以享受优惠。
我们公司刚注册了一个新商标。
注册.en: Our company just registered a new trademark.

注册.zh: 在网上注册课程很方便，不用排队。
注册.en: Registering for courses online is very convenient, no need to queue.

厅.en: The sofa in the living room is very comfortable.

厅.zh: 我们约在餐厅门口见面。
厅.en: We agreed to meet at the restaurant entrance.

厅.zh: 请到大厅等候，有人会来接待你。
厅.en: Please wait in the hall, someone will come to receive you.

厅.zh: 这个电影院有好几个放映厅。
厅.en: This cinema has several screening halls.

厅.zh: 他喜欢在客厅看电视，不喜欢在卧室看。
厅.en: He likes watching TV in the living room, not in the bedroom.

果然.zh: 你说得对，今天果然下雨了。
果然.en: You were right, it indeed rained today.

果然.zh: 他果然没来，我就知道他在骗我。
果然.en: He indeed didn't come; I knew he was lying to me.

果然.zh: 试试这个新菜，果然很好吃。
果然.en: Try this new dish, it's really delicious.

果然.zh: 我以为他会迟到，结果他果然迟到了。
果然.en: I thought he would be late, and sure enough, he was late.

果然.zh: 你猜对了，老板果然生气了。
果然.en: You guessed right; the boss indeed got angry.

位于.en: My school is located in the city center.

位于.zh: 这家餐厅位于街角，很容易找到。
位于.en: This restaurant is located on the corner of the street and is easy to find.

位于.zh: 我们公司位于上海郊区，环境很好。
位于.en: Our company is located in the suburbs of Shanghai, with a nice environment.

位于.zh: 新图书馆位于公园旁边，走路五分钟就到。
位于.en: The new library is located next to the park, just a five-minute walk away.

位于.zh: 那个博物馆位于山顶，但风景特别美。
位于.en: That museum is located on the mountaintop, but the view is especially beautiful.

静.zh: 晚上这里很静，适合散步。
静.en: It's very quiet here at night, suitable for a walk.
Be quiet for a moment; let me finish talking first.

静.zh: 教室里突然静了下来，大家都不说话了。
静.en: The classroom suddenly became quiet, and everyone stopped talking.

静.zh: 虽然外面很吵，但我的心里很静。
静.en: Although it's noisy outside, my heart is very calm.

摇.en: The wind is too strong; the trees are shaking nonstop.
He shook his head, indicating disagreement.
The little dog came running over wagging its tail.

摇.zh: 船摇得太厉害，我有点想吐。
摇.en: The boat is rocking so violently that I feel like vomiting.

摇.zh: 她轻轻摇了摇手里的杯子。
摇.en: She gently shook the cup in her hand.

需求.en: There is a huge demand for this product.

需求.zh: 我们需要先了解客户的需求。
需求.en: We need to understand the customer's needs first.

需求.zh: 随着人口增长，住房需求越来越高。
需求.en: As the population grows, the demand for housing is increasing.

需求.zh: 公司根据市场需求调整了计划。
需求.en: The company adjusted its plan based on market demand.

需求.zh: 如果你有任何需求，随时告诉我。
需求.en: If you have any needs, let me know anytime.

展现.zh: 她在这场比赛中展现了实力。
展现.en: She showed her strength in this competition.

展现.zh: 这幅画展现了画家对自然的热爱。
展现.en: This painting shows the artist's love for nature.

展现.zh: 他在面试中展现了自己的能力。
展现.en: He demonstrated his abilities during the interview.

展现.zh: 新的设计展现了现代与传统的结合。
展现.en: The new design shows a combination of modernity and tradition.

展现.zh: 这部电影展现了普通人生活中的温暖。
展现.en: This movie shows the warmth in ordinary people's lives.

培养.zh: 父母要培养孩子的独立性。
培养.en: Parents should cultivate their children's independence.

培养.zh: 学校注重培养学生的创造力。
培养.en: Schools focus on cultivating students' creativity.

培养.zh: 这个项目培养了很多年轻人才。
培养.en: This program has cultivated many young talents.

培养.zh: 通过阅读可以培养自己的思考能力。
培养.en: Through reading, you can cultivate your own thinking ability.

培养.zh: 公司花了很多钱培养新员工。
培养.en: The company spent a lot of money training new employees.

平静.en: The sea surface is very calm.
Her tone of voice was very calm.

平静.zh: 虽然发生了意外，他依然保持平静。
平静.en: Despite the accident, he remained calm.

平静.zh: 风暴过后，一切都恢复平静了。
平静.en: After the storm, everything returned to calm.

平静.zh: 我们需要找一个平静的地方好好谈谈。
平静.en: We need to find a quiet place to talk properly.

谈话.zh: 我们进行了一次长谈话。

谈话.en: The teacher wants to talk with the parents.

谈话.zh: 在谈话中，他提到了很多重要的事情。
谈话.en: During the conversation, he mentioned many important things.

谈话.zh: 我跟他谈话之后，心情好多了。
谈话.en: After talking with him, I felt much better.

平安.zh: 他给家里打电话报平安。
平安.en: He called home to report that he was safe.

平安.zh: 虽然路上有点堵，但我们平安到达了。
平安.en: Although there was some traffic, we arrived safely.

平安.zh: 过年的时候，人们互相祝福平安。
平安.en: During the New Year, people wish each other safety.

传说.zh: 很多人都相信这个古老的传说。
传说.en: Many people believe this ancient legend.

传说.zh: 虽然只是传说，但我还是很好奇。
传说.en: Although it's just a legend, I'm still curious.

传说.zh: 传说中那个地方有宝藏。
传说.en: Legend says there is treasure in that place.
Have you heard the legend of Chang'e?

环节.zh: 比赛的最后一个环节是问答。
环节.en: The last part of the competition is the Q&A.
No mistakes can be made in any step.

环节.zh: 如果你想成功，每个环节都要做好。
环节.en: If you want to succeed, you need to do well in every step.

环节.zh: 这个生产过程有五个环节。
环节.en: This production process has five stages.

转变.zh: 这几年她的想法有了很大转变。
转变.en: Her thinking has undergone a big change in the past few years.

转变.zh: 因为经历了很多事，他的性格发生了转变。
转变.en: Because he experienced a lot, his personality underwent a transformation.

至今.en: This matter still has no result so far.
I still remember that incident to this day.

至今.zh: 虽然已经过了十年，我至今仍记得他。
至今.en: Although ten years have passed, I still remember him.

至今.zh: 这种古老的传统至今仍在流传。
至今.en: This ancient tradition is still passed down to this day.

无数.zh: 他为了这个目标付出了无数努力。
无数.en: He put in countless efforts for this goal.
Countless people are busy making a living.

无数.zh: 虽然遇到了无数困难，但我没有放弃。
无数.en: Although I encountered countless difficulties, I didn't give up.

无数.zh: 夜空中闪烁着无数颗星星。
无数.en: Countless stars are twinkling in the night sky.

后果.zh: 这样的后果你承担得起吗？
如果你继续这样，后果会很糟糕。
后果.en: If you continue like this, the consequences will be bad.

后果.zh: 这件事的后果由你负责。
后果.en: You are responsible for the consequences of this matter.
You have to bear all the consequences.

打破.zh: 她成功打破了世界纪录。
打破.en: She successfully broke the world record.

打破.zh: 如果不小心，很容易打破玻璃。
打破.en: If you're not careful, it's easy to break the glass.

打破.zh: 我们需要打破陈旧的传统观念。
打破.en: We need to break outdated traditional ideas.

违反.zh: 这样做违反了公司的规定。
违反.en: Doing this violates the company's regulations.
You must not violate traffic rules.

违反.zh: 如果你违反合同，就要赔偿损失。
违反.en: If you break the contract, you will have to compensate for losses.

全力.zh: 他全力投入到这个工作中。
全力.en: He devoted full effort to this work.

全力.zh: 虽然很累，但我还是全力完成了任务。
全力.en: Although very tired, I still completed the task with full effort.

石头.zh: 他把那块大石头扔进了河里。
石头.en: He threw that big stone into the river.
Watch out for the stones under your feet.

石头.zh: 如果路上有石头，很容易绊倒。
石头.en: If there are stones on the road, it's easy to trip.

主持.zh: 虽然他很忙，但还是主持了这次活动。
主持.en: Although he was very busy, he still hosted this event.

主持.zh: 她主持的节目很受欢迎。
主持.en: The show she hosts is very popular.

主持.zh: 我朋友主持了一个关于环保的讲座。
主持.en: My friend hosted a lecture about environmental protection.

关闭.zh: 因为疫情，那家商店被迫关闭了。
关闭.en: Because of the epidemic, that store was forced to close.

关闭.zh: 我们要关闭所有不用的电源。
关闭.en: We need to turn off all unused power sources.

关闭.zh: 虽然天气很热，但他还是关闭了空调。
关闭.en: Although it was very hot, he still turned off the air conditioner.

软.zh: 我喜欢吃软一点的米饭。
软.en: I like to eat softer rice.

软.zh: 这种面包吃起来又软又香。
软.en: This kind of bread tastes soft and fragrant.

软.zh: 如果你觉得床太软，可以换一个硬点的。
软.en: If you think the bed is too soft, you can switch to a harder one.

访问.zh: 我昨天访问了那家公司。
他访问了多个国家，学习当地文化。
访问.en: He visited many countries to learn local cultures.

访问.zh: 这次访问让我学到了很多东西。
访问.en: This visit taught me a lot.

访问.zh: 虽然时间很短，但他的访问很成功。
访问.en: Although the time was short, his visit was very successful.

签名.en: He gave autographs to fans as souvenirs.

签名.zh: 我收到了偶像的签名照片。
签名.en: I received my idol's signed photo.

签名.zh: 如果你要签名，请排队等候。
签名.en: If you want an autograph, please queue and wait.

先进.zh: 我们公司引进了先进的生产设备。
先进.en: Our company introduced advanced production equipment.

先进.zh: 这个国家拥有先进的医疗系统。
先进.en: This country has an advanced medical system.

先进.zh: 虽然价格高，但它的性能很先进。
先进.en: Although the price is high, its performance is very advanced.

摄影.zh: 他周末去山里摄影，拍了很多风景。
摄影.en: He went to the mountains for photography on the weekend and took many landscapes.

摄影.zh: 这个摄影展展出了很多优秀的作品。
摄影.en: This photography exhibition displays many excellent works.

摄影.zh: 因为天气不好，所以摄影计划取消了。
摄影.en: Because the weather was bad, the photography plan was cancelled.

交换.zh: 留学生和本地学生交换了联系方式。
交换.en: International students and local students exchanged contact information.
I want to exchange seats with you.

交换.zh: 通过语言交换，我的口语进步很快。
交换.en: Through language exchange, my speaking improved quickly.

交换.zh: 如果你愿意，我们可以交换意见。
交换.en: If you are willing, we can exchange opinions.

描述.zh: 他很难描述当时的心情。
描述.en: It was hard for him to describe his feelings at that time.

描述.zh: 我可以用几句话来描述那个场景。
描述.en: I can describe that scene in a few sentences.

描述.zh: 虽然事情很复杂，但她描述得很清楚。
描述.en: Although the matter was very complicated, she described it very clearly.

今日.zh: 今日的会议改到了明天。
今日.en: Today's meeting has been moved to tomorrow.

今日.zh: 今日我和朋友一起吃了午饭。
今日.en: Today I had lunch with a friend.

今日.zh: 因为今日是周末，所以不用上班。
今日.en: Because today is the weekend, so no need to work.

挡.zh: 太阳太刺眼了，你帮我挡一下。
挡.en: The sun is too glaring, help me block it for a moment.
He used an umbrella to block the rain a bit.

挡.zh: 虽然想帮忙，但我也挡不住他的脾气。
挡.en: Although I wanted to help, I couldn't stop his temper.

挡.zh: 车停在那里把路全挡住了。
挡.en: The car parked there completely blocked the road.

届.zh: 他参加了上一届的选举。
届.en: He participated in the last election.

届.zh: 本届会议将在下周一举行。
届.en: This session will be held next Monday.

届.zh: 虽然上一届没成功，但这一届他很有信心。
届.en: Although last term wasn't successful, he is confident this term.

届.zh: 每年一届的音乐节很受欢迎。
届.en: The annual music festival is very popular.

认.zh: 因为没看清，所以认错了路。
认.en: Because I didn't see clearly, I recognized the wrong road.
He admitted this was his fault.

亿.en: His company's market value exceeds one billion.

亿.zh: 虽然只差一亿，但预算还是不够。
亿.en: Although only 100 million short, the budget is still insufficient.
He spent 200 million to buy that building.

在场.en: Were you also present at that time?

在场.zh: 他不在场，所以不知道发生了什么。
在场.en: He wasn't present, so he doesn't know what happened.

在场.zh: 所有在场的人都惊呆了。
在场.en: All the people present were stunned.

在场.zh: 虽然我在场，但我没看见是谁做的。
在场.en: Although I was present, I didn't see who did it.
Please make sure all witnesses are present.

敏感.zh: 这个话题很敏感，最好别谈。
敏感.en: This topic is very sensitive, better not to discuss it.

敏感.zh: 他对别人的批评特别敏感。
敏感.en: He is especially sensitive to others' criticism.

敏感.zh: 因为我是敏感体质，所以容易过敏。
敏感.en: Because I have a sensitive constitution, I'm prone to allergies.

敏感.zh: 这种植物对光线很敏感。
敏感.en: This plant is very sensitive to light.

运气.zh: 今天运气不错，抽到了大奖。
运气.en: Today luck is good, I won a big prize.

运气.zh: 他运气太差了，总是丢东西。
运气.en: His luck is too bad, he's always losing things.

运气.zh: 虽然运气不好，但他还是很努力。
运气.en: Although luck is bad, he still works hard.

运气.zh: 运气也是实力的一部分。
运气.en: Luck is also part of ability.

玩具.zh: 别把玩具扔得到处都是。
虽然玩具很多，但他最喜欢那个小熊。
玩具.en: Although there are many toys, he likes that little bear the most.

玩具.zh: 每次逛超市，他都要买一个新玩具。
玩具.en: Every time we go to the supermarket, he wants to buy a new toy.

鼠.en: There's a rat in the kitchen, be careful.
This year is the Year of the Rat.
Although the mouse is small, it's very smart.

鼠.zh: 实验室养了很多小白鼠。
鼠.en: The lab keeps many white mice.

防止.en: When going out, prevent catching a cold.
Please close windows and doors to prevent thieves.

防止.zh: 打疫苗可以有效防止疾病。
为了避免事故，我们要防止疲劳驾驶。
防止.en: To avoid accidents, we must prevent driving while tired.

防止.zh: 多喝水能防止皮肤干燥。
防止.en: Drinking more water can prevent dry skin.

年纪.en: How old are you this year?

年纪.zh: 他年纪大了，走路不方便。
年纪.en: He is old and walks with difficulty.

年纪.zh: 虽然年纪不大，但他很懂事。
年纪.en: Although he is not old, he is very sensible.

年纪.zh: 我们俩年纪差不多，都是八零后。
年纪.en: We two are about the same age, both born in the 80s.

年纪.zh: 年纪轻轻就学会这么多东西，真厉害。
年纪.en: Learning so much at such a young age is really impressive.

设置.zh: 你可以自己设置闹钟时间。
设置.en: You can set the alarm time yourself.

设置.zh: 我先把手机设置好，再出门。
设置.en: I'll set up my phone first, then go out.

设置.zh: 这个软件有很多设置选项，我还没搞懂。
设置.en: This software has many settings options, I haven't figured them out yet.

设置.zh: 他为了省电，把屏幕亮度设置得很低。
设置.en: He set the screen brightness very low to save power.

智慧.en: Old people have a lot of wisdom.

智慧.zh: 遇到问题要用智慧解决。
智慧.en: You should use wisdom to solve problems.

智慧.zh: 智慧不是天生的，而是慢慢学来的。
智慧.en: Wisdom is not innate but learned gradually.

智慧.zh: 他靠自己的智慧赚了很多钱。
智慧.en: He made a lot of money through his own wisdom.

智慧.zh: 这本书里讲了很多生活智慧，值得一看。
智慧.en: This book contains a lot of life wisdom, worth reading.

含.en: Does this glass of water contain sugar?

含.zh: 这个饮料含有很多维生素。
虽然这个饮料含糖，但我还是想喝。
含.en: Although this drink contains sugar, I still want to drink it.

含.zh: 他说的话含有一点讽刺的意思。
含.en: His words contain a bit of sarcasm.

含.zh: 这款化妆品不含任何有害成分。
含.en: This cosmetic product does not contain any harmful ingredients.

采用.en: The company decided to adopt new technology.

采用.zh: 如果采用这个方案，需要多花一些时间。
采用.en: If we adopt this plan, it will take some more time.

采用.zh: 他们采用了我的建议，效果很好。
采用.en: They adopted my suggestion, and the result was great.

采用.zh: 很多学校都采用了这种教学方法。
采用.en: Many schools have adopted this teaching method.

夫妇.en: The old couple takes a walk together every day.

夫妇.zh: 那对年轻夫妇刚搬来不久。
夫妇.en: That young couple just moved here not long ago.

夫妇.zh: 这对夫妇虽然很恩爱，但偶尔也会吵架。
夫妇.en: Although this couple is very loving, they occasionally argue.

夫妇.zh: 夫妇俩商量了一下，决定去旅游。
夫妇.en: The couple discussed it and decided to travel.

夫妇.zh: 他们是一对很有名的夫妇，经常上电视。
夫妇.en: They are a very famous couple who often appear on TV.

摔.zh: 他不小心把手机摔坏了。
摔.en: He accidentally dropped and broke his phone.

摔.zh: 走路的时候看路，不然容易摔。
摔.en: Watch the road when walking, otherwise you might fall.

摔.zh: 孩子从床上摔下来，哭得很厉害。
摔.en: The child fell off the bed and cried very hard.

沟通.zh: 沟通是解决问题的关键。
沟通.en: Communication is the key to solving problems.

沟通.zh: 他们之间沟通不畅，所以误会了。
沟通.en: There was poor communication between them, so they misunderstood.

沟通.zh: 如果你有想法，请及时跟我沟通。
沟通.en: If you have any ideas, please communicate with me in time.

沟通.zh: 有效的沟通能让工作更顺利。
沟通.en: Effective communication can make work go more smoothly.

手指.zh: 我用手指指了一下那边。
手指.en: I pointed over there with my finger.

手指.zh: 他手指上戴了一个戒指。
手指.en: He wears a ring on his finger.

手指.zh: 如果你用手指着别人，是不礼貌的。
手指.en: It is impolite to point at others with your finger.

手指.zh: 她不小心用刀切到了手指，流了好多血。
手指.en: She accidentally cut her finger with a knife and bled a lot.

结论.en: This conclusion is not very accurate.

结论.zh: 经过讨论，我们得出了结论。
结论.en: After discussion, we reached a conclusion.

结论.zh: 他的结论下得太早了，没有证据。
结论.en: He jumped to a conclusion too early without evidence.

结论.zh: 根据这些数据，我们可以得出结论。
结论.en: Based on this data, we can draw a conclusion.

提升.zh: 我想提升我的口语水平。
提升.en: I want to improve my spoken language level.

提升.zh: 公司最近在提升员工福利。
提升.en: The company has been improving employee benefits recently.

提升.zh: 多读书可以提升你的知识面。
提升.en: Reading more can broaden your knowledge.

提升.zh: 他通过努力训练提升了跑步速度。
提升.en: He improved his running speed through hard training.

提升.zh: 这个软件更新后，性能提升了不少。
提升.en: After this software update, the performance improved a lot.

化学.zh: 我高中时最喜欢化学课。
化学.en: I liked chemistry class the most in high school.

化学.zh: 这种洗衣粉含有化学添加剂。
化学.en: This laundry detergent contains chemical additives.

化学.zh: 化学老师做了一个有趣的实验。
化学.en: The chemistry teacher did an interesting experiment.

化学.zh: 很多食品里都加了化学防腐剂。
化学.en: Many foods have chemical preservatives added.

化学.zh: 虽然化学很难，但我还是选了理科。
化学.en: Although chemistry is hard, I still chose science.

总之.en: In short, I don't want to go.

总之.zh: 他又迟到，又不交作业，总之很懒。
总之.en: He is late and doesn't hand in homework; in short, he is very lazy.

总之.zh: 总之这件事你别管了，我来处理。
总之.en: Anyway, don't worry about this, I'll handle it.

总之.zh: 天气不好，路又远，总之今天不适合出门。
总之.en: The weather is bad and the road is far; in short, today is not suitable to go out.

总之.zh: 他有钱、有房、有车，总之条件很好。
总之.en: He has money, a house, and a car; in short, his conditions are good.

地面.zh: 地震后地面裂开了一条缝。
地面.en: After the earthquake, the ground cracked open.

地面.zh: 请把垃圾扔到地面上的桶里。
地面.en: Please throw the trash into the bin on the ground.

地面.zh: 他趴在地面上找掉落的钥匙。
地面.en: He lay on the ground looking for the dropped keys.

地面.zh: 虽然飞机已经起飞，但还能看清地面的灯光。
地面.en: Although the plane had taken off, you could still see the lights on the ground.

天空.en: The sky is very blue today.
A flock of birds flew across the sky.

天空.zh: 晚上天空中有很多星星。
天空.en: There are many stars in the sky at night.

天空.zh: 他仰望着天空，心里很平静。
天空.en: He looked up at the sky and felt very calm.

天空.zh: 暴风雨过后，天空出现了一道彩虹。
天空.en: After the storm, a rainbow appeared in the sky.

统一.zh: 我们要统一意见再行动。
统一.en: We need to unify our opinions before taking action.

统一.zh: 公司统一了工作服的颜色。
统一.en: The company unified the color of the work uniforms.

统一.zh: 大家统一穿红色衣服参加活动。
统一.en: Everyone wore red clothes uniformly to the event.

统一.zh: 这个国家历史上曾经统一过多次。
统一.en: This country has been unified many times in history.

统一.zh: 虽然想法不同，但最终我们达成了统一。
统一.en: Although we had different ideas, we finally reached a consensus.

虎.zh: 动物园里有一只大老虎。
虎.en: There is a big tiger in the zoo.
He was born in the Year of the Tiger, and he has a strong personality.
The tiger is the king of the forest.

虎.zh: 别看他个子小，其实是个虎将。
虎.en: Don't judge by his small size; he's actually a brave fighter.

虎.zh: 他做事虎头蛇尾，常常半途而废。
虎.en: He starts things with great enthusiasm but ends poorly, often giving up halfway.

制度.zh: 公司的考勤制度很严格。
制度.en: The company's attendance system is very strict.

制度.zh: 每个学校都有自己的管理制度。
制度.en: Every school has its own management system.

制度.zh: 如果不遵守交通制度，会被罚款。
制度.en: If you don't follow traffic regulations, you'll be fined.

制度.zh: 新的休假制度让员工更满意了。
制度.en: The new vacation policy makes employees more satisfied.

绕.zh: 前面修路，我们得绕远路。
绕.en: The road ahead is under repair; we have to take a detour.

绕.zh: 他说话总是绕来绕去，不直接。
绕.en: He always talks in circles and doesn't get straight to the point.
The rope is wound around the pole.

绕.zh: 这个问题很复杂，别绕进去了。
绕.en: This problem is very complicated; don't get tangled up in it.

玉米.en: Corn is very cheap at the market.
He planted a large field of corn.
Corn can be made into popcorn.

玉米.zh: 奶奶用玉米面和面做饼子。
玉米.en: Grandma uses corn flour to make pancakes.

工业.zh: 这几年工业污染问题越来越严重了。
工业.en: In recent years, industrial pollution has become more serious.

工业.zh: 工业城市现在都在转型做环保。
工业.en: Industrial cities are now transforming to be environmentally friendly.

工业.zh: 虽然工业很重要，但也要注意环境保护。
工业.en: Although industry is important, we also need to pay attention to environmental protection.

工业.zh: 我爸爸在工业区上班，离家很远。
工业.en: My dad works in an industrial zone, far from home.

身材.zh: 你最近健身了吗？身材变化很大。
身材.en: Have you been working out recently? Your figure has changed a lot.

身材.zh: 她不仅身材好，而且性格也很棒。
身材.en: Not only is her figure good, but her personality is also great.

身材.zh: 这件衣服很挑身材，我穿不好看。
身材.en: This dress is very picky about body shape; it doesn't look good on me.

身材.zh: 他一直坚持运动，为了保持好身材。
身材.en: He keeps exercising to maintain a good physique.

设施.en: The community facilities are very complete.

设施.zh: 这个公园的健身设施都是新修的。
设施.en: The fitness facilities in this park are all newly built.

设施.zh: 虽然酒店设施一般，但服务特别好。
设施.en: Although the hotel facilities are average, the service is especially good.

设施.zh: 学校的基础设施需要更新了。
公共设施应该为所有人服务。

腰.zh: 他最近腰扭伤了，不能做运动。
腰.en: He recently sprained his waist and can't exercise.

腰.zh: 坐久了腰会不舒服，所以要多站起来活动。
腰.en: Sitting for a long time makes the waist uncomfortable, so stand up and move more.

腰.zh: 她系了一条腰带在腰上。
腰.en: She tied a belt around her waist.

腰.zh: 跳舞的时候要注意腰部的动作。
腰.en: When dancing, pay attention to waist movements.

抱怨.zh: 她抱怨公司给的工资太低了。
抱怨.en: She complains that the company pays too low a salary.

抱怨.zh: 他抱怨天气不好，但也没办法改变。
抱怨.en: He complains about the bad weather, but can't change it.

抱怨.zh: 遇到问题光抱怨没用，要想办法解决。
抱怨.en: It's useless to just complain when encountering problems; you need to find a solution.

抱怨.zh: 他一边抱怨一边还是把工作做完了。
抱怨.en: He complained while still finishing the work.

从事.zh: 她从事金融行业已经十年了。
从事.en: She has been in the finance industry for ten years.

从事.zh: 虽然从事这个行业很辛苦，但他喜欢。
从事.en: Although engaging in this industry is hard, he likes it.

从事.zh: 很多年轻人选择从事互联网相关工作。
从事.en: Many young people choose to engage in internet-related work.

无关.en: This matter has nothing to do with me.

无关.zh: 他辞职的原因跟工资无关，是个人发展问题。
无关.en: The reason he resigned has nothing to do with salary; it's about personal development.

无关.zh: 这个问题跟今天的主题无关，我们下次再讨论。
无关.en: This question is unrelated to today's topic; we'll discuss it next time.

无关.zh: 你的想法跟现实完全无关。
无关.en: Your ideas have nothing to do with reality.

无关.zh: 他们的争吵跟那件小事无关。
无关.en: Their argument has nothing to do with that small matter.

义务.zh: 每个人都有义务保护环境。
义务.en: Everyone has the duty to protect the environment.

义务.zh: 做义工虽然不是强制性的，但我觉得是公民的义务。
义务.en: Doing volunteer work is not mandatory, but I think it's a citizen's duty.

义务.zh: 他们参加了一次义务劳动。
义务.en: They participated in a voluntary labor activity.
Parents have the obligation to raise children.

奇迹.zh: 他能从这么严重的车祸中生还真是个奇迹。
奇迹.en: It's a miracle that he survived such a serious car accident.

奇迹.zh: 虽然医生说不一定能好，但她创造了奇迹。
奇迹.en: Although the doctor said she might not recover, she created a miracle.

奇迹.zh: 坚持努力，也许会有奇迹发生。
奇迹.en: Persist in efforts, maybe a miracle will happen.

奇迹.zh: 奇迹很少发生，还是要靠自己。
奇迹.en: Miracles rarely happen; you still have to rely on yourself.

运用.zh: 他运用自己的经验解决了这个难题。
运用.en: He applied his own experience to solve this difficult problem.

运用.zh: 学习语法后要在实际对话中运用它。
运用.en: After learning grammar, you need to apply it in actual conversation.

运用.zh: 这个技巧运用得当的话，效果会很好。
运用.en: If this skill is applied properly, the effect will be good.

运用.zh: 她不懂得如何运用法律来保护自己。
运用.en: She doesn't know how to apply the law to protect herself.

逐渐.en: The weather is gradually getting cold.

逐渐.zh: 随着时间推移，他的态度逐渐改变了。
逐渐.en: As time went on, his attitude gradually changed.

逐渐.zh: 我逐渐习惯了这里的生活。
逐渐.en: I gradually got used to life here.

逐渐.zh: 如果不努力，你的成绩会逐渐下降。
逐渐.en: If you don't work hard, your grades will gradually drop.

动手.zh: 我们已经准备好了，可以动手了。
动手.en: We are ready, we can start.

动手.zh: 他先动手打人，所以被罚了。
动手.en: He hit first, so he was punished.

动手.zh: 这件事需要大家一起动手才能完成。
动手.en: This matter needs everyone to work together to finish.

靠近.zh: 他慢慢靠近窗户，想看看外面发生了什么。
靠近.en: He slowly approached the window to see what happened outside.

靠近.zh: 这个小区靠近地铁站，很方便。
靠近.en: This neighborhood is near the subway station, very convenient.

靠近.zh: 因为船靠近了岸边，大家都能看到沙滩了。
靠近.en: Because the boat approached the shore, everyone could see the beach.

制定.en: We need to make a plan.

制定.zh: 公司正在制定新的规章制度。
制定.en: The company is formulating new rules and regulations.

制定.zh: 政府制定了很多环保政策。
制定.en: The government has formulated many environmental policies.

制定.zh: 为了提高效率，我们制定了一份详细的时间表。
制定.en: To improve efficiency, we made a detailed schedule.

沉默.zh: 在会议上，他始终沉默不语。
沉默.en: At the meeting, he remained silent and didn't speak.

沉默.zh: 沉默有时候是最好的回答。
沉默.en: Silence is sometimes the best answer.
Her silence made me very worried.

沉默.zh: 面对他的质问，她选择了沉默。
沉默.en: In the face of his questioning, she chose silence.

直播.en: Is there a live broadcast tonight?

直播.zh: 很多网红喜欢在晚上开直播。
直播.en: Many influencers like to do live streams at night.
I'm watching the live broadcast of the ball game.
Live streaming sales are very popular now.

直播.zh: 因为网络不好，直播卡住了。
直播.en: Because the internet was bad, the live stream froze.

独特.zh: 这家餐厅的味道非常独特，值得一试。
独特.en: This restaurant's flavor is very unique, worth a try.

独特.zh: 每个人都有自己独特的想法。
独特.en: Everyone has their own unique ideas.

独特.zh: 他独特的见解让大家印象深刻。

应当.zh: 作为学生，我们应当遵守校规。
应当.en: As students, we should follow school rules.
You should tell him about this matter.

应当.zh: 如果犯了错，就应当主动承认。
应当.en: If you make a mistake, you should voluntarily admit it.

罚.en: He ran a red light and got fined.

罚.zh: 老师罚他抄写课文十遍。
罚.en: The teacher punished him by copying the text ten times.
Drunk driving will be heavily punished.
Being late will result in a fine.

罚.zh: 他因为超速被罚了两百块钱。
罚.en: He was fined 200 yuan for speeding.

交往.en: We've known each other for many years.

交往.zh: 多和优秀的人交往对你有好处。
交往.en: Associating with excellent people benefits you.

交往.zh: 他们交往不久就结婚了。
交往.en: They got married not long after dating.
I don't want to associate with him.

交往.zh: 在交往过程中，信任是很重要的。
交往.en: In the process of interaction, trust is very important.

各自.zh: 考试结束后，同学们各自收拾东西离开教室。
各自.en: After the exam, the students each packed their things and left the classroom.

各自.zh: 虽然大家想法不同，但各自都努力了。
各自.en: Although everyone had different ideas, each tried their best.

各自.zh: 你们各自的任务是什么？
他们各自点了自己喜欢的菜。
各自.en: They each ordered their favorite dishes.

糟糕.en: Oh no, I forgot my keys!

糟糕.zh: 今天真是糟糕的一天，什么都做不好。
糟糕.en: Today is really a terrible day, I can't do anything right.

糟糕.zh: 因为天气糟糕，所以我们取消了旅行。
糟糕.en: Because the weather was bad, we canceled the trip.
Oh no, the phone is dead.

糟糕.zh: 这道菜的味道太糟糕了。
糟糕.en: The taste of this dish is terrible.

空中.en: A bird is flying in the air.

空中.zh: 飞机在空中飞行了十个小时才到达。
空中.en: The plane flew in the air for ten hours before arriving.

空中.zh: 虽然空中乌云密布，但始终没有下雨。
空中.en: Although the sky was full of dark clouds, it never rained.

空中.zh: 他在空中翻了一个跟头。
空中.en: He did a somersault in the air.
Many balloons are floating in the air.

连接.zh: 这条高速公路连接了两个城市。
如果你把这两根线连接起来，灯就会亮。
连接.en: If you connect these two wires, the light will turn on.

连接.zh: 蓝牙耳机需要连接手机。
连接.en: The Bluetooth headset needs to connect to the phone.

连接.zh: 这座桥连接了河的两岸。
连接.en: This bridge connects both sides of the river.

药品.zh: 医生建议我按时服用这些药品。
药品.en: The doctor advised me to take these medicines on time.

药品.zh: 因为药品过期了，所以不能再用。
药品.en: Because the medicine expired, it cannot be used anymore.

药品.zh: 请把药品放在孩子够不到的地方。
药品.en: Please keep medicines out of reach of children.

药品.zh: 这家药店卖的药品种类很多。
药品.en: This pharmacy sells many kinds of medicines.

影片.zh: 昨晚我们看了一部关于外星人的影片。
影片.en: Last night we watched a movie about aliens.

影片.zh: 虽然影片很长，但观众都很喜欢。
影片.en: Although the movie was long, the audience all liked it.

影片.zh: 这部影片的导演很有名。
影片.en: The director of this film is very famous.

影片.zh: 影片结束时大家都鼓掌了。
影片.en: When the film ended, everyone applauded.

拆.en: I want to unwrap the gift.
Workers are demolishing that old building.

拆.zh: 因为房子太旧了，所以需要拆掉重建。
拆.en: Because the house is too old, it needs to be torn down and rebuilt.

拆.zh: 别拆这个盒子，里面还有东西。
拆.en: Don't open this box, there's still something inside.
He helped me disassemble the computer hard drive.

退休.zh: 她退休后每天去公园散步。
退休.en: After retiring, she goes for walks in the park every day.

退休.zh: 虽然他已经退休了，但还是很忙。
退休.en: Although he has retired, he is still very busy.
When do you plan to retire?
Retirement life should be very relaxing.

此时.en: At this moment, he is sleeping.

此时.zh: 此时天空突然下起了大雨。
此时.en: At this moment, it suddenly started raining heavily.

此时.zh: 就在此时，我接到了她的电话。
此时.en: Just at this moment, I received her phone call.
At this moment, everyone is very nervous.
The mood at this moment is particularly complicated.

当作.en: Don't treat it as a joke.

当作.zh: 我一直把你当作最好的朋友。
当作.en: I have always regarded you as my best friend.

当作.zh: 如果你把困难当作挑战，就会更有动力。
当作.en: If you treat difficulties as challenges, you will be more motivated.
