Dianping (大众点评) is very useful.
Mass media has a huge influence.

假如.zh: 假如明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。
假如.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go hiking.

假如.zh: 假如你有时间，可以来参加我们的聚会。
假如.en: If you have time, you can come to our party.

假如.zh: 假如你不确定，最好先问一下。
假如.en: If you're not sure, it's best to ask first.

假如.zh: 假如我是你，我会接受这个工作。
假如.en: If I were you, I would accept this job.

相对.zh: 相对而言，这个方案更好。
相对.en: Relatively speaking, this plan is better.

相对.zh: 虽然价格高，但质量相对好很多。
相对.en: Although the price is high, the quality is relatively much better.

相对.zh: 他们住在城市相对偏远的地区。
相对.en: They live in a relatively remote area of the city.

改善.zh: 公司正在改善员工的工作环境。
改善.en: The company is improving the working environment for employees.

改善.zh: 通过锻炼，他的健康状况得到了改善。
改善.en: Through exercise, his health condition improved.

改善.zh: 这个政策改善了交通状况。
改善.en: This policy improved the traffic conditions.

拥抱.zh: 她张开双臂，热情地拥抱了老朋友。
拥抱.en: She opened her arms and warmly hugged her old friend.

拥抱.zh: 虽然我们很久没见，但一见面就拥抱了。
拥抱.en: Although we haven't seen each other for a long time, we hugged as soon as we met.

拥抱.zh: 因为太激动了，他忍不住拥抱了妈妈。
拥抱.en: Because he was too excited, he couldn't help hugging his mother.

拥抱.zh: 每次见面，他们都会给对方一个温暖的拥抱。
拥抱.en: Every time they meet, they give each other a warm hug.

晒.zh: 今天太阳很好，我想晒被子。
晒.en: The sun is nice today, I want to dry the quilt.

晒.zh: 夏天的时候，很多人喜欢去海边晒太阳。
晒.en: In summer, many people like to go to the beach to sunbathe.

晒.zh: 如果天气好，我就把衣服拿出去晒。
晒.en: If the weather is good, I'll take the clothes out to dry.

晒.zh: 她每天都要晒一个小时太阳，为了补钙。
晒.en: She sunbathes for an hour every day to get calcium.

晒.zh: 别在太阳底下晒太久，会晒伤的。
晒.en: Don't sunbathe too long under the sun, you'll get sunburned.

计算机.zh: 现在越来越多的工作都需要用到计算机。
计算机.en: Now more and more jobs require the use of computers.

计算机.zh: 他虽然年纪大了，但也会用计算机上网。
计算机.en: Although he is old, he also knows how to use a computer to go online.

计算机.zh: 计算机科学是一门很重要的学科。
计算机.en: Computer science is a very important subject.

计算机.zh: 这台计算机的速度非常快，适合玩游戏。
计算机.en: This computer is very fast, suitable for playing games.

房屋.zh: 最近几年，城市的房屋价格涨了很多。
房屋.en: In recent years, house prices in the city have risen a lot.

房屋.zh: 因为租约到期了，他们正在找新的房屋。
房屋.en: Because the lease expired, they are looking for a new house.

房屋.zh: 这栋房屋的装修风格我很喜欢。
房屋.en: I really like the decoration style of this house.

房屋.zh: 地震后，很多房屋都需要重建。
房屋.en: After the earthquake, many houses need to be rebuilt.

纪录.zh: 这部电影创造了新的票房纪录。
纪录.en: This movie set a new box office record.

纪录.zh: 虽然天气很冷，他还是刷新了个人纪录。
纪录.en: Although it was very cold, he still broke his personal record.

纪录.zh: 这个纪录保持了十年，终于被打破了。
纪录.en: This record stood for ten years and finally was broken.

纪录.zh: 奥运会纪录的难度非常大。

农民.en: Farmers work hard in the fields.

农民.zh: 很多农民现在开始使用现代化的农业技术。
农民.en: Many farmers are now starting to use modern agricultural technology.

农民.zh: 因为城里工资高，有些农民选择去打工。
农民.en: Because wages in the city are high, some farmers choose to work there.

农民.zh: 这些蔬菜都是农民自己种的，非常新鲜。
农民.en: These vegetables are grown by the farmers themselves, very fresh.

农民.zh: 政府对农民提供了很多补贴。
农民.en: The government provides many subsidies to farmers.

双手.zh: 她用双手接过了礼物，连声道谢。
双手.en: She took the gift with both hands, repeatedly saying thank you.

双手.zh: 如果你不知道答案，就请举起双手示意。
双手.en: If you don't know the answer, please raise both hands to signal.

双手.zh: 他双手捧着书，认真地读起来。
双手.en: He held the book with both hands and started reading seriously.

双手.zh: 老人双手颤抖着打开信封。
双手.en: The old man opened the envelope with trembling hands.

买卖.en: This deal made a lot of money.

买卖.zh: 他做小买卖起家，现在开了大公司。
买卖.en: He started with small business and now owns a big company.

买卖.zh: 虽然行情不好，但他还是做成了一笔买卖。
买卖.en: Although the market is bad, he still managed to make a deal.

买卖.zh: 做生意最重要的是公平买卖。
买卖.en: The most important thing in business is fair trade.

买卖.zh: 网上买卖越来越流行了。
买卖.en: Online buying and selling is becoming more and more popular.

形势.en: The current situation is very complex.

形势.zh: 我们要根据形势的变化及时调整计划。
形势.en: We need to adjust our plans in time according to changes in the situation.

形势.zh: 如果你了解当前的形势，就知道该怎么做。
形势.en: If you understand the current situation, you'll know what to do.

形势.zh: 经济形势不好，很多公司都裁员了。
形势.en: The economic situation is bad, many companies have laid off workers.

形势.zh: 国际形势的变化会影响我们的日常生活。
形势.en: Changes in the international situation affect our daily lives.

劝.en: I advised him not to go.

劝.zh: 朋友们都劝她早点休息，不要熬夜。
劝.en: Her friends all advised her to rest early and not stay up late.

劝.zh: 虽然他不想听，但我还是劝了他几句。
劝.en: Although he didn't want to listen, I still advised him a few words.

劝.zh: 医生劝他少抽烟，对身体不好。
劝.en: The doctor advised him to smoke less, it's bad for health.

劝.zh: 你劝劝他，让他别那么冲动。
劝.en: You persuade him, tell him not to be so impulsive.

出售.zh: 这家店出售各种进口巧克力。
出售.en: This shop sells all kinds of imported chocolate.

出售.zh: 他最近在二手网站出售旧书。
出售.en: He recently sold old books on a second-hand website.

出售.zh: 因为缺钱，他只好出售了自己珍藏的画。
出售.en: Because he was short of money, he had to sell his treasured painting.

出售.zh: 超市出售的水果都很新鲜。
出售.en: The fruits sold at the supermarket are all very fresh.

出售.zh: 公司决定低价出售库存，以便快速回笼资金。
出售.en: The company decided to sell off the inventory at low prices to quickly recover funds.

总部.en: The company headquarters is in Shanghai.

总部.zh: 他昨天刚调到总部工作。
总部.en: He was just transferred to work at headquarters yesterday.

总部.zh: 总部的领导下周要来我们分公司视察。
总部.en: Leaders from headquarters will come to inspect our branch next week.

总部.zh: 这家企业的总部在纽约，但工厂都在亚洲。
总部.en: The headquarters of this enterprise is in New York, but all the factories are in Asia.

总部.zh: 我们部门的申请需要先报到总部审批。
总部.en: Our department's application needs to be submitted to headquarters for approval first.

分离.zh: 这对好朋友因为工作分离了。
分离.en: The two good friends were separated because of work.

分离.zh: 油和水混合后又会自然分离。
分离.en: Oil and water will naturally separate again after being mixed.

分离.zh: 分离焦虑是很多小孩都会经历的阶段。
分离.en: Separation anxiety is a stage that many children go through.

分离.zh: 他们不想分离，但现实让他们不得不各奔东西。
分离.en: They didn't want to separate, but reality forced them to go their separate ways.

分离.zh: 科学家正在研究如何更高效地分离二氧化碳。
分离.en: Scientists are researching how to separate carbon dioxide more efficiently.

运输.en: This shipment is being transported by truck.

运输.zh: 运输过程中要小心易碎品。
运输.en: Be careful with fragile items during transportation.

运输.zh: 他们负责把农产品运输到城市里。
运输.en: They are responsible for transporting agricultural products to the city.

运输.zh: 铁路运输比公路运输更便宜。
运输.en: Rail transport is cheaper than road transport.

运输.zh: 因为天气不好，运输时间可能会延长两三天。
运输.en: Because of the bad weather, the transport time may be extended by two or three days.

扇.zh: 天太热了，给我一把扇子。
扇.en: It's too hot, give me a fan.
He fanned himself with his hand.

扇.zh: 妈妈轻轻扇着扇子哄宝宝睡觉。
扇.en: Mom gently waved the fan to lull the baby to sleep.

扇.zh: 这扇窗户关不严，老是漏风。
扇.en: This window doesn't close tightly and always lets in drafts.

扇.zh: 她生气地扇了他一巴掌。
扇.en: She angrily slapped him across the face.

利润.en: The profit this month is pretty good.

利润.zh: 他们通过降低成本来提高利润。
利润.en: They increased profits by reducing costs.

利润.zh: 虽然销量高，但利润其实很少。
利润.en: Although sales are high, the actual profit is very small.

利润.zh: 老板说今年利润比去年翻了一倍。
利润.en: The boss said this year's profit has doubled compared to last year.

利润.zh: 公司把大部分利润都用来研发新产品了。
利润.en: The company used most of the profit to develop new products.

堵.en: There's a traffic jam on the road.

堵.zh: 下水道堵了，水都流不出去。
堵.en: The drain is clogged and water can't flow out.

堵.zh: 别堵在门口，让别人先过。
堵.en: Don't block the doorway, let others pass first.

堵.zh: 他心里堵得慌，想找人聊聊。
堵.en: He feels a lump in his heart and wants to talk to someone.

堵.zh: 周末去市中心肯定特别堵。
堵.en: Going to the city center on weekends is definitely very congested.

珍惜.zh: 时间过得很快，你要珍惜每一天。
珍惜.en: Time flies, you should cherish every day.

珍惜.zh: 他非常珍惜这段友谊，从不轻易发火。
珍惜.en: He really cherishes this friendship and never loses his temper easily.

珍惜.zh: 只有失去过，才懂得珍惜。
珍惜.en: Only after losing it do you learn to cherish it.

传播.zh: 他在网上传播了很多正能量。
传播.en: He spread a lot of positive energy online.

传播.zh: 谣言一旦传播开来就很难控制。
传播.en: Once rumors spread, they are hard to control.

传播.zh: 这个习俗通过口口相传传播了好几百年。
传播.en: This custom has been spread for hundreds of years through word of mouth.

匹.en: He is riding a white horse.
This piece of cloth is of good quality.

匹.zh: 我们公司买了三匹新马。
匹.en: Our company bought three new horses.

匹.zh: 草原上有一匹自由奔跑的马。
匹.en: There is a horse running freely on the grassland.

随意.en: Everyone sit wherever you like, no need to be polite.

随意.zh: 他选衣服很随意，从不纠结。
随意.en: He chooses clothes very casually, never agonizing over it.

随意.zh: 你随意写几个字就行，我不挑剔。
随意.en: Just write a few words casually, I'm not picky.

随意.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但他还是随意吃了点东西。
随意.en: Although time was tight, he still casually ate a bit.

随意.zh: 周末我喜欢随意逛逛，不设定具体目标。
随意.en: On weekends I like to stroll around casually without setting specific goals.

好奇.zh: 她好奇地打开那个盒子。
我很好奇他为什么突然辞职。
好奇.en: I'm very curious why he suddenly quit.

好奇.zh: 因为好奇，他报名参加了那个实验。
好奇.en: Out of curiosity, he signed up for that experiment.

好奇.zh: 看到新邻居搬来，大家都挺好奇的。
好奇.en: Seeing the new neighbor move in, everyone is quite curious.

集体.en: We are going on an outing as a group.

集体.zh: 这次比赛是集体项目，需要配合。
集体.en: This competition is a team event and requires cooperation.

集体.zh: 虽然每个人想法不同，但集体决定必须遵守。
集体.en: Although everyone has different ideas, collective decisions must be followed.

集体.zh: 公司组织了一次集体培训，大家都觉得很有收获。
集体.en: The company organized a group training, and everyone found it very rewarding.

预计.en: It is expected to rain tomorrow.

预计.zh: 这次旅行预计需要五天。
预计.en: This trip is expected to take five days.

预计.zh: 工程预计下个月完工，但可能延迟。
预计.en: The project is expected to finish next month, but it might be delayed.

预计.zh: 他预计自己会考得很好，结果却失望了。
预计.en: He predicted he would do well on the exam, but was disappointed.

预计.zh: 公司预计今年的利润比去年增长百分之十。
预计.en: The company expects profits to grow by ten percent this year compared to last year.

收获.en: Autumn is the season of harvest.
I gained a lot from this study.

收获.zh: 他辛苦一年，终于有了收获。
收获.en: After a year of hard work, he finally reaped rewards.

收获.zh: 虽然比赛输了，但我们收获了经验。
收获.en: Although we lost the game, we gained experience.

收获.zh: 去农村体验生活让我有很多意想不到的收获。
收获.en: Experiencing life in the countryside brought me many unexpected gains.

装饰.zh: 她喜欢用鲜花装饰客厅。
装饰.en: She likes to decorate the living room with fresh flowers.

装饰.zh: 买一些装饰品来布置新家吧。
装饰.en: Buy some decorations to furnish the new home.

装饰.zh: 虽然装饰简单，但给人很温馨的感觉。
装饰.en: Although the decoration is simple, it gives a very warm feeling.

锅.en: The water in the pot is boiling.
This pot can be used for stir-frying.

锅.zh: 她买了一个新的不粘锅。
锅.en: She bought a new non-stick pan.

锅.zh: 煮汤的时候记得盖锅盖。
锅.en: Remember to cover the pot when making soup.

锅.zh: 我洗锅的时候不小心把手烫了。
锅.en: I accidentally burned my hand while washing the pot.

太太.zh: 他太太在一家公司上班。
太太.en: His wife works at a company.

太太.zh: 太太们在一起聊天喝茶。
太太.en: The ladies are chatting and drinking tea together.

太太.zh: 张太太对邻居非常热情。
太太.en: Mrs. Zhang is very warm to the neighbors.

太太.zh: 他太太做的菜味道特别好。
太太.en: His wife's cooking tastes especially good.

轻易.en: This medicine should not be taken lightly.

轻易.zh: 他轻易地就解决了这个问题。
轻易.en: He solved this problem with ease.

轻易.zh: 虽然困难很大，但不要轻易说放弃。
轻易.en: Although the difficulty is great, don't easily say give up.

轻易.zh: 她轻易相信了别人的话，结果被骗了。
轻易.en: She easily believed what others said, and ended up being cheated.

强调.en: The teacher emphasized the key points.

强调.zh: 我想强调一下，这次考试很重要。
强调.en: I want to emphasize that this exam is very important.

强调.zh: 虽然已经说过，但我还是要强调团队合作。
强调.en: Although it has been said, I still want to emphasize teamwork.

强调.zh: 在会议上，经理强调了我们不能忽视客户需求。
强调.en: At the meeting, the manager emphasized that we cannot ignore customer needs.

丑.en: This bag is a bit ugly.
Can you not laugh at me for being ugly?

丑.zh: 虽然他长得丑, 但心地善良.
丑.en: Although he looks ugly, he has a kind heart.

丑.zh: 那只小狗丑得还挺可爱的.
丑.en: That puppy is so ugly it's kind of cute.

丑.zh: 你穿这件衣服真丑, 快换掉吧.
丑.en: You look really ugly in this outfit, change it quickly.

分配.zh: 今年奖金分配得很公平.
分配.en: This year's bonuses were distributed very fairly.

分配.zh: 老师让我们自己分配小组作业.
分配.en: The teacher let us assign the group work ourselves.

分配.zh: 如果资源不够, 就要合理分配.
分配.en: If resources are insufficient, they need to be allocated reasonably.

分配.zh: 公司重新分配了办公室, 我搬到三楼了.
分配.en: The company reassigned offices, and I moved to the third floor.

账户.zh: 你记得银行账户密码吗?
账户.en: Do you remember your bank account password?

账户.zh: 我用新账户付了这笔钱.
账户.en: I paid this amount using the new account.

账户.zh: 如果账户余额不足, 交易会失败.
账户.en: If the account balance is insufficient, the transaction will fail.

账户.zh: 他登录了三个不同的社交账户.
账户.en: He logged into three different social media accounts.

当成.en: Don't take me for a fool.

当成.zh: 他把那个玩具当成了真的狗.
当成.en: He mistook that toy for a real dog.

当成.zh: 我一直把你当成最好的朋友.
当成.en: I've always regarded you as my best friend.

当成.zh: 她总是把客气话当成真心话.
当成.en: She always takes polite remarks as sincere words.

当成.zh: 我们不要把这件事当成玩笑, 很重要.
当成.en: We shouldn't treat this matter as a joke; it's very important.

适当.zh: 饭吃八分饱, 适当就好.
适当.en: Eat until 80% full; moderation is fine.

适当.zh: 适当休息可以提高工作效率.
适当.en: Proper rest can improve work efficiency.

适当.zh: 给小孩零花钱要适当, 不能太多.
适当.en: Give children pocket money in moderation, not too much.

适当.zh: 如果你感觉累了, 就适当放松一下.
适当.en: If you feel tired, just relax appropriately.

如同.en: She is beautiful like a fairy.
He treats me as well as his own younger brother.

如同.zh: 这个城市夜晚灯火辉煌, 如同白昼.
如同.en: The city at night is brilliantly lit, like daytime.

如同.zh: 他说话声音很小, 如同蚊子叫一样.
如同.en: He speaks very softly, like the buzz of a mosquito.

提起.en: Don't bring it up, it's annoying.
I only remembered him when you mentioned him.

提起.zh: 她一提起到那件事就生气.
提起.en: She gets angry as soon as she mentions that matter.

提起.zh: 提起这箱子, 发现还挺重的.
提起.en: When I lifted this suitcase, I found it was quite heavy.

提起.zh: 你提起的那个餐厅, 我昨天刚去过.
提起.en: That restaurant you mentioned, I just went there yesterday.

修改.en: I modified the time of the plan.

修改.zh: 老师让我修改一下作文.
修改.en: The teacher asked me to revise my essay.

修改.zh: 他把合同修改了三遍才满意.
修改.en: He revised the contract three times before he was satisfied.

修改.zh: 如果发现错误, 你可以随时修改.
修改.en: If you find any errors, you can revise them at any time.

冻.en: Put the meat in the freezer to freeze.

冻.zh: 昨天太冷了, 河都冻住了.
冻.en: Yesterday was so cold that the river froze over.

冻.zh: 你冻感冒了没有? 快喝点热水.
冻.en: Did you catch a cold from the cold? Drink some hot water quickly.

冻.zh: 这天气冻得我直打哆嗦, 不想出门.
冻.en: This weather is so cold that I'm shivering and don't want to go out.

要不.zh: 快点, 要不就迟到了.
要不.en: Hurry up, or else we'll be late.

要不.zh: 要不你帮我一下, 我自己做不完.
要不.en: Maybe you could help me? I can't finish by myself.

要不.zh: 要不先吃饭, 再去看电影?
要不.en: How about we eat first and then go watch a movie?

要不.zh: 你得多穿点, 要不肯定会感冒.
要不.en: You need to wear more, otherwise you'll definitely catch a cold.

辞职.zh: 因为压力太大，她决定辞职。
辞职.en: Because the pressure was too great, she decided to resign.

辞职.zh: 我打算下个月辞职去旅行。
辞职.en: I plan to resign next month to travel.

辞职.zh: 如果你不满意，可以辞职，但是要提前说。
辞职.en: If you're not satisfied, you can resign, but you have to give notice.
The boss didn't agree to his resignation.

遵守.zh: 请遵守交通规则，注意安全。
遵守.en: Please obey traffic rules and pay attention to safety.

遵守.zh: 虽然很难，但我们必须遵守法律。
遵守.en: Although it's difficult, we must abide by the law.
He doesn't like to follow discipline.

遵守.zh: 在图书馆里要遵守安静的规定。
遵守.en: In the library, you need to follow the rules of quietness.

抓紧.zh: 我们要抓紧机会学习新东西。
抓紧.en: We need to seize the opportunity to learn new things.

抓紧.zh: 因为快迟到了，他抓紧吃了早饭。
抓紧.en: Because he was almost late, he quickly ate breakfast.
Hold the handle tight, don't let go.
Before the exam, you need to focus on reviewing.

相处.zh: 我和新同事相处得不太愉快。
相处.en: I don't get along very well with the new colleague.

相处.zh: 虽然性格不同，但他们相处得很融洽。
相处.en: Although their personalities are different, they get along harmoniously.

相处.zh: 跟邻居相处需要互相尊重。
相处.en: Getting along with neighbors requires mutual respect.
How have you gotten along for so long?

建造.zh: 这个城市正在建造很多高楼。
建造.en: This city is constructing many tall buildings.

建造.zh: 公司计划明年建造一个新工厂。
建造.en: The company plans to build a new factory next year.

建造.zh: 他们用木头建造了一所小房子。
建造.en: They built a small house using wood.
This temple was built in ancient times.

反映.zh: 他的脸色反映了他很疲惫。
反映.en: His complexion reflects that he is very tired.

反映.zh: 如果你有意见，可以向经理反映。
反映.en: If you have comments, you can report them to the manager.

反映.zh: 这个数据反映了真实情况。
反映.en: This data reflects the real situation.

反映.zh: 他们反映食堂的饭菜不好吃。
反映.en: They reported that the cafeteria food is not tasty.

思维.zh: 我们需要改变传统的思维方式。
思维.en: We need to change traditional ways of thinking.

思维.zh: 因为思维不同，我们经常有分歧。
思维.en: Because our thinking is different, we often have disagreements.

思维.zh: 这个游戏能锻炼逻辑思维。
思维.en: This game can train logical thinking.

思维.zh: 她的思维很活跃，总能想出新点子。
思维.en: Her thinking is very active; she always comes up with new ideas.

保存.zh: 这些照片需要好好保存。
保存.en: These photos need to be well preserved.

保存.zh: 虽然手机坏了，但数据还保存着。
保存.en: Although the phone broke, the data is still saved.
Please store it in the refrigerator.

保存.zh: 他保存了很多小时候的玩具。
保存.en: He has kept many childhood toys.

饼.zh: 妈妈做的鸡蛋饼很好吃。
饼.en: The egg pancake mom makes is very tasty.

饼.zh: 如果你饿了，可以先吃块饼。
饼.en: If you're hungry, you can have a piece of flatbread first.

饼.zh: 这家店的葱油饼很出名。
饼.en: This shop's scallion pancake is very famous.

饼.zh: 他喜欢把饼泡在汤里吃。
饼.en: He likes to soak the pancake in soup and eat it.

阵.en: It rained heavily for a short while just now.

阵.zh: 他感到一阵头痛，就去休息了。
阵.en: He felt a sudden headache, so he went to rest.
From the battlefield came a burst of gunfire.
There was a burst of laughter from outside.

地震.en: Did you know there was an earthquake last night?

地震.zh: 地震的时候，我正好在洗澡。
地震.en: When the earthquake happened, I was taking a shower.

地震.zh: 虽然地震不大，但大家还是跑出去了。
地震.en: Although the earthquake wasn't strong, everyone still ran outside.

地震.zh: 那个地方经常地震，所以房子都建得很结实。
地震.en: That place often has earthquakes, so all the houses are built very sturdy.

地震.zh: 地震后，救援队很快就到了现场。
地震.en: After the earthquake, the rescue team arrived at the scene very quickly.

电视台.en: Which TV station do you like the most?

电视台.zh: 这个新闻是中央电视台播的。
电视台.en: This news was broadcast by CCTV.

电视台.zh: 他在这家电视台当了十年主持人。
电视台.en: He has been a host at this TV station for ten years.

电视台.zh: 那个电视台的节目越来越无聊了。
电视台.en: The shows on that TV station are getting more and more boring.

电视台.zh: 我们公司跟当地电视台合作做了一个广告。
电视台.en: Our company collaborated with the local TV station to make an advertisement.

发明.zh: 这个机器是我爷爷发明的。
发明.en: This machine was invented by my grandfather.

发明.zh: 他发明了一种新的做饭方法。
发明.en: He invented a new way of cooking.

发明.zh: 虽然这个发明很小，但帮了很多人。
发明.en: Although this invention is small, it has helped many people.

发明.zh: 爱迪生发明了很多有用的东西。

疼痛.zh: 她因为肚子疼痛没去上班。
疼痛.en: She didn't go to work because of stomach pain.

疼痛.zh: 运动后肌肉疼痛是正常的。
疼痛.en: Muscle pain after exercise is normal.

疼痛.zh: 他强忍着疼痛走完了全程。
疼痛.en: He endured the pain and finished the whole journey.

返回.en: We will return to Beijing tomorrow.

返回.zh: 飞机因天气原因返回了机场。
返回.en: The plane returned to the airport due to weather.
When are you returning to school?

返回.zh: 他离开后，再也没有返回过家乡。
返回.en: After he left, he never returned to his hometown.

返回.zh: 如果你迷路了，请返回起点。
返回.en: If you get lost, please return to the starting point.

玫瑰.en: He gave her a bouquet of roses.

玫瑰.zh: 院子里种了好几棵玫瑰。
玫瑰.en: There are several rose bushes planted in the yard.

玫瑰.zh: 玫瑰虽然漂亮，但是有刺。
玫瑰.en: Roses are beautiful, but they have thorns.

玫瑰.zh: 情人节那天，玫瑰卖得特别贵。
玫瑰.en: On Valentine's Day, roses are sold at a very high price.

过度.en: Excessive drinking is bad for your health.

过度.zh: 他因为过度紧张没考好。
过度.en: He didn't do well on the exam because of excessive nervousness.

过度.zh: 任何东西吃过度都会有问题的。
过度.en: Eating anything in excess can cause problems.

过度.zh: 医生建议他不要过度使用手机。
过度.en: The doctor advised him not to overuse his phone.

挥.en: Don't wave the knife around, it's dangerous.

挥.zh: 他挥着旗子让大家集合。
挥.en: He waved the flag to gather everyone.

挥.zh: 每次见面她都会挥手打招呼。
挥.en: Every time we meet, she waves to say hello.

挥.zh: 他用力一挥，把球打出了场外。
挥.en: He swung hard and hit the ball out of the field.

突出.zh: 这个问题突出了他的缺点。
她的学习成绩在班上很突出。
突出.en: Her academic performance stands out in the class.

突出.zh: 我们要突出这次活动的重点。
突出.en: We need to highlight the key points of this event.

突出.zh: 虽然他不是最突出的，但是很努力。
突出.en: Although he is not the most outstanding, he is very hardworking.

富有.en: She is not only rich but also kind.

富有.zh: 这个地区富有自然资源。
富有.en: This region is rich in natural resources.

富有.zh: 他是一个富有经验的老师。
富有.en: He is a highly experienced teacher.
Wealthy people are not necessarily happy.

减肥.en: She is on a diet and doesn't eat dinner.

减肥.zh: 我最近减肥效果不错，已经瘦了三公斤。
减肥.en: I've had good results from my diet recently—I've already lost three kilograms.

减肥.zh: 虽然减肥很辛苦，但为了健康还是值得的。
减肥.en: Although losing weight is tough, it's still worth it for health.

减肥.zh: 你减肥的时候可以多吃蔬菜，少喝奶茶。
减肥.en: When you're dieting, you can eat more vegetables and drink less milk tea.

减肥.zh: 他因为减肥成功，整个人看起来精神多了。
减肥.en: Because he succeeded in losing weight, he looks much more energetic.

电池.zh: 遥控器没电了，需要换电池。
电池.en: The remote control is dead and needs new batteries.

电池.zh: 这种电池不耐用，用两天就没电了。
电池.en: This type of battery doesn't last long—it dies after two days.

电池.zh: 我买了新电池，但发现型号不对。
电池.en: I bought new batteries, but found the model was wrong.

电池.zh: 如果你不用的时候把电池取出来，可以延长寿命。
电池.en: If you take out the batteries when not in use, you can extend their lifespan.

电池.zh: 手机电池越来越不耐用了，我打算换个新的。
电池.en: My phone battery is getting worse and worse; I'm planning to get a new one.

乐观.zh: 她性格很乐观，总是笑呵呵的。
乐观.en: She has a very optimistic personality and is always smiling.

乐观.zh: 虽然考试没考好，但他还是很乐观。
乐观.en: Even though he didn't do well on the exam, he's still optimistic.

乐观.zh: 我觉得面对困难时保持乐观很重要。
乐观.en: I think it's important to stay optimistic when facing difficulties.

乐观.zh: 他是个乐观的人，不管发生什么事都能往好处想。
乐观.en: He's an optimistic person; no matter what happens, he can think positively.

乐观.zh: 如果你能乐观一点，生活就会轻松很多。
乐观.en: If you can be a bit more optimistic, life will be much easier.

产业.zh: 这个城市的旅游产业发展得很快。
产业.en: The tourism industry in this city is developing very fast.

产业.zh: 人工智能产业在未来几年会有很大增长。
产业.en: The AI industry will see significant growth in the next few years.

产业.zh: 政府正在大力支持新能源产业的发展。
产业.en: The government is strongly supporting the development of the new energy industry.

产业.zh: 传统产业需要转型升级，才能适应新的市场。
产业.en: Traditional industries need to transform and upgrade to adapt to new markets.

产业.zh: 这个地区的农业产业很发达，主要种植水果和蔬菜。
产业.en: The agricultural industry in this region is very developed, mainly growing fruits and vegetables.

涨.en: Oil prices have gone up again recently.

涨.zh: 房价涨得太快，年轻人买不起房。
涨.en: Housing prices are rising too fast; young people can't afford to buy a house.

涨.zh: 听说下个月工资要涨，大家都很高兴。
涨.en: I heard that salaries will go up next month, and everyone is very happy.

涨.zh: 股票今天涨了不少，我赚了一点点。
涨.en: Stocks went up quite a bit today, and I made a little money.

涨.zh: 因为水果涨了价，我最近都改吃蔬菜了。
涨.en: Because fruit prices have gone up, I've switched to eating vegetables lately.

热烈.en: Everyone gave the new teacher a warm welcome.

热烈.zh: 观众们的掌声非常热烈，持续了好几分钟。
热烈.en: The audience's applause was very enthusiastic and lasted for several minutes.

热烈.zh: 我们进行了一场热烈的讨论，最后终于达成了共识。
热烈.en: We had a heated discussion and finally reached a consensus.

热烈.zh: 他在台上演讲，台下响起了热烈的掌声。
热烈.en: He was giving a speech on stage, and warm applause erupted from the audience.

热烈.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但现场的气氛非常热烈。
热烈.en: Although the weather was very cold, the atmosphere at the scene was very warm and lively.

吨.en: This truck can carry two tons of goods.

吨.zh: 我们每个月要处理几十吨垃圾。
吨.en: We have to process dozens of tons of trash every month.

吨.zh: 这座桥的承重能力是十吨，不能超载。
吨.en: The load-bearing capacity of this bridge is ten tons; it cannot be overloaded.

吨.zh: 工厂每天消耗大约五吨水，数量很大。
吨.en: The factory consumes about five tons of water every day, which is a large amount.

吨.zh: 这批钢材重达一百吨，运输起来很麻烦。
吨.en: This batch of steel weighs a hundred tons and is very troublesome to transport.

居住.en: Which city do you live in?

居住.zh: 这里环境很好，适合长期居住。
居住.en: The environment here is very good, suitable for long-term residence.

居住.zh: 他在北京居住五年了，已经习惯了这里的生活。
居住.en: He has lived in Beijing for five years and is already used to life here.

居住.zh: 越来越多的年轻人选择在郊区居住，因为房价比较低。
居住.en: More and more young people choose to live in the suburbs because housing prices are lower.

居住.zh: 这个小区居住条件不错，有花园和健身房。
居住.en: This residential community has good living conditions, with a garden and a gym.

相似.en: The two of them really look alike.

相似.zh: 这两件衣服颜色很相似，但款式不同。
相似.en: These two pieces of clothing are similar in color but different in style.

相似.zh: 我们的想法很相似，所以合作起来很顺利。
相似.en: Our ideas are very similar, so it's easy to work together.

相似.zh: 虽然这两个词的意思相似，但用法不一样。
相似.en: Although the meanings of these two words are similar, their usage is different.

相似.zh: 这家餐厅的菜和那家很相似，但价格便宜不少。
相似.en: The dishes at this restaurant are very similar to that one's, but the price is much cheaper.

担任.en: He has served as class monitor for two years.

担任.zh: 这次活动由我担任主持人。
担任.en: I am serving as the host for this event.

担任.zh: 她担任财务主管后，公司的账目清楚多了。
担任.en: After she took on the role of finance manager, the company's accounts became much clearer.

担任.zh: 他在公司担任项目经理，负责好几个大项目。
担任.en: He works as a project manager at the company, responsible for several big projects.

担任.zh: 虽然担任这个职位压力很大，但他做得非常好。
担任.en: Although taking on this position comes with a lot of pressure, he is doing an excellent job.

广.en: This square has a lot of people.

广.zh: 广告打得太广了，全城都看到了。
广.en: The advertisement was so widespread that the whole city saw it.

广.zh: 虽然地方不大，但用途很广。
广.en: Although the place is small, its uses are wide.

广.zh: 这部电影受众很广，从小孩到老人都喜欢。
广.en: This movie has a wide audience, from children to the elderly all like it.

宿舍.en: I need to go back to the dorm to get something.
Four people live in the dorm.

宿舍.zh: 因为宿舍太吵，我去图书馆学习了。
宿舍.en: Because the dorm was too noisy, I went to the library to study.

宿舍.zh: 我们宿舍楼下有个小卖部。
宿舍.en: There's a small shop downstairs in our dorm building.

宿舍.zh: 新宿舍楼的设施比旧的好很多。
宿舍.en: The facilities in the new dorm building are much better than the old one.

线路.en: This bus route is very convenient.
Subway Line 1 is the longest route.

线路.zh: 如果修路的话，这条线路会临时改道。
线路.en: If there is road construction, this line will be temporarily rerouted.

线路.zh: 旅游线路设计得很合理，景点都连在一起。
线路.en: The tour route is well designed, with all the attractions connected.

线路.zh: 电路线路老化，需要全部更换。
线路.en: The electrical circuits are aging and need to be completely replaced.

沉.en: The stone sank to the bottom of the water.

沉.zh: 他心情很沉，一句话也不说。
沉.en: He is in a heavy mood and doesn't say a word.

沉.zh: 虽然书包很沉，但他还是坚持自己背。
沉.en: Although the backpack is very heavy, he still insists on carrying it himself.

沉.zh: 太阳快落山了，天边沉下一片红霞。
沉.en: The sun is about to set, and a rosy glow sinks at the horizon.

善良.en: One should be a little kind as a person.

善良.zh: 虽然他外表很凶，但其实内心很善良。
善良.en: Although he looks fierce on the outside, he is actually very kind inside.

善良.zh: 邻居阿姨特别善良，经常帮助流浪猫。
善良.en: The aunt next door is especially kind and often helps stray cats.

善良.zh: 善良的人总会得到好报，我相信这一点。
善良.en: Kind people will always be rewarded, I believe that.

可靠.zh: 这个牌子的手机质量可靠。
可靠.en: The quality of this brand of phone is reliable.

可靠.zh: 因为数据来源可靠，所以结论没有问题。
可靠.en: Because the data source is reliable, the conclusion is fine.

可靠.zh: 他做事一直很可靠，你可以放心交给他。
可靠.en: He has always been reliable in doing things, you can trust him with it.

可靠.zh: 我觉得这种保险产品不太可靠，要小心。
可靠.en: I think this insurance product is not very reliable, be careful.

其余.en: The rest of the people wait a moment.

其余.zh: 这本书你拿走吧，其余的明天再说。
其余.en: Take this book, we'll talk about the rest tomorrow.

其余.zh: 我只点了两道菜，其余的都是他点的。
其余.en: I only ordered two dishes, the rest were ordered by him.

其余.zh: 其余的问题我们开会时再讨论。
其余.en: We'll discuss the rest of the issues during the meeting.

其余.zh: 除了这个颜色，其余的颜色我都不喜欢。
其余.en: Except for this color, I don't like the rest.

规模.en: This event is large in scale.
The company expanded its production scale.

规模.zh: 小镇的规模不大，但很热闹。
规模.en: The town is not large in scale, but it's very lively.

规模.zh: 因为资金有限，我们只能缩小项目规模。
规模.en: Due to limited funds, we can only reduce the project scale.

规模.zh: 这次地震的规模比预想的要大得多。
规模.en: The scale of this earthquake was much larger than expected.

决心.en: I am determined to run every day.
He is determined to learn Chinese well.

决心.zh: 虽然困难很多，但她决心不放弃。
决心.en: Although there are many difficulties, she is determined not to give up.

决心.zh: 下定决心后，事情反而简单了。
决心.en: After making up my mind, things actually became simpler.

决心.zh: 只要有决心，没有什么做不成的事。
决心.en: As long as you have determination, there is nothing you can't accomplish.

乡村.en: We went hiking in the countryside on the weekend.

乡村.zh: 乡村的空气比城市好太多了。
乡村.en: The air in the countryside is much better than in the city.

乡村.zh: 虽然乡村交通不方便，但环境很优美。
乡村.en: Although the countryside is not convenient for transportation, the environment is beautiful.

乡村.zh: 每年暑假他都回乡村看望爷爷奶奶。
乡村.en: Every summer vacation he goes back to the countryside to visit his grandparents.

忍不住.zh: 看到好吃的，他忍不住流口水。
忍不住.en: Seeing delicious food, he couldn't help drooling.

忍不住.zh: 虽然知道不该吃，但我还是忍不住尝了一口。
忍不住.en: Although I knew I shouldn't eat, I still couldn't resist taking a bite.

忍不住.zh: 她听到那个消息后，忍不住哭了起来。
忍不住.en: After hearing the news, she couldn't help crying.

忍不住.zh: 每次看到小狗，我忍不住想摸它。
忍不住.en: Every time I see a puppy, I can't help wanting to pet it.

捡.en: He picked up a dollar on the ground.

捡.zh: 我在公园里捡到一只小鸟。
捡.en: I found a little bird in the park.

捡.zh: 如果你看到垃圾，请把它捡起来。
捡.en: If you see trash, please pick it up.

捡.zh: 她捡起地上的书，放回书架。
捡.en: She picked up the book from the floor and put it back on the shelf.

捡.zh: 昨天我捡到一个钱包，交给了警察。
捡.en: Yesterday I picked up a wallet and handed it to the police.

蔬菜.en: Mom told me to eat more vegetables.
The vegetables in the supermarket are very fresh.

蔬菜.zh: 为了健康，每天都要吃足够的蔬菜。
蔬菜.en: For health, you need to eat enough vegetables every day.

蔬菜.zh: 今天的晚餐有蔬菜沙拉和烤鸡。
蔬菜.en: Today's dinner has vegetable salad and grilled chicken.

哪怕.en: Even if it rains, I'll still go.

哪怕.zh: 哪怕再苦再累，他都不放弃。
哪怕.en: Even if it's hard and tiring, he doesn't give up.

哪怕.zh: 哪怕只有一点点希望，我们也要试试。
哪怕.en: Even if there's only a little hope, we should try.

哪怕.zh: 哪怕你不喜欢，也得吃完。
哪怕.en: Even if you don't like it, you have to finish eating.

哪怕.zh: 哪怕工作很忙，他还是抽时间锻炼。
哪怕.en: Even if work is very busy, he still makes time to exercise.

补充.zh: 饭后可以吃水果补充维生素。
补充.en: After meals, you can eat fruit to supplement vitamins.

补充.zh: 老师让我们补充一些细节。
补充.en: The teacher asked us to add some details.

补充.zh: 除了主食，还要补充蛋白质和蔬菜。
补充.en: Besides staple food, you also need to supplement protein and vegetables.

伙.en: They are in the same group.
We partnered to open a shop.

伙.zh: 他伙同几个朋友一起去了。
伙.en: He went together with a few friends.

伙.zh: 公司伙食很好，每天都换花样。
伙.en: The company meals are very good, changing every day.
The police caught that group of thieves.

最初.en: At first I didn't like him.
The initial plan was very simple.

最初.zh: 他最初想学画画，后来改了主意。
最初.en: At first he wanted to learn painting, but later changed his mind.
At first we weren't very familiar.

最初.zh: 虽然最初很困难，但最后成功了。
最初.en: Although it was very difficult at first, we succeeded in the end.

克服.zh: 只要努力，就能克服一切。
克服.en: As long as you work hard, you can overcome everything.

克服.zh: 她克服了害羞，上台演讲。
克服.en: She overcame her shyness and gave a speech on stage.

克服.zh: 我们共同克服了这次危机。

薄.en: He has a thin skin and is easily embarrassed.

薄.zh: 今天天气冷，多穿点，别穿太薄。
薄.en: It's cold today, wear more, don't wear too thin.

装修.en: Renovating a house is very troublesome.

装修.zh: 他们准备下个月装修厨房。
装修.en: They plan to renovate the kitchen next month.

装修.zh: 装修的时候要注意安全问题。
装修.en: During renovation, you need to pay attention to safety.

装修.zh: 邻居家装修太吵了，我受不了。
装修.en: The neighbor's renovation is too noisy, I can't stand it.

填.en: He filled out the registration form and left.

填.zh: 这个坑需要填土才能走路。
填.en: This hole needs to be filled with dirt before we can walk.

填.zh: 先填好个人信息，再提交申请。
填.en: First fill in your personal information, then submit the application.

填.zh: 我昨天填了问卷，但是忘了提交。
填.en: I filled out the survey yesterday, but forgot to submit it.

成分.en: The ingredients of this drink include sugar.
Look at the ingredient list before buying.
The ingredients of this medicine are very safe.

成分.zh: 我不清楚这个食品的成分是什么。
成分.en: I'm not sure what the ingredients of this food are.

成分.zh: 虽然成分都一样，但是味道不同。
成分.en: Although the ingredients are the same, the taste is different.

同一.en: We live in the same building.
These two clothes are the same style.
They come from the same school.

同一.zh: 虽然名字不同，但是他们是同一人。
同一.en: Although the names are different, they are the same person.

同一.zh: 同一件事，每个人看法不一样。
同一.en: Everyone has a different opinion about the same thing.

召开.en: A meeting will be held tomorrow.
The company will hold its annual meeting next week.
The school held a parent-teacher meeting.

召开.zh: 这次会议是由他主持召开。
召开.en: This meeting was chaired and convened by him.

召开.zh: 因为疫情，会议改为线上召开。
召开.en: Because of the pandemic, the meeting was changed to being held online.

有限.zh: 超市的优惠时间是有限的。
有限.en: The supermarket's promotion period is limited.

有限.zh: 虽然能力有限，但我会尽力。
有限.en: Although my ability is limited, I will do my best.

有限.zh: 你的选择有限，只能选一个。
有限.en: Your choices are limited; you can only pick one.

代替.zh: 他生病了，我代替他上班。
代替.en: He is sick, so I'm covering his shift.
No one can replace your position.

代替.zh: 虽然我不想去，但只能代替他。
代替.en: Although I don't want to go, I have to fill in for him.

过于.zh: 过于自信反而容易出错。
过于.en: Being overconfident actually makes it easy to make mistakes.

过于.zh: 我觉得这个要求过于严格了。
过于.en: I think this requirement is too strict.

有利.en: Going to bed early and waking up early is good for health.

有利.zh: 下雨对比赛不利，对我们有利。
有利.en: Rain is bad for the game, but good for us.

有利.zh: 选择有利的条件能提高成功率。
有利.en: Choosing favorable conditions can increase the success rate.

有利.zh: 虽然短期看有利，但长期不行。
有利.en: Although it looks good in the short term, it won't work in the long run.

博物馆.en: Let's go to the museum tomorrow.

博物馆.zh: 这个博物馆有很多展品。
我上次去博物馆看到了恐龙化石。
博物馆.en: Last time I went to the museum, I saw dinosaur fossils.

博物馆.zh: 虽然博物馆很大，但半天就能逛完。
博物馆.en: Although the museum is very big, you can finish visiting it in half a day.

热爱.en: She has loved painting since she was a child.

热爱.zh: 虽然辛苦，但她热爱这份工作。
热爱.en: Although it's hard, she loves this job.

体现.zh: 他的做法体现了团队合作的重要性。
体现.en: His approach reflects the importance of teamwork.

体现.zh: 这件艺术品体现了东方美学。
通过这个活动，我们体现了对社区的关爱。
体现.en: Through this activity, we demonstrated care for the community.

体现.zh: 这部电影不仅有趣，还体现了深刻的社会问题。
体现.en: This movie is not only fun but also reflects deep social issues.

体现.zh: 他的笑容体现了内心的快乐。

生长.zh: 这个地区生长着许多稀有植物。
生长.en: Many rare plants grow in this area.

生长.zh: 孩子的生长需要充足的营养和睡眠。
生长.en: A child's growth needs adequate nutrition and sleep.

生长.zh: 因为气候温暖，这里的竹子生长得非常茂盛。
生长.en: Because the climate is warm, the bamboo here grows very lush.

生长.zh: 他从小生长在海边，所以很会游泳。
生长.en: He grew up by the sea, so he is good at swimming.

完了.en: The exam is over, we are on break.

完了.zh: 电影完了，大家开始鼓掌。
完了.en: The movie ended, everyone started clapping.

完了.zh: 等事情完了，我们再讨论。
完了.en: We'll discuss it after the matter is settled.

完了.zh: 完了，我把钥匙忘在车上了！
完了.en: Oh no, I left my keys in the car!

完了.zh: 他叹了口气说：“这下全完了。”
完了.en: He sighed and said, 'It's all over now.'

论文.zh: 这篇论文的主题很有意义。
论文.en: The topic of this paper is very meaningful.

论文.zh: 他正在准备毕业论文的答辩。
论文.en: He is preparing for his thesis defense.

论文.zh: 因为时间不够，他的论文只写了一部分。
论文.en: Because of time constraints, he only wrote part of his paper.

论文.zh: 教授对我的论文提出了很多修改意见。
论文.en: The professor gave a lot of revision suggestions on my paper.

半夜.en: He didn't come home until midnight.
It suddenly started raining heavily in the middle of the night.
I was woken up by noise in the middle of the night.

半夜.zh: 他经常工作到半夜才睡觉。
半夜.en: He often works until midnight before going to sleep.

半夜.zh: 昨天晚上半夜，我听到有人敲门。
半夜.en: Last night in the middle of the night, I heard someone knocking.

特色.zh: 这家店的食物很有特色。
特色.en: The food at this restaurant is very distinctive.

特色.zh: 每个地方都有自己独特的特色。
特色.en: Every place has its own unique characteristics.

特色.zh: 这个城市的建筑特色很吸引人。
特色.en: The architectural features of this city are very appealing.

特色.zh: 他们的服务没有特色，客人很少。
特色.en: Their service lacks features, so they have few customers.

特色.zh: 这道菜是餐厅的特色菜，你一定要尝尝。
特色.en: This dish is the restaurant's specialty, you must try it.

用户.zh: 我们需要听取用户的意见。
用户.en: We need to listen to user feedback.

用户.zh: 用户反馈说这个功能很好用。
用户.en: Users reported that this feature works well.

用户.zh: 为了提高用户体验，我们改进了界面。
用户.en: To improve user experience, we improved the interface.

用户.zh: 新版本增加了用户喜欢的几个功能。
用户.en: The new version added several features that users like.

从而.zh: 他努力学习，从而取得了好成绩。
从而.en: He studied hard, thereby achieving good grades.

从而.zh: 公司降低了成本，从而提高了利润。
从而.en: The company reduced costs, thus increasing profits.

从而.zh: 多读书可以开阔眼界，从而提升自己。
从而.en: Reading more can broaden your horizons, thereby improving yourself.

从而.zh: 他坚持锻炼，从而身体越来越好。
从而.en: He kept exercising, so his health got better and better.

从而.zh: 通过这次合作，我们建立了信任，从而实现了双赢。
从而.en: Through this cooperation, we built trust, thereby achieving a win-win.

整体.zh: 整体来看，这次活动很成功。
整体.en: Overall, this event was very successful.
The company's overall performance is good.

整体.zh: 我们需要从整体上考虑问题。
整体.en: We need to consider the problem from an overall perspective.

整体.zh: 这个方案的整体设计很合理。
整体.en: The overall design of this plan is very reasonable.

整体.zh: 虽然有些小问题，但整体效果很好。
整体.en: Although there are some minor issues, the overall effect is very good.

综合.zh: 综合来看，这个方案可行。
综合.en: Comprehensively speaking, this plan is feasible.

综合.zh: 这份报告综合了各方意见。
综合.en: This report synthesizes opinions from all sides.

综合.zh: 他的成绩是综合评定的。
我们需要综合考虑到所有因素。
综合.en: We need to take all factors into comprehensive consideration.

综合.zh: 这个学校提供综合性的教育服务。
综合.en: This school provides comprehensive educational services.

形容.zh: 他形容那部电影很感人。
形容.en: He described that movie as very moving.

形容.zh: 这个词形容天气非常好。
形容.en: This word describes the weather as very good.

形容.zh: 她总是用夸张的话形容自己。
形容.en: She always uses exaggerated words to describe herself.

形容.zh: 我不知道怎么形容那种感觉，真的很奇妙。
形容.en: I don't know how to describe that feeling; it's really amazing.

形容.zh: 虽然很难形容，但我还是想试试。
形容.en: Although it's hard to describe, I still want to try.

列车.zh: 列车上的乘客都安静下来了。
列车.en: The passengers on the train quieted down.

列车.zh: 因为天气原因，列车晚点了两个小时。
列车.en: Due to weather, the train was delayed by two hours.

列车.zh: 我每天坐列车上下班，已经习惯了。
列车.en: I take the train to and from work every day, and I'm used to it.

吸收.zh: 这个海绵吸收了很多水。
吸收.en: This sponge absorbed a lot of water.

吸收.zh: 孩子容易吸收新的知识。
皮肤能吸收护肤品里的营养。
吸收.en: Skin can absorb nutrients from skincare products.

吸收.zh: 公司需要吸收更多优秀的人才来发展。
吸收.en: The company needs to absorb more excellent talents to develop.

迎接.en: We went to the airport to welcome the guests.

迎接.zh: 他们准备好迎接挑战了。
迎接.en: They are ready to face the challenge.

迎接.zh: 学校举行了活动迎接新生。
迎接.en: The school held an event to welcome new students.

迎接.zh: 虽然很紧张，但我还是微笑着迎接考试。
迎接.en: Although I was nervous, I still smiled to face the exam.

改进.zh: 我们改进了产品的设计。
经过改进，机器效率更高了。
改进.en: After improvement, the machine is more efficient.

改进.zh: 老师建议我改进写作的方式。
改进.en: The teacher suggested I improve my writing style.

改进.zh: 如果你发现问题，请提出来一起改进。
改进.en: If you find any problems, please raise them so we can improve together.

舒适.zh: 穿一双舒适的鞋很重要。
舒适.en: Wearing a pair of comfortable shoes is important.

舒适.zh: 这家酒店的床特别舒适，我睡得很好。
舒适.en: The bed in this hotel is especially comfortable; I slept very well.

舒适.zh: 为了更舒适地工作，我换了新的办公椅。
舒适.en: To work more comfortably, I changed to a new office chair.

建设.en: They are responsible for road construction.

建设.zh: 建设一个美好的社区需要大家努力。
建设.en: Building a beautiful community requires everyone's effort.

建设.zh: 政府投资了很多钱用于环保建设。
建设.en: The government invested a lot of money in environmental construction.

建设.zh: 除了硬件设施，文化建设也很重要。
建设.en: Besides hardware facilities, cultural construction is also important.

文学.en: This book is a literary classic.

文学.zh: 文学课教我们分析小说。
文学.en: Literature class teaches us to analyze novels.

文学.zh: 她在大学主修中国文学。
文学.en: She majored in Chinese literature at university.

文学.zh: 虽然我不懂文学，但我觉得这首诗很美。
文学.en: Although I don't understand literature, I think this poem is beautiful.

美味.en: The food my mom cooks is delicious.

美味.zh: 这家餐厅的汤特别美味。
美味.en: The soup at this restaurant is especially delicious.

美味.zh: 我们吃了一顿美味的晚餐。
虽然看起来很普通，但味道却非常美味。
美味.en: Although it looks ordinary, the taste is very delicious.

仿佛.en: He seemed to know the answer.

仿佛.zh: 听到这首歌，仿佛又回到了从前。
仿佛.en: Hearing this song, it felt like returning to the past.

仿佛.zh: 虽然不认识，但仿佛是老朋友一样亲切。
仿佛.en: Although we don't know each other, it feels as warm as meeting an old friend.

不利.zh: 天气不好对我们很不利。
不利.en: Bad weather is very unfavorable for us.

不利.zh: 这个位置虽然便宜，但交通有点不利。
不利.en: This location is cheap, but the transportation is a bit inconvenient.

不利.zh: 比赛刚开始就落后，局面很不不利。
不利.en: Falling behind at the start of the game, the situation is very disadvantageous.

不利.zh: 如果现在取消订单，对我们双方都不利。
不利.en: If we cancel the order now, it will be unfavorable for both sides.

不利.zh: 他说话太直接，反而给自己造成了不利影响。
不利.en: He spoke too directly, which instead caused adverse effects for himself.

漏.en: The water pipe is leaking, call someone to fix it quickly.
He accidentally let the secret slip while talking.

漏.zh: 检查了好几遍，还是漏了一个字。
漏.en: I checked several times, but still missed one character.

漏.zh: 昨天大雨，屋顶漏了好多水。
漏.en: Yesterday's heavy rain caused the roof to leak a lot of water.

漏.zh: 名单上漏了我的名字，所以没收到通知。
漏.en: My name was left out of the list, so I didn't receive the notice.

难度.zh: 你要根据自己水平选择难度。
难度.en: You should choose the difficulty level based on your own ability.

难度.zh: 虽然动作看起来简单，但其实难度很高。
难度.en: Although the movement looks simple, it's actually very difficult.

难度.zh: 这个游戏的难度可以自己调，新手也能玩。
难度.en: The difficulty of this game can be adjusted, so beginners can play too.

难度.zh: 爬山最难的其实是最后一段，难度突然增加了。
难度.en: The hardest part of hiking is actually the last section, where the difficulty suddenly increases.

铁路.zh: 这条铁路连接了两个城市。

铁路.en: Taking the railway is much faster than driving.

铁路.zh: 新的铁路明年才能通车。
铁路.en: The new railway won't open to traffic until next year.

铁路.zh: 铁路两边种了很多树，风景不错。
铁路.en: Many trees are planted on both sides of the railway, and the scenery is nice.

铁路.zh: 因为铁路施工，这条路被封了。
铁路.en: This road is closed because of railway construction.

向前.en: Everyone please take a step forward.

向前.zh: 不管多难，我们都要向前看。
向前.en: No matter how hard it is, we must look forward.

向前.zh: 他鼓励我勇敢向前，不要害怕失败。
向前.en: He encouraged me to move forward bravely and not be afraid of failure.

向前.zh: 车子突然向前冲了一下，吓了我一跳。
向前.en: The car suddenly lurched forward and startled me.

向前.zh: 只要一直向前，总有一天会到达终点。
向前.en: As long as you keep moving forward, you will reach the finish line one day.

一下子.zh: 听到消息，他一下子愣住了。
一下子.en: Upon hearing the news, he was stunned for a moment.

一下子.zh: 天气一下子变冷了，记得加衣服。
一下子.en: The weather suddenly turned cold, remember to put on more clothes.

一下子.zh: 这个问题太难了，我一下子答不上来。
一下子.en: This question is too hard, I can't answer it right away.

一下子.zh: 他跑得太快，我一下子没反应过来。
一下子.en: He ran so fast that I didn't react in time.

一下子.zh: 别一下子吃太多，要慢慢来。
一下子.en: Don't eat too much all at once, take it slowly.

目光.zh: 所有人的目光都集中在她身上。
目光.en: Everyone's eyes were focused on her.

目光.zh: 一个人要有长远的目光，不能只看眼前。
目光.en: A person should have far-sighted vision, not just look at the immediate.

目光.zh: 她目光扫过房间，没有发现异常。
目光.en: Her gaze swept across the room and found nothing unusual.

目光.zh: 面对质疑，他始终保持着平静的目光。
目光.en: Facing doubts, he maintained a calm gaze throughout.

雾.en: It was very foggy this morning.
The fog cleared and the sun came out.

雾.zh: 开车遇到大雾一定要开雾灯。
雾.en: When driving in heavy fog, you must turn on the fog lights.

雾.zh: 山里的雾特别美，像仙境一样。
雾.en: The fog in the mountains is especially beautiful, like a fairyland.

雾.zh: 因为雾太大，飞机晚点了两个小时。
雾.en: Because the fog was too thick, the flight was delayed by two hours.

伸.zh: 把胳膊伸出来，量一下血压。
伸.en: Stretch out your arm, let me take your blood pressure.

伸.zh: 他伸了个懒腰，然后继续工作。
伸.en: He stretched and then continued working.

伸.zh: 小猫伸爪子去够桌上的鱼。
伸.en: The kitten stretched its paw to reach the fish on the table.

伸.zh: 别把手伸到窗外去，危险。
伸.en: Don't reach your hand out of the window, it's dangerous.

伸.zh: 他伸手想扶我，但我自己站起来了。
伸.en: He reached out his hand to help me, but I stood up on my own.

有力.zh: 你需要提供有力的证据。
有力.en: You need to provide strong evidence.

有力.zh: 他握了握我的手，非常有力。
有力.en: He shook my hand, and it was very firm.

有力.zh: 这个理由不够有力，说服不了别人。
有力.en: This reason is not strong enough to convince others.

有力.zh: 在辩论中，他用了几个有力的例子来支持自己的观点。
有力.en: In the debate, he used several powerful examples to support his point.

穷.zh: 虽然我家以前很穷，但父母还是供我上了大学。
穷.en: Although my family was poor before, my parents still supported me through college.

穷.zh: 穷没关系，只要努力就行。
穷.en: Being poor doesn't matter, as long as you work hard.

穷.zh: 那些穷孩子连书都买不起。
穷.en: Those poor children can't even afford books.

穷.zh: 他不想再这么穷下去了。
穷.en: He doesn't want to stay poor like this anymore.

尽可能.en: Please come as early as possible.
I will help you as much as I can.

尽可能.zh: 出门前尽可能检查一下行李。
尽可能.en: Check your luggage as much as possible before leaving.

尽可能.zh: 为了健康，我们要尽可能少吃垃圾食品。
尽可能.en: For health, we should eat as little junk food as possible.

尽可能.zh: 她尽可能多地参加公益活动。
尽可能.en: She participates in as many charity events as possible.

奋斗.en: He has been striving for his dream.

奋斗.zh: 虽然很累，但我们还要继续奋斗。
奋斗.en: Even though we're tired, we still have to keep striving.

奋斗.zh: 年轻人就该为自己的未来奋斗。
奋斗.en: Young people should strive for their own future.

奋斗.zh: 经过多年奋斗，他终于成功了。
奋斗.en: After years of struggle, he finally succeeded.

奋斗.zh: 我不怕吃苦，只怕没有奋斗的目标。
奋斗.en: I'm not afraid of hardship, just afraid of having no goal to strive for.

约定.zh: 既然有了约定，就要遵守。
约定.en: Since we made a promise, we should keep it.

约定.zh: 他和朋友约定一起去看电影。
约定.en: He and his friend agreed to go see a movie together.

约定.zh: 按照约定，他应该付一半的钱。
约定.en: According to the agreement, he should pay half the money.

技能.en: This skill is hard to learn.

技能.zh: 他掌握了很多实用技能。
技能.en: He has mastered many practical skills.

技能.zh: 学一门技能对找工作很有帮助。
技能.en: Learning a skill is very helpful for finding a job.

技能.zh: 除了专业技能，沟通能力也很重要。
技能.en: Besides professional skills, communication skills are also important.

技能.zh: 公司定期给员工培训新技能。
技能.en: The company regularly trains employees in new skills.

消费.zh: 现在的年轻人消费观念不一样。
消费.en: Young people nowadays have different consumption concepts.

消费.zh: 网上消费越来越方便了。
消费.en: Online shopping is becoming more and more convenient.

消费.zh: 他每个月消费很高，存不下钱。
消费.en: He spends a lot every month and can't save money.

消费.zh: 为了减少消费，我开始记账了。
消费.en: To reduce spending, I started keeping track of expenses.

实行.zh: 这个计划从下个月开始实行。
实行.en: This plan will be implemented starting next month.

实行.zh: 公司要实行新的考勤制度。
实行.en: The company is going to implement a new attendance system.

实行.zh: 如果实行这个方案，成本会降低很多。
实行.en: If this plan is implemented, costs will be greatly reduced.

实行.zh: 学校实行了新的课程安排。
实行.en: The school has implemented a new course schedule.

实行.zh: 政策实行后，效果很明显。
实行.en: After the policy was implemented, the effect was very noticeable.

打扮.en: She dressed up very beautifully today.
Dress up nicely before going out.

打扮.zh: 他不喜欢穿得太正式，喜欢随便打扮。
打扮.en: He doesn't like to dress too formally; he prefers casual dressing.

打扮.zh: 为了参加婚礼，她打扮了两个小时。
打扮.en: She spent two hours dressing up for the wedding.

打扮.zh: 虽然打扮很重要，但内在美更关键。
打扮.en: Although dressing up is important, inner beauty is more critical.

乐趣.en: Reading has a lot of fun.

乐趣.zh: 工作的乐趣在于解决问题。
乐趣.en: The fun of work lies in solving problems.

乐趣.zh: 生活中到处都有乐趣，关键要用心发现。
乐趣.en: There is fun everywhere in life; the key is to discover it with your heart.

乐趣.zh: 旅游带给我的乐趣太多了。
乐趣.en: Traveling brings me so much joy.

乐趣.zh: 和他在一起，我总能找到乐趣。
乐趣.en: With him, I can always find fun.

知名.zh: 这家酒店在当地非常知名。
知名.en: This hotel is very famous locally.

知名.zh: 她因为出演那部电影而变得知名。
知名.en: She became famous because of acting in that movie.

知名.zh: 虽然产品很知名，但价格有点贵。
知名.en: Although the product is well-known, the price is a bit expensive.

兔.en: I was born in the Year of the Rabbit, and you?

兔.zh: 兔肉我很少吃，因为觉得太瘦了。
兔.en: I rarely eat rabbit meat because I find it too lean.

兔.zh: 小朋友养了一只小白兔，天天给它喂胡萝卜。
兔.en: The kid keeps a little white rabbit and feeds it carrots every day.

兔.zh: 这只兔子跑得飞快，一眨眼就不见了。
兔.en: This rabbit runs so fast that it disappeared in a blink.

裁判.en: The referee blew the whistle and the game paused.

裁判.zh: 篮球裁判要眼疾手快，才能做出准确判罚。
裁判.en: A basketball referee must be sharp-eyed and quick to make accurate calls.

裁判.zh: 裁判宣布红方获胜，全场都沸腾了。
裁判.en: The referee announced the red side won, and the whole crowd went wild.

裁判.zh: 如果裁判没看到，那个动作其实犯规了。
裁判.en: If the referee hadn't seen it, that move was actually a foul.

从不.zh: 他工作很认真，从不马虎。
从不.en: He works very seriously and never slacks off.

从不.zh: 她虽然很忙，但从不对朋友爽约。
从不.en: Although she is very busy, she never stands up her friends.

从不.zh: 这家店的东西从不打折，但品质确实好。
从不.en: This store never has sales, but the quality is really good.

从不.zh: 我从小到大从不挑食，所以身体一直很好。
从不.en: I have never been a picky eater since I was a child, so I've always been healthy.

渐渐.zh: 随着天气变暖，樱花渐渐开了。
渐渐.en: As the weather warms up, the cherry blossoms are gradually blooming.

渐渐.zh: 我渐渐习惯了这里的生活，不再想家了。
渐渐.en: I'm gradually getting used to life here and don't miss home anymore.

渐渐.zh: 刚开始觉得很难，但坚持练习后渐渐就掌握了。
渐渐.en: At first it felt very hard, but after persistent practice, I gradually mastered it.

口味.zh: 我喜欢辣的口味，越辣越好。
口味.en: I like spicy flavors, the spicier the better.

口味.zh: 每个人的口味不同，很难让所有人都满意。
口味.en: Everyone has different tastes, so it's hard to please everyone.

口味.zh: 你尝尝这个新口味，我觉得比原来的好吃。
口味.en: Try this new flavor; I think it tastes better than the original.

口味.zh: 虽然我平时口味清淡，但偶尔也会想吃重口味的菜。
口味.en: Although I usually prefer light flavors, I occasionally crave strong-tasting dishes.

具备.zh: 这份工作要具备一定的经验。
具备.en: This job requires a certain amount of experience.

具备.zh: 成功的人通常都具备坚持和耐心。
具备.en: Successful people usually possess persistence and patience.

具备.zh: 这个房间不具备住人的条件，太潮湿了。
具备.en: This room doesn't have the conditions for living; it's too damp.

具备.zh: 如果想当领导，必须具备良好的沟通能力。
具备.en: If you want to be a leader, you must have good communication skills.

姿势.en: I changed my pose when taking the photo.

姿势.zh: 瑜伽老师教我们放松姿势。
姿势.en: The yoga teacher taught us a relaxing pose.

姿势.zh: 他跑步的姿势很标准，一看就是练过的。
姿势.en: His running form is very standard; you can tell he's trained.

姿势.zh: 长时间用错误的姿势看手机，脖子会疼。
姿势.en: Using the wrong posture to look at your phone for a long time will make your neck hurt.

增强.en: Exercising more can strengthen your physique.

增强.zh: 这次合作增强了我们的信心。
每天喝牛奶有助于增强骨骼健康。
增强.en: Drinking milk every day helps strengthen bone health.

增强.zh: 公司通过培训来增强员工的专业能力。
增强.en: The company enhances employees' professional skills through training.

增强.zh: 适当的休息不但不会浪费时间，反而能增强工作效率。
增强.en: Proper rest not only doesn't waste time but actually increases work efficiency.

谨慎.zh: 他说话很谨慎，从不乱讲。
谨慎.en: He speaks very cautiously and never says things carelessly.

谨慎.zh: 投资之前一定要谨慎考虑风险。
谨慎.en: You must carefully consider the risks before investing.

谨慎.zh: 虽然事情看起来很顺利，但我们还是得谨慎一点。
谨慎.en: Although things seem to be going smoothly, we still need to be cautious.

谨慎.zh: 她在网上买东西很谨慎，只选信誉好的店家。
谨慎.en: She is very cautious when shopping online, only choosing stores with good reputations.

握.en: He gripped the steering wheel tightly.

握.zh: 小朋友握着笔，认真地写字。
握.en: The kid held the pen and wrote carefully.

握.zh: 握手的时候要稍微用力，不然显得没诚意。
握.en: When shaking hands, you should apply a little force, or it seems insincere.

握.zh: 他握着我的手说谢谢，眼里闪着泪光。
握.en: He held my hand and said thank you, with tears in his eyes.

尽力.zh: 虽然很难，但我会尽力完成。
尽力.en: Although it's hard, I will try my best to finish it.

尽力.zh: 他尽力跑了，但还是没追上。
尽力.en: He ran as hard as he could, but still didn't catch up.

尽力.zh: 你只要尽力就好，结果不重要。
尽力.en: Just do your best, the result doesn't matter.

尽力.zh: 为了这次考试，我尽力复习了一个月。
尽力.en: For this exam, I did my best to review for a whole month.

陌生.zh: 虽然都是陌生人，但他一点也不紧张。
陌生.en: Although they were all strangers, he wasn't nervous at all.

陌生.zh: 第一次去陌生城市，我有点害怕。
陌生.en: Going to a strange city for the first time, I'm a bit scared.

陌生.zh: 她很快就和陌生人都聊起来了。
陌生.en: She quickly started chatting with strangers.

陌生.zh: 因为周围都是陌生面孔，我找不到一个认识的人。
陌生.en: Because all the faces around me were unfamiliar, I couldn't find anyone I knew.

新娘.en: The bride is really beautiful today.

新娘.zh: 新郎和新娘正在台上跳舞。
新娘.en: The groom and the bride are dancing on the stage.

新娘.zh: 大家都在等新娘扔捧花。
新娘.en: Everyone is waiting for the bride to throw the bouquet.

新娘.zh: 婚礼开始了，新娘慢慢走进来。
新娘.en: The wedding began, and the bride walked in slowly.

新娘.zh: 新娘笑得特别开心，因为她终于嫁给他了。
新娘.en: The bride smiled so happily because she finally married him.

车祸.zh: 他因为车祸住院了一个月。
车祸.en: He was hospitalized for a month because of a car accident.

车祸.zh: 昨天那场车祸没有人受伤，真是万幸。
车祸.en: No one got hurt in that car accident yesterday; it's really fortunate.

车祸.zh: 开车一定要小心，避免车祸。
车祸.en: You must drive carefully to avoid car accidents.

车祸.zh: 虽然车祸很严重，但他只受了点轻伤。
车祸.en: Although the car accident was severe, he only got minor injuries.

扶.en: Please help the old man up.

扶.zh: 他摔倒了，我赶紧去扶他。
扶.en: He fell down, and I quickly went to help him up.

扶.zh: 你帮我扶着梯子，我上去看看。
扶.en: You help me hold the ladder steady, and I'll go up and check.

扶.zh: 她扶着墙慢慢往前走，因为腿受伤了。
扶.en: She walked slowly leaning on the wall because her leg was injured.

扶.zh: 我扶着你走，别怕，路很滑。
扶.en: I'll hold you as we walk, don't worry, the road is slippery.

下载.zh: 这个软件可以免费下载。
下载.en: This software can be downloaded for free.

下载.zh: 因为网速太慢，下载了半天还没好。
下载.en: Because the internet is too slow, it's been downloading for a while and still not done.

下载.zh: 我下载了一个学习中文的App。
下载.en: I downloaded an app for learning Chinese.

下载.zh: 你先下载这个文件，然后打开看看。
下载.en: First download this file, then open it and take a look.

维修.zh: 电梯正在维修，请走楼梯。
维修.en: The elevator is under repair, please take the stairs.

维修.zh: 维修工人下午才能来，你要等一等。
维修.en: The repair worker can only come in the afternoon; you'll have to wait.

维修.zh: 因为空调坏了，我们叫了维修师傅。
维修.en: Because the air conditioner broke down, we called a repair technician.

维修.zh: 这辆车维修了好几次，还是有问题。
维修.en: This car has been repaired several times, but there are still problems.

整整.en: I waited a full two hours.
He hasn't been home for a whole year.

整整.zh: 为了写这篇报告，我花了整整三天。
整整.en: To write this report, I spent a full three days.

整整.zh: 虽然只迟到了五分钟，他却生气了整整一天。
整整.en: Although he was only five minutes late, he was angry for a whole day.

整整.zh: 这次旅行我们整整开了十个小时的车。
整整.en: On this trip, we drove for a full ten hours.

构成.zh: 水和氧气构成了生命的基本条件。
构成.en: Water and oxygen constitute the basic conditions for life.

构成.zh: 这个团队由五个不同国家的人构成。
构成.en: This team is made up of people from five different countries.

构成.zh: 虽然只是小误会，但已经构成了我们的矛盾。
构成.en: Although it's just a small misunderstanding, it has already caused conflict between us.

口袋.en: I have one yuan in my pocket.

口袋.zh: 他双手插在口袋里，看起来很酷。
口袋.en: He put his hands in his pockets and looked cool.

口袋.zh: 这件衣服的口袋太浅了，手机容易掉。
口袋.en: The pockets on this shirt are too shallow; the phone can easily fall out.

口袋.zh: 因为钱包被偷了，他口袋里一分钱都没有。
口袋.en: Because his wallet was stolen, he didn't have a single cent in his pocket.

口袋.zh: 你帮我从口袋里拿一下钥匙，我手不方便。
口袋.en: Help me take the keys out of my pocket; my hands are not free.

不良.zh: 由于不良天气，航班延误了。
不良.en: Due to bad weather, the flight was delayed.
This food is bad for health.

不良.zh: 如果你继续这样，可能会产生不良后果。
不良.en: If you continue like this, it may lead to adverse consequences.

不良.zh: 公司的不良资产被处理了。
不良.en: The company's non-performing assets were dealt with.

无限.zh: 无限流量套餐很受欢迎。
无限.en: Unlimited data plans are very popular.
My love for you is unlimited.

无限.zh: 这里的风景美得无限，让人舍不得离开。
无限.en: The scenery here is infinitely beautiful, making people reluctant to leave.

无限.zh: 只要努力，你的潜力就是无限的。
无限.en: As long as you work hard, your potential is unlimited.

发言.en: Please raise your hand to speak.

发言.zh: 他在会议上发言很精彩。
发言.en: His speech at the meeting was wonderful.
The teacher had students take turns speaking.
This opportunity to speak is rare.

真诚.zh: 我真诚地希望你能接受我的道歉。
真诚.en: I sincerely hope you can accept my apology.

真诚.zh: 因为她的真诚，大家都喜欢她。
真诚.en: Because of her sincerity, everyone likes her.

真诚.zh: 这份感谢是发自内心的真诚。
真诚.en: This gratitude is from the heart, sincere.

前来.zh: 他接到通知后立刻前来公司。
前来.en: After receiving the notice, he immediately came to the company.

前来.zh: 请各位准时前来参加活动。
前来.en: Please come on time to participate in the event.

前来.zh: 虽然路途遥远，他还是决定前来。
前来.en: Although the journey was long, he still decided to come.
She came specially to thank me.

平台.zh: 社交媒体是一个重要的交流平台。
平台.en: Social media is an important communication platform.

平台.zh: 他利用这个平台推广产品。
平台.en: He uses this platform to promote products.

平台.zh: 因为有了这个平台，我们才能合作。
平台.en: Because of this platform, we were able to cooperate.

平台.zh: 火车站的站台就是上下车的平台。
平台.en: The platform at the train station is where you get on and off.

依据.zh: 我们依据合同条款来处理这个问题。
依据.en: We handle this issue according to the contract terms.

依据.zh: 你的结论没有科学依据。
依据.en: Your conclusion has no scientific basis.

依据.zh: 虽然他没有直接证据，但依据经验判断。
依据.en: Although he has no direct evidence, he judged based on experience.
The legal basis must be clear.

挣.en: He earns money with great difficulty.

挣.zh: 她每个月挣的钱都寄给家里。
挣.en: She sends the money she earns every month to her family.

挣.zh: 虽然累，但为了养家他必须多挣点。
挣.en: Although tired, to support his family he must earn more.
He earns his living by writing.

观念.zh: 现在的年轻人观念和我们不一样。
观念.en: Young people today have different concepts from us.

观念.zh: 因为观念不同，他们经常吵架。
观念.en: Because of different concepts, they often quarrel.
The concept of environmental protection is becoming more widespread.

催.en: Don't urge me, I'll be ready soon.

催.zh: 老板一直在催我交报告。
催.en: The boss has been urging me to submit the report.
He urged several times but it was useless.

催.zh: 既然时间紧张，我们就互相催一下。
催.en: Since time is tight, let's urge each other.
The child urged mom to hurry up and leave.

大胆.zh: 他大胆地提出了不同意见。
大胆.en: He boldly raised a different opinion.
Do you dare to be a bit bolder?

大胆.zh: 虽然很危险，但他还是大胆尝试了。
大胆.en: Although it was dangerous, he still bravely tried.

大胆.zh: 这个设计师的大胆创意让人印象深刻。
大胆.en: This designer's bold creativity left a deep impression.

大胆.zh: 她大胆地拒绝了老板的不合理要求。
大胆.en: She boldly rejected the boss's unreasonable request.

改革.zh: 公司正在推行新的改革。
改革.en: The company is implementing new reforms.

改革.zh: 改革让我们的生活变得更好了。
改革.en: Reforms have made our lives better.

改革.zh: 教育改革需要家长和老师的配合。
改革.en: Education reform requires cooperation between parents and teachers.

改革.zh: 因为改革力度太大，很多人一时难以适应。
改革.en: Because the reforms were too strong, many people found it hard to adapt at first.

改革.zh: 这次经济改革给小企业带来了很多机会。
改革.en: This economic reform has brought many opportunities to small businesses.

嘴巴.en: You have a sweet mouth (you're flattering).

嘴巴.zh: 吃东西的时候别张着嘴巴。
嘴巴.en: Don't open your mouth when eating.

嘴巴.zh: 他嘴巴很严，从来不乱说话。
嘴巴.en: He is tight-lipped and never speaks carelessly.

嘴巴.zh: 感冒的时候嘴巴里总是没什么味道。
嘴巴.en: When you have a cold, your mouth always tastes bland.

留言.zh: 我不在的时候，你可以给我留言。
留言.en: When I'm not here, you can leave me a message.

留言.zh: 看到你的留言我马上就回了。
留言.en: I replied as soon as I saw your message.

留言.zh: 因为电话打不通，我就留了一条语音留言。
留言.en: Because the call wouldn't go through, I left a voice message.

告别.zh: 我跟朋友告别后就回家了。
告别.en: I said goodbye to my friend and went home.

告别.zh: 我们开了一个告别派对。
虽然很舍不得，但还是要好好告别。
告别.en: Although it's hard to let go, we still have to say a proper goodbye.

告别.zh: 他还没来得及告别就匆匆离开了。
告别.en: He left in a hurry before he could say goodbye.

秘书.en: My secretary is on leave today.

秘书.zh: 王秘书帮我安排了明天的会议。
秘书.en: Secretary Wang arranged tomorrow's meeting for me.

秘书.zh: 她当秘书已经五年了，经验很丰富。
秘书.en: She has been a secretary for five years and has a lot of experience.

秘书.zh: 因为秘书不在，我只好自己处理这些文件。
秘书.en: Since the secretary is not here, I have to handle these documents myself.

秘书.zh: 老板让秘书订两张去上海的机票。
秘书.en: The boss asked the secretary to book two plane tickets to Shanghai.

捐.zh: 很多人给灾区捐了衣物。
捐.en: Many people donated clothes to the disaster area.

捐.zh: 她决定捐出自己所有的零花钱。
捐.en: She decided to donate all her pocket money.

捐.zh: 虽然自己不富裕，但他还是坚持捐钱。
捐.en: Although he is not rich himself, he still insists on donating money.

捐.zh: 这次活动捐到的善款将用于学校的建设。
捐.en: The donations raised in this event will be used for school construction.

卧室.zh: 她喜欢把卧室布置得很温馨。
卧室.en: She likes to make her bedroom cozy.

卧室.zh: 卧室的窗户正对着花园。
卧室.en: The bedroom window faces the garden.

卧室.zh: 因为卧室太吵，我根本睡不着。
卧室.en: Because the bedroom was too noisy, I couldn't sleep at all.

卧室.zh: 他每天早上都在卧室里做十分钟的瑜伽。
卧室.en: He does ten minutes of yoga in his bedroom every morning.

众多.zh: 众多明星出席了这次活动。
面对众多选择，她不知道该怎么办。
众多.en: Faced with numerous choices, she didn't know what to do.

众多.zh: 这个问题引起了众多网友的关注。
众多.en: This issue has attracted the attention of numerous netizens.

众多.zh: 虽然困难众多，但我们还是坚持下来了。
众多.en: Although there were numerous difficulties, we still persevered.

失误.en: This mistake could have been avoided.

失误.zh: 他在比赛中出现了严重失误。
失误.en: He made a serious mistake during the competition.

失误.zh: 因为一个小小的失误，整个项目都失败了。
失误.en: Because of a small mistake, the whole project failed.

失误.zh: 失误不可怕，关键是要从中吸取教训。
失误.en: Mistakes are not scary; the key is to learn from them.

失误.zh: 他向客户道歉，承认了工作上的失误。
失误.en: He apologized to the client and admitted his mistake at work.

含量.zh: 这个饮料的糖含量很高。
含量.en: This drink has a high sugar content.

含量.zh: 我买酸奶时会看钙含量和蛋白质含量。
含量.en: When I buy yogurt, I look at the calcium and protein content.

含量.zh: 虽然这瓶果汁的维生素含量很高，但糖分也很多。
含量.en: Although this bottle of juice has high vitamin content, it also has a lot of sugar.

含量.zh: 这种食品的脂肪含量比较低。
含量.en: This type of food has relatively low fat content.

含量.zh: 你得注意食物中的盐含量。
含量.en: You need to pay attention to the salt content in food.

决不.en: He never goes back on his promises.

决不.zh: 我决不让你一个人去那么远的地方。
决不.en: I will never let you go to such a far place alone.

决不.zh: 虽然很难，但我决不退缩。
决不.en: Although it's hard, I will never back down.
We will never bow down to difficulties.

燃烧.zh: 这场大火燃烧了整整三天。
燃烧.en: This big fire burned for three whole days.

燃烧.zh: 他心中的热情像火一样燃烧。
燃烧.en: The passion in his heart burns like fire.

燃烧.zh: 因为氧气不足，火焰燃烧得很慢。
燃烧.en: Because of insufficient oxygen, the flame burns very slowly.

燃烧.zh: 蜡烛燃烧时会产生光和热。
燃烧.en: When a candle burns, it produces light and heat.

反复.zh: 我反复看了好几遍才明白。
反复.en: I read it over and over several times before I understood.

反复.zh: 虽然老师反复强调，他还是记不住。
反复.en: Although the teacher emphasized repeatedly, he still couldn't remember.

反复.zh: 这个问题反复出现，需要解决。
反复.en: This problem keeps recurring and needs to be solved.

反复.zh: 她反复确认了时间才出门。
反复.en: She checked the time repeatedly before leaving.

牙齿.zh: 每天早晚都要认真刷牙齿。
牙齿.en: Brush your teeth carefully every morning and evening.
Eating too much sugar is bad for your teeth.

牙齿.zh: 如果你不刷牙，牙齿就会蛀掉。
牙齿.en: If you don't brush your teeth, they will decay.

牙齿.zh: 他摔了一跤，磕掉了一颗牙齿。
牙齿.en: He fell and knocked out a tooth.

极其.zh: 这个问题的答案极其复杂。
极其.en: The answer to this question is extremely complicated.

极其.zh: 虽然天气极其寒冷，他还是坚持跑步。
极其.en: Although the weather was extremely cold, he still insisted on running.

极其.zh: 他极其聪明，学什么都快。
极其.en: He is extremely smart and learns everything quickly.

极其.zh: 这部电影极其感人，我看哭了。
极其.en: This movie is extremely touching; I cried watching it.

尊敬.zh: 他是一个值得尊敬的长辈。
尊敬.en: He is an elder worthy of respect.

尊敬.zh: 因为他品德高尚，大家都尊敬他。
尊敬.en: Because of his noble character, everyone respects him.

尊敬.zh: 这位老师深受学生尊敬。
尊敬.en: This teacher is deeply respected by students.

包装.zh: 礼物的包装需要更精致一些。
包装.en: The gift wrapping needs to be more exquisite.

包装.zh: 虽然包装看起来很普通，里面却是好东西。
包装.en: Although the packaging looks ordinary, the inside is good stuff.
This packaging material is not environmentally friendly.

开通.zh: 你要开通手机国际漫游吗？
开通.en: Do you want to activate international roaming on your phone?

开通.zh: 因为他思想开通，所以很容易接受新事物。
开通.en: Because he is open-minded, he easily accepts new things.

开通.zh: 这条航线什么时候开通？
开通.en: When will this air route be opened?

宠物.zh: 很多家庭都把猫狗当宠物养。
宠物.en: Many families keep cats and dogs as pets.

宠物.zh: 虽然养宠物很麻烦，但能带来很多快乐。
宠物.en: Although keeping a pet is troublesome, it brings a lot of joy.

增.zh: 这个月收入增了不少，我很开心。
增.en: Income increased a lot this month, I'm very happy.

增.zh: 因为成本增了，所以东西都涨价了。
增.en: Because costs increased, everything has gone up in price.
Running more can strengthen the body.

增.zh: 公司增了很多人手，工作效率更高了。
增.en: The company added many staff, work efficiency is higher.

四处.zh: 小猫四处乱跑，我找不到它了。
四处.en: The kitten ran around everywhere, I can't find it.
Don't look around everywhere, focus on driving.

四处.zh: 虽然我四处打听，但还是没消息。
四处.en: Although I inquired everywhere, still no news.

四处.zh: 假期里我们四处旅游，玩得很开心。
四处.en: During the holiday we traveled around, had a lot of fun.

肩.zh: 这个任务落在我的肩上，压力很大。
肩.en: This task falls on my shoulders, heavy pressure.

肩.zh: 她扛着东西，肩膀都红了。
肩.en: She was carrying things, her shoulders are red.

肩.zh: 因为长期背重物，他的肩膀很疼。
肩.en: Because he carries heavy things for long, his shoulders hurt a lot.

同情.zh: 看到他的遭遇，大家都非常同情。
同情.en: Seeing his experience, everyone felt very sympathetic.

同情.zh: 别光同情，想想怎么帮忙。
同情.en: Don't just sympathize, think about how to help.

同情.zh: 虽然我同情他，但也不能一直帮他。
同情.en: Although I sympathize with him, I can't keep helping him.

同情.zh: 她总是同情别人，自己也挺累的。
同情.en: She always sympathizes with others, she herself is quite tired.

病情.zh: 医生说病情已经稳定，不用担心。
病情.en: The doctor says the condition is stable, no need to worry.

病情.zh: 病情突然恶化，得马上手术。
病情.en: The condition suddenly worsened, need surgery immediately.

病情.zh: 虽然病情严重，但他很乐观。
病情.en: Although the illness is serious, he is very optimistic.

病情.zh: 她每天记录病情，好让医生了解。
病情.en: She records her condition daily so the doctor can understand.

说不定.en: Bring an umbrella, maybe it will rain.
Give it a try, maybe you can succeed.

说不定.zh: 如果你努力，说不定就能考上。
说不定.en: If you work hard, maybe you can pass the exam.
Don't give up, maybe there's a turning point.

场所.zh: 我们需要找一个合适的场所聚会。
场所.en: We need to find a suitable place to gather.

场所.zh: 因为那里是危险场所，所以别去。
场所.en: Because that place is dangerous, so don't go.

场所.zh: 学校是学习的场所，不是玩的。
场所.en: School is a place for learning, not for playing.

挑选.zh: 她在商店里仔细挑选衣服。
挑选.en: She carefully selects clothes in the store.
Choosing gifts takes a lot of time.

挑选.zh: 虽然有很多选择，但很难挑选。
挑选.en: Although there are many choices, it's hard to choose.
The coach is selecting team members.

成本.zh: 公司要降低成本，才能多赚钱。
成本.en: The company needs to reduce costs to make more money.

成本.zh: 因为运输成本高，所以商品贵。
成本.en: Because transportation costs are high, so goods are expensive.

成本.zh: 他们想尽办法控制成本。
成本.en: They try every way to control costs.

亲人.zh: 过年时，亲人都聚在一起。
亲人.en: During New Year, family members gather together.

亲人.zh: 虽然工作忙，但要多陪亲人。
亲人.en: Although work is busy, spend more time with family.

亲人.zh: 我们要珍惜身边的亲人。
亲人.en: We should cherish the family around us.

处在.en: He is now in a difficult situation.

处在.zh: 因为经济不好，很多公司都处在亏损的状态。
处在.en: Because the economy is bad, many companies are in a state of loss.

处在.zh: 我们学校处在市中心，交通很方便。
处在.en: Our school is located in the city center, transportation is very convenient.

处在.zh: 他正处在人生的十字路口。
处在.en: He is at a crossroads in life.

处在.zh: 虽然处在逆境，但他从来没放弃过努力。
处在.en: Although in adversity, he never gave up effort.

早已.en: I have known about this for a long time.

早已.zh: 因为天气太热，河里的水早已干涸了。
早已.en: Because the weather was too hot, the water in the river had long dried up.

早已.zh: 他们的关系早已破裂，只是没公开而已。
早已.en: Their relationship has long broken down, just not made public.

早已.zh: 等你来的时候，他早已离开这个城市了。
早已.en: By the time you come, he will have already left this city.

睡眠.en: His sleep quality is very poor.

睡眠.zh: 如果睡眠不足，第二天就会没精神。
睡眠.en: If you don't get enough sleep, you'll be listless the next day.

睡眠.zh: 我昨天晚上睡眠特别好，一觉到天亮。
睡眠.en: I had a very good sleep last night, slept until dawn.
Sleep is very important for health.

睡眠.zh: 为了改善睡眠，她每天睡前都会喝杯牛奶。
睡眠.en: To improve sleep, she drinks a glass of milk every night before bed.

比例.en: This ratio is not very reasonable.

比例.zh: 在考试中，选择题的比例占百分之六十。
比例.en: In the exam, the proportion of multiple-choice questions is 60%.

比例.zh: 因为男女比例失调，很多男生找不到对象。
比例.en: Because the male-female ratio is imbalanced, many men can't find partners.

比例.zh: 水和面粉的比例是二比一。
比例.en: The ratio of water to flour is 2:1.

比例.zh: 我们要调整投资和消费的比例，让经济更平衡。
比例.en: We need to adjust the ratio of investment and consumption to make the economy more balanced.

输入.zh: 你需要输入用户名和密码才能登录。
输入.en: You need to enter username and password to log in.

输入.zh: 只要输入正确的验证码，就能完成支付。
输入.en: As long as you input the correct verification code, you can complete the payment.

输入.zh: 这个表格的数据已经输入了。
输入.en: The data for this form has been input.

输入.zh: 他花了一整天把所有的信息输入到电脑里。
输入.en: He spent a whole day inputting all the information into the computer.

灯光.en: The stage lighting is very beautiful.

灯光.zh: 晚上街道上灯光通明，行人很多。
灯光.en: At night the streets are brightly lit, with many pedestrians.

灯光.zh: 因为灯光太暗，我根本看不清书上的字。
灯光.en: Because the light was too dim, I couldn't see the words on the book at all.

灯光.zh: 灯光突然灭了，大家都吓了一跳。
灯光.en: The lights suddenly went out, everyone got a fright.

灯光.zh: 这家餐厅的灯光设计很有情调，适合约会。
灯光.en: The lighting design of this restaurant is very romantic, suitable for dates.

色彩.en: The colors of this painting are very vivid.

色彩.zh: 秋天的森林色彩丰富，有红有黄有绿。
色彩.en: The autumn forest has rich colors, red, yellow, and green.

色彩.zh: 虽然这件衣服色彩单调，但款式很时尚。
色彩.en: Although this clothes has monotonous colors, the style is very fashionable.

色彩.zh: 设计师用了很多明亮的色彩来装饰儿童房。
色彩.en: The designer used many bright colors to decorate the children's room.

紧紧.zh: 她紧紧跟在妈妈身后，害怕走丢了。
紧紧.en: She followed closely behind her mother, afraid of getting lost.

紧紧.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但他还是紧紧抱着那本书。
紧紧.en: Although it was very cold, he still tightly held that book.

紧紧.zh: 两个朋友紧紧拥抱在一起，好久没见面了。
紧紧.en: The two friends hugged each other tightly, hadn't seen each other for a long time.

劳动.zh: 他每天都要做体力劳动。
劳动.en: He does physical labor every day.

劳动.zh: 通过劳动，我们才能创造美好的生活。
劳动.en: Through labor, we can create a beautiful life.

劳动.zh: 虽然劳动很累，但看到成果就很有成就感。
劳动.en: Although labor is tiring, seeing results gives a sense of achievement.
We have three days off for Labor Day.

创新.en: We must be brave to innovate.

创新.zh: 这家公司因为不断创新而获得了成功。
创新.en: This company succeeded because of continuous innovation.

创新.zh: 虽然传统方法很稳定，但我们也需要创新。
创新.en: Although traditional methods are stable, we also need innovation.

创新.zh: 科技需要创新才能进步。
他提出了一个很有创新性的方案，大家都赞同。
创新.en: He proposed a very innovative plan, everyone agreed.

事先.zh: 这件事我们事先商量好了。
如果你事先做好准备，就不会那么紧张了。
事先.en: If you prepare in advance, you won't be so nervous.

事先.zh: 我事先不知道他会来，所以有点惊讶。
事先.en: I didn't know he was coming beforehand, so I was a bit surprised.

事先.zh: 出发前她事先查好了路线，所以没迷路。
事先.en: She checked the route in advance before leaving, so she didn't get lost.

失业.en: He's been unemployed for three months.

失业.zh: 失业后他一直在找工作。
失业.en: After losing his job, he's been looking for work.

失业.zh: 很多人因为疫情失业了。
失业.en: Many people lost their jobs because of the pandemic.

失业.zh: 她虽然失业了，但心态还是很乐观。
失业.en: Although she's unemployed, she still has a positive attitude.

失业.zh: 我表哥失业半年后终于找到了一份新工作。
失业.en: My cousin finally found a new job after being unemployed for half a year.

无效.en: The medicine the doctor prescribed seems ineffective.

无效.zh: 你的建议虽然很好，但对解决这个问题无效。
无效.en: Your suggestion is good, but it's ineffective for solving this problem.

无效.zh: 如果合同没签字，在法律上是无效的。
无效.en: If the contract isn't signed, it's legally invalid.

无效.zh: 试了好几次，这个密码还是无效。
无效.en: I tried several times, but this password is still invalid.

哎呀.en: Oh dear, why didn't you say so earlier?
Wow, this dish is too salty!

哎呀.zh: 哎呀，我把手机摔坏了，真倒霉。
哎呀.en: Ah, I dropped my phone and broke it. What bad luck.

哎呀.zh: 哎呀，原来你在这里，我找了你好久。
哎呀.en: Oh, there you are! I've been looking for you for ages.

新人.en: She is a newcomer at the company.
The bride and groom were very happy at the wedding.

新人.zh: 新人刚来，大家多帮帮他。
新人.en: He's new here, so everyone please help him out.

新人.zh: 这个部门最近招了几个新人。
新人.en: This department recently hired a few new people.

新人.zh: 虽然她是新人，但工作能力很强。
新人.en: Although she's a newcomer, her work ability is very strong.

刚好.zh: 我刚好要出门，你就来了。
刚好.en: I was just about to leave when you arrived.

刚好.zh: 这个杯子不大不小，刚好够用。
刚好.en: This cup is neither too big nor too small; it's just right.

刚好.zh: 他刚好路过，就顺便帮我带了杯咖啡。
刚好.en: He happened to pass by, so he brought me a coffee on the way.

刚好.zh: 我们带的钱刚好够付房租，多一分都没有。
刚好.en: We brought just enough money to pay the rent, not a penny more.

规律.en: This game has patterns you can follow.

规律.zh: 他每天坚持运动，身体很有规律。
规律.en: He exercises every day and keeps a regular routine.

规律.zh: 天气变化没有规律，很难预测。
规律.en: Weather changes are irregular, making it hard to predict.

规律.zh: 只要找到学习的规律，成绩就能提高。
规律.en: As long as you find the pattern in studying, your grades can improve.

待遇.zh: 工作虽累，但待遇还不错。
待遇.en: Although the work is tiring, the compensation is decent.

待遇.zh: 不同职位的人待遇差别很大。
待遇.en: People in different positions have very different benefits.

待遇.zh: 如果你表现好，公司会提高你的待遇。
待遇.en: If you perform well, the company will improve your compensation.

比分.en: What was the final score of the game?
The score was very close in the first half.

比分.zh: 虽然比分落后，但大家没有放弃。
比分.en: Although the score was behind, no one gave up.

比分.zh: 这场篮球赛的比分最后定格在89比85。
比分.en: The final score of this basketball game ended at 89 to 85.

淡.en: This cup of tea is too weak.
He has a very indifferent attitude toward this matter.

淡.zh: 夏天我喜欢穿颜色淡的衣服。
淡.en: In summer, I like to wear light-colored clothes.

淡.zh: 这道菜味道有点淡，再放点盐吧。
淡.en: This dish tastes a bit bland; add some more salt.

淡.zh: 她说话语气很淡，听不出是高兴还是生气。
淡.en: Her tone of voice was very flat, impossible to tell if she was happy or angry.

上下.en: This building has about twenty floors.

上下.zh: 他的成绩在班里上下浮动很大。
上下.en: His grades fluctuate a lot in the class.
Be careful going up and down the stairs.

上下.zh: 我上下班都要坐一个小时地铁。
上下.en: I have to take the subway for an hour commuting to and from work.

上下.zh: 虽然价格上下差别不大，但我还是选了便宜的。
上下.en: Although the price difference is small, I still chose the cheaper one.

物理.en: I got full marks on the physics exam.

物理.zh: 物理课上老师做了个有趣的实验。
物理.en: The teacher did an interesting experiment in physics class.

物理.zh: 这个现象可以用物理原理来解释。
物理.en: This phenomenon can be explained by physics principles.

物理.zh: 他物理和化学都学得很好。
物理.en: He is good at both physics and chemistry.

物理.zh: 虽然物理很难，但我觉得很有意思。
物理.en: Although physics is difficult, I think it's very interesting.

机器人.en: This robot can sweep the floor.

机器人.zh: 工厂里用了很多机器人来组装汽车。
机器人.en: The factory uses many robots to assemble cars.

机器人.zh: 我小时候特别想要一个机器人玩具。
机器人.en: When I was a kid, I really wanted a robot toy.

机器人.zh: 随着科技发展，机器人越来越像人了。
机器人.en: With the development of technology, robots are becoming more and more human-like.

机器人.zh: 如果机器人能做饭，那就太方便了。
机器人.en: If robots could cook, that would be really convenient.

前途.zh: 这个专业前途不错，找工作容易。
前途.en: This major has good prospects, it's easy to find a job.

前途.zh: 别担心，你的前途一片光明。
前途.en: Don't worry, your future is bright.

前途.en: If you don't study hard, your future will be affected.

After a busy day, she was exhausted.

忙碌.zh: 虽然工作很忙碌，但他很有成就感。
忙碌.en: Although work is very busy, he feels a great sense of accomplishment.

忙碌.zh: 因为家里事情多，她一直很忙碌。
忙碌.en: Because there were many things to do at home, she has been very busy.

忙碌.zh: 忙碌的生活让他没有时间锻炼。
忙碌.en: A busy life leaves him no time to exercise.

灰色.zh: 我不喜欢灰色的天空，太压抑了。
灰色.en: I don't like gray skies, it's too depressing.

灰色.zh: 这部电影的基调是灰色的，有点悲伤。
灰色.en: The tone of this movie is gray, a bit sad.

灰色.zh: 虽然天空是灰色的，但我觉得很舒服。
灰色.en: Although the sky is gray, I feel very comfortable.

灰色.zh: 他的想法有点灰色地带，不太好判断。
灰色.en: His thoughts are in a gray area, hard to judge.

高档.zh: 她喜欢买高档化妆品，但太贵了。
高档.en: She likes to buy high-end cosmetics, but they are too expensive.

高档.zh: 这个品牌主打高档市场，质量很好。
高档.en: This brand targets the high-end market, quality is very good.

高档.zh: 虽然价格高档，但服务真的很好。
高档.en: Although the price is high-end, the service is really good.

高档.zh: 他送了一个高档礼盒给我，我很开心。
高档.en: He gave me a high-end gift box, I'm very happy.

束.en: Give her a bunch of flowers.

束.zh: 我把头发束起来了，比较凉快。
束.en: I tied up my hair, it's cooler.

束.zh: 他手里拿着一束玫瑰走进来。
束.en: He walked in with a bunch of roses in his hand.

束.zh: 我想买一束花，但不知道她喜欢哪种。
束.en: I want to buy a bunch of flowers, but I don't know which kind she likes.

束.zh: 这束花真漂亮，是谁送的？
束.en: This bunch of flowers is really beautiful, who gave it?

个别.zh: 这个问题只是个别的，不用太担心。
个别.en: This problem is only individual, no need to worry too much.

个别.zh: 个别情况需要特别处理。
虽然大部分人都同意，但个别还有意见。
个别.en: Although most people agree, a few still have opinions.

个别.zh: 个别员工不太配合，影响了进度。
个别.en: A few employees are not cooperative, affecting progress.

蝴蝶.zh: 花园里有很多蝴蝶，特别漂亮。
蝴蝶.en: There are many butterflies in the garden, very beautiful.

蝴蝶.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀上有好看的花纹。
蝴蝶.en: The butterfly's wings have beautiful patterns.

蝴蝶.zh: 小时候我喜欢捉蝴蝶，但现在不这样做了。
蝴蝶.en: When I was young I liked catching butterflies, but now I don't do that.

蝴蝶.zh: 这只蝴蝶的颜色很特别。
蝴蝶.en: The color of this butterfly is very special.

否定.zh: 他否定了我的建议，但没给理由。
否定.en: He denied my suggestion but didn't give a reason.

否定.zh: 不要轻易否定别人的意见。
虽然有人反对，但没人否定整个计划。
否定.en: Although some oppose, no one negates the whole plan.

销量.en: This month's sales volume is good.

销量.zh: 新产品的销量比上个月高了很多。
销量.en: The sales of the new product are much higher than last month.

销量.zh: 销量下降是因为质量出了问题。
销量.en: The drop in sales is because of quality issues.

销量.zh: 虽然广告多，但销量没涨。
销量.en: Although there are many ads, sales didn't increase.

销量.zh: 你能告诉我上周的销量吗？
销量.en: Can you tell me last week's sales?

灵活.zh: 这个方案很灵活，可以随时调整。
灵活.en: This plan is very flexible, can be adjusted anytime.

灵活.zh: 他做事很灵活，不会死板。
灵活.en: He is flexible in doing things, not rigid.

灵活.zh: 只要保持灵活，就能应对各种变化。
灵活.en: As long as you stay flexible, you can handle all kinds of changes.

灵活.zh: 她的身体很灵活，适合跳舞。
灵活.en: Her body is very flexible, suitable for dancing.

分类.en: Classify and put these books away.

分类.zh: 我们要把垃圾进行分类，然后扔掉。
分类.en: We need to sort the garbage, then throw it away.

分类.zh: 这个系统可以自动分类图片。
分类.en: This system can automatically classify images.

分类.zh: 如果你想找得快，最好先分类。
分类.en: If you want to find quickly, better to classify first.

分类.zh: 超市的商品按类别分类摆放。
分类.en: The supermarket's products are placed by category.

外部.en: The external environment is very important.

外部.zh: 这个问题来自外部，不是内部原因。
外部.en: This problem comes from outside, not internal causes.

外部.zh: 我们需要外部帮助才能完成。
外部.en: We need external help to finish.

外部.zh: 虽然外部条件不好，但我们还是做成了。
外部.en: Although external conditions are not good, we still made it.

外部.zh: 请检查外部电源是否已经接好。
外部.en: Please check if the external power source is connected.

亲切.zh: 她说话的语气特别亲切。
亲切.en: Her tone of voice is especially warm.

亲切.zh: 虽然老板很严格，但对员工其实很亲切。
亲切.en: Although the boss is strict, he is actually very kind to employees.

亲切.zh: 第一次见面他就给我一种亲切的感觉。
亲切.en: He gave me a feeling of warmth the first time we met.

亲切.zh: 邻居阿姨总是笑眯眯的，特别亲切。
亲切.en: The neighbor auntie is always smiling, very friendly.

预订.zh: 因为旺季人多，所以最好提前预订酒店。
预订.en: Because it's peak season, it's best to reserve a hotel in advance.

预订.zh: 他帮我们预订了明天的会议室。
预订.en: He booked the meeting room for us tomorrow.

预订.zh: 网上预订比现场买便宜很多。
预订.en: Booking online is much cheaper than buying on-site.

充足.zh: 只要准备充足，考试就没问题。
充足.en: As long as you're well prepared, the exam will be fine.

充足.zh: 因为资金充足，我们扩大了团队。
充足.en: Because the funding was sufficient, we expanded the team.

充足.zh: 超市里的水果供应非常充足。
充足.en: The supermarket has a very ample supply of fruit.

充足.zh: 睡眠充足对健康很重要。
充足.en: Getting enough sleep is important for health.

名称.zh: 公司的名称改成了新科技。
名称.en: The company's name was changed to New Tech.

名称.zh: 虽然名称变了，但产品还是老样子。
