名称.en: Although the name changed, the product is still the same.

名称.zh: 你能告诉我这道菜的名称吗？
名称.en: Can you tell me the name of this dish?

名称.zh: 这个品牌的名称在全球都很出名。
名称.en: The name of this brand is famous worldwide.

向上.zh: 他的态度一直很积极向上。
向上.en: His attitude has always been positive and upward-looking.

向上.zh: 虽然遇到挫折，但他仍然向上努力。
向上.en: Although he encountered setbacks, he still strives upward.

向上.zh: 电梯坏了，我们只能向上爬楼梯。
向上.en: The elevator is broken, we have to climb the stairs upward.

向上.zh: 公司的发展趋势是向上的。
向上.en: The company's development trend is upward.

预约.en: I need to make a doctor's appointment.

预约.zh: 我已经预约了明天的理发。
预约.en: I've already booked a haircut for tomorrow.

预约.zh: 因为病人太多，所以需要提前预约。
预约.en: Because there are too many patients, you need to make an appointment in advance.

预约.zh: 他打电话预约了周末的餐厅。
预约.en: He called to reserve a table at the restaurant for the weekend.

预约.zh: 这家诊所可以网上预约，很方便。
预约.en: This clinic allows online appointments, very convenient.

趋势.zh: 现在手机越来越薄，是种趋势。
趋势.en: Phones are getting thinner now, that's a trend.

趋势.zh: 虽然价格在涨，但下降的趋势很明显。
趋势.en: Although prices are rising, the downward trend is obvious.

趋势.zh: 年轻人更喜欢线上购物，这是明显的趋势。
趋势.en: Young people prefer online shopping; this is an obvious trend.

趋势.zh: 我们要抓住市场的变化趋势。
趋势.en: We need to grasp the changing trends of the market.

艰苦.zh: 他们克服了艰苦的条件。
虽然工作艰苦，但他从不放弃。
艰苦.en: Although the work is arduous, he never gives up.

艰苦.zh: 那段艰苦的日子让他变得更坚强。
艰苦.en: That difficult period made him stronger.

艰苦.zh: 创业初期非常艰苦，但他们坚持下来了。
艰苦.en: The early days of starting a business were very tough, but they persisted.

抢救.en: The doctor is rescuing the patient.

抢救.zh: 消防员冲进火场抢救儿童。
抢救.en: Firefighters rushed into the fire to rescue children.

抢救.zh: 虽然受伤严重，但经过抢救终于脱离危险。
抢救.en: Although seriously injured, he was out of danger after rescue.

抢救.zh: 抢救黄金时间只有几分钟。
抢救.en: The golden rescue window is only a few minutes.

抢救.zh: 他们连夜抢救，终于保住了那幅名画。
抢救.en: They worked through the night to save that famous painting.

摄像机.en: The video camera's battery is dead.

摄像机.zh: 他用摄像机拍下了整个过程。
摄像机.en: He recorded the whole process with a video camera.

摄像机.zh: 因为需要高清画面，所以借了一台专业摄像机。
摄像机.en: Because high-definition footage was needed, he borrowed a professional video camera.

摄像机.zh: 这家店的每个角落都装了摄像机。
摄像机.en: Every corner of this store is equipped with a video camera.

摄像机.zh: 摄像机太重了，我带不动。
摄像机.en: The video camera is too heavy; I can't carry it.

名牌.en: This bag is a famous brand.

名牌.zh: 她很喜欢买名牌衣服，但是太贵了。
名牌.en: She loves buying designer clothes, but they're too expensive.

名牌.zh: 我分不清这些名牌的真假。
名牌.en: I can't tell if these famous brands are real or fake.

名牌.zh: 虽然名牌质量好，但价格也高。
名牌.en: Although famous brands have good quality, the price is also high.

名牌.zh: 他送我一个名牌手表，我特别开心。
名牌.en: He gave me a designer watch, and I'm really happy.

更换.zh: 这个灯泡坏了，需要更换一个新的。
更换.en: This light bulb is broken; we need to replace it with a new one.

更换.zh: 我们每半年更换一次床单。
更换.en: We change the bedsheets every half year.

更换.zh: 因为手机屏幕碎了，所以我得更换。
更换.en: Because the phone screen is broken, I have to replace it.

更换.zh: 公司决定更换供应商，因为价格更低。
更换.en: The company decided to switch suppliers because the price is lower.

丢失.zh: 她不小心丢失了钱包，很难过。
丢失.en: She accidentally lost her wallet and is very upset.

丢失.zh: 如果你丢失了证件，要尽快补办。
丢失.en: If you lose your ID, you should get a replacement as soon as possible.

丢失.zh: 虽然我们找了好久，但是手机还是丢失了。
丢失.en: Although we looked for a long time, the phone is still lost.

丢失.zh: 在旅行中丢失行李是很麻烦的事情。
丢失.en: Losing luggage during a trip is a very troublesome matter.

鼓掌.zh: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
鼓掌.en: After the performance, the audience applauded warmly.

鼓掌.zh: 他讲完笑话，我们都鼓掌大笑。
鼓掌.en: After he finished the joke, we all applauded and laughed heartily.

鼓掌.zh: 虽然节目不太精彩，但大家还是礼貌地鼓掌。
鼓掌.en: Although the show wasn't very exciting, everyone still applauded politely.

鼓掌.zh: 老师表扬我的时候，同学们都在鼓掌。
鼓掌.en: When the teacher praised me, my classmates were all applauding.

学术.zh: 这篇论文的学术价值很高。
学术.en: This paper has high academic value.

学术.zh: 她参加了一个学术会议，学到了很多。
学术.en: She attended an academic conference and learned a lot.

学术.zh: 虽然学术很重要，但也要注意实践。
学术.en: Although academics are important, you also need to focus on practice.

学术.zh: 这个大学以学术自由闻名全球。
学术.en: This university is world-famous for academic freedom.

近期.en: The weather has been changing a lot recently.
He's been preparing for exams recently.

近期.zh: 我近期没有时间去看电影。
近期.en: I haven't had time to go see a movie recently.

近期.zh: 由于近期工作太忙，我很少运动。
近期.en: Due to work being too busy recently, I rarely exercise.

近期.zh: 她近期打算换一份新工作，所以很努力。
近期.en: She plans to change jobs soon, so she's working very hard.

地理.zh: 你了解这个地区的地理吗？
地理.en: Do you know the geography of this area?

地理.zh: 地理知识对旅行很有帮助。
地理.en: Geographical knowledge is very helpful for travel.

地理.zh: 因为地理考试很难，所以我复习了很久。
地理.en: Because the geography exam was hard, I reviewed for a long time.

地理.zh: 虽然我地理学得不好，但我很喜欢看地图。
地理.en: Although I'm not good at geography, I really like looking at maps.

翅膀.en: The little bird's wing is injured.

翅膀.zh: 飞机像大鸟一样，有两只翅膀。
翅膀.en: An airplane, like a big bird, has two wings.

翅膀.zh: 如果小鸟没有翅膀，就不能飞了。
翅膀.en: If a bird has no wings, it can't fly.

翅膀.zh: 她梦想有一双翅膀，飞到天空中去。
翅膀.en: She dreams of having a pair of wings to fly into the sky.

阳台.en: I dry clothes on the balcony.

阳台.zh: 阳台上的花开了，真好看。
阳台.en: The flowers on the balcony have bloomed; they're so pretty.

阳台.zh: 他喜欢在阳台喝咖啡看风景。
阳台.en: He likes to drink coffee and enjoy the view on the balcony.

阳台.zh: 因为阳台太小，所以只能放几盆花。
阳台.en: Because the balcony is too small, we can only put a few potted plants.

阳台.zh: 虽然外面冷，我还在阳台呼吸新鲜空气。
阳台.en: Although it's cold outside, I still go to the balcony to breathe fresh air.

礼拜.zh: 我们每个礼拜都去超市购物。
礼拜.en: We go grocery shopping every week.

礼拜.zh: 下个礼拜我要出差去上海。
礼拜.en: Next week I have a business trip to Shanghai.

礼拜.zh: 如果这个礼拜不下雨，我们就去爬山。
礼拜.en: If it doesn't rain this week, we'll go hiking.

礼拜.zh: 虽然这个礼拜很累，但我还是完成了任务。
礼拜.en: Although this week was tiring, I still finished the tasks.

名片.en: Please give me a business card.

名片.zh: 我昨天在会议上交换了很多名片，但忘了收好。
名片.en: I exchanged many business cards at the meeting yesterday but forgot to put them away.

名片.zh: 因为没带名片，所以我只好手写联系方式。
名片.en: Because I didn't bring business cards, I had to write my contact info by hand.

名片.zh: 他的名片设计得很特别，让人印象深刻。
名片.en: His business card design is very special, leaving a deep impression.

名片.zh: 你把名片给我，我回头加你微信。
名片.en: Give me your business card, and I'll add you on WeChat later.

评.zh: 老师评完作文后，给我们提出了很多建议。
评.en: After the teacher commented on the essays, she gave us a lot of suggestions.

评.zh: 虽然大家评得不错，但我还是觉得不够好。
评.en: Although everyone commented positively, I still think it's not good enough.

评.zh: 他评别人的时候很严格，对自己却很宽松。
评.en: He is strict when evaluating others, but lenient with himself.

评.zh: 网上有很多人评这家餐厅，说服务很差。
评.en: Many people online comment on this restaurant, saying the service is terrible.

缓慢.zh: 因为道路施工，车辆只能缓慢地往前移动。
缓慢.en: Due to road construction, vehicles can only move forward slowly.

缓慢.zh: 虽然他走得很缓慢，但最终还是到了终点。
缓慢.en: Although he walked very slowly, he finally reached the finish line.

缓慢.zh: 河水缓慢地流着，看起来非常平静。
缓慢.en: The river flows slowly, looking very calm.

缓慢.zh: 他的动作太缓慢了，我都等不及了。
缓慢.en: His movements are too slow; I can't wait anymore.

再也.en: I will never eat spicy food again.

再也.zh: 自从那次吵架后，他再也不跟我说话了。
再也.en: Since that quarrel, he never talks to me again.

再也.zh: 如果这件事处理不好，我们再也回不到以前了。
再也.en: If this matter is not handled well, we can never go back to how we were before.

再也.zh: 这个游戏玩腻了，我再也不想玩了。
再也.en: I'm bored of this game; I never want to play it again.

再也.zh: 丢了工作后，他再也找不到这样的好机会了。
再也.en: After losing his job, he will never find such a good opportunity again.

行走.en: I like walking in the park.

行走.zh: 每天行走一万步对身体很好，但要坚持。
行走.en: Walking ten thousand steps a day is good for health, but you need to persist.

行走.zh: 因为下雨，行走的时候要小心路滑。
行走.en: Because it's raining, be careful of slippery roads when walking.

行走.zh: 他在沙漠中行走了三天，终于找到了水源。
行走.en: He walked in the desert for three days and finally found a water source.

行走.zh: 这双鞋很适合行走，穿起来很舒服。
行走.en: These shoes are very suitable for walking; they are comfortable to wear.

出自.en: Which book does this sentence come from?

出自.zh: 这个设计灵感出自一位著名的建筑师。
出自.en: This design inspiration comes from a famous architect.

出自.zh: 虽然这个故事出自古代，但现在听起来仍然很有道理。
出自.en: Although this story comes from ancient times, it still makes sense when heard today.

出自.zh: 他画的画出自内心的感受，不是模仿别人。
出自.en: His paintings come from inner feelings, not imitating others.

出自.zh: 这些名酒都出自法国的一个小镇。
出自.en: These famous wines all come from a small town in France.

由此.en: From this we can see he is right.

由此.zh: 他每天坚持锻炼，由此身体越来越好。
由此.en: He persists in exercising every day, thus his health gets better and better.

由此.zh: 如果我们不采取措施，由此造成的后果会很严重。
由此.en: If we don't take measures, the consequences resulting from this will be serious.

由此.zh: 这个问题很重要，由此大家展开了激烈讨论。
由此.en: This issue is very important, and thus everyone started a heated discussion.

由此.zh: 由此看来，我们还是早点准备比较好。
由此.en: From this point of view, we'd better prepare early.

尾巴.zh: 猫的尾巴竖起来的时候，说明它很紧张。
尾巴.en: When a cat's tail stands up, it means it's nervous.

尾巴.zh: 他不仅没承认错误，还夹着尾巴逃走了。
尾巴.en: He not only didn't admit his mistake, but also tucked his tail and ran away.

尾巴.zh: 飞机尾巴上的标志是航空公司的标识。
尾巴.en: The logo on the tail of the plane is the airline's emblem.

尾巴.zh: 考试结束后，我们还有个小尾巴要处理。
尾巴.en: After the exam, we still have a small loose end to deal with.

罚款.en: Parking illegally will get a fine.

罚款.zh: 他在高速上超速行驶，被交警罚款两百元。
罚款.en: He was speeding on the highway and was fined 200 yuan by the traffic police.

罚款.zh: 如果不按时交税，不仅要罚款，还可能被拘留。
罚款.en: If you don't pay taxes on time, you'll not only be fined but also possibly detained.

罚款.zh: 公司因为污染环境被罚款了一笔巨款。
罚款.en: The company was fined a huge sum for polluting the environment.

罚款.zh: 乱扔垃圾的话，小心被罚款。
罚款.en: If you litter, be careful you'll be fined.

握手.zh: 在商务场合，握手时要保持微笑和目光接触。
握手.en: In business settings, maintain a smile and eye contact when shaking hands.

握手.zh: 虽然我们之前有矛盾，但见面时还是友好地握手了。
握手.en: Although we had conflicts before, we still shook hands friendly when we met.

握手.zh: 握手是国际通用的礼貌动作。
握手.en: Shaking hands is a universal polite gesture.

摇头.en: He shook his head and said no.

摇头.zh: 我问了他三次，他都摇头表示不知道。
摇头.en: I asked him three times, and he shook his head each time to show he didn't know.

摇头.zh: 看到这个结果，她直摇头。
摇头.en: Seeing this result, she kept shaking her head.

摇头.zh: 他虽然摇头，但心里其实同意了。
摇头.en: Although he shook his head, he actually agreed in his heart.

摇头.zh: 老板听完我的解释，只是摇头笑了笑。
摇头.en: After hearing my explanation, the boss just shook his head and smiled.

租金.en: This month's rent hasn't been paid yet.

租金.zh: 市中心的租金比郊区贵很多。
租金.en: Rent in the city center is much more expensive than in the suburbs.

租金.zh: 因为租金涨了，我们打算换个地方住。
租金.en: Because the rent went up, we plan to move somewhere else.

租金.zh: 房东说租金可以按月付。
租金.en: The landlord said the rent can be paid monthly.

租金.zh: 她跟室友平分租金，所以压力不大。
租金.en: She splits the rent with her roommate, so the pressure isn't too high.

智能.zh: 智能家居让生活更方便。
智能.en: Smart home devices make life more convenient.

智能.zh: 现在的汽车越来越智能了。
智能.en: Cars nowadays are getting more and more intelligent.

智能.zh: 虽然智能设备好用，但价格也不便宜。
智能.en: Although smart devices are convenient, the prices aren't cheap.

智能.zh: 他买了一台智能扫地机器人。
智能.en: He bought a smart sweeping robot.

手工.zh: 她喜欢做手工，比如折纸和编织。
手工.en: She likes doing handicrafts, such as origami and knitting.

手工.zh: 手工蛋糕比机器做的更香。
手工.en: Handmade cakes are more fragrant than machine-made ones.

手工.zh: 周末我们去学手工陶艺。
手工.en: This weekend we're going to learn handmade pottery.

手工.zh: 虽然手工慢，但质量很好。
手工.en: Although handmade is slow, the quality is very good.

心态.zh: 输了比赛，但他心态很好。
心态.en: He lost the game, but he had a good attitude.

心态.zh: 保持积极的心态，你就能克服困难。
心态.en: Keep a positive mindset, and you can overcome difficulties.

心态.zh: 她总是抱怨，心态需要调整一下。
心态.en: She always complains; her mindset needs some adjustment.

心态.zh: 考试前我尽量放松心态。
心态.en: Before the exam, I try to relax my mindset.

来信.en: Please send letters to this address.

来信.zh: 很久没来信了，你最近还好吗？
来信.en: Haven't heard from you in a while; how have you been?

来信.zh: 他来信说下个月要回国。
来信.en: He wrote that he will return to China next month.

来信.zh: 如果你来信，我会马上回复。
来信.en: If you write to me, I will reply immediately.

总体.en: This event was overall very successful.

总体.zh: 虽然有小问题，但总体效果很好。
总体.en: Although there were minor issues, the overall effect was good.

总体.zh: 我们总体花了一天时间准备。
总体.en: We spent a day preparing overall.

登录.en: Please log in to your account first.

登录.zh: 密码输错了，登录不上去。
登录.en: The password was entered incorrectly, so I can't log in.
You can earn points by logging in every day.

登录.zh: 我忘了密码，现在无法登录。
登录.en: I forgot my password, so I can't log in now.

登录.zh: 登录之后你就可以修改个人信息。
登录.en: After logging in, you can modify your personal information.

题目.zh: 考试的题目你都会做吗？
题目.en: Can you answer all the exam questions?

题目.zh: 老师出的题目很有深度。
题目.en: The topic the teacher assigned is quite profound.

题目.zh: 我看了三遍才理解题目的意思。
题目.en: I read it three times before understanding the meaning of the question.

应对.en: You need to learn to cope with stress.

应对.zh: 面对突发情况，他冷静应对。
应对.en: Faced with an unexpected situation, he responded calmly.

应对.zh: 公司制定了新的策略来应对市场变化。
应对.en: The company formulated new strategies to respond to market changes.

应对.zh: 我们得想办法应对这个挑战。
应对.en: We have to find a way to deal with this challenge.

应对.zh: 虽然问题很多，但团队应对得很好。
应对.en: Although there were many problems, the team handled them well.

节省.en: We need to save some water.

节省.zh: 为了省钱，他每天都节省吃饭的开销。
节省.en: To save money, he cuts down on meal expenses every day.

节省.zh: 这个办法虽然慢，但能节省不少时间。
节省.en: This method is slow, but it can save a lot of time.

节省.zh: 如果你提前订票，可以节省一半的费用。
节省.en: If you book tickets in advance, you can save half the cost.

节省.zh: 我妈总说，平时节省一点，急用的时候才不慌。
节省.en: My mom always says, save a little bit usually, so you won't panic when you need it urgently.

围巾.zh: 她围了一条红色围巾，特别好看。
围巾.en: She wore a red scarf, and it looked especially nice.

围巾.zh: 出门记得带上围巾，今天风很大。
围巾.en: Remember to bring a scarf when you go out; it's very windy today.

围巾.zh: 我买了一条羊毛围巾送给妈妈当生日礼物。
围巾.en: I bought a wool scarf as a birthday gift for my mom.

围巾.zh: 围巾太长的话，可以在脖子上绕两圈再系起来。
围巾.en: If the scarf is too long, you can wrap it around your neck twice and then tie it.

光线.zh: 拍照的时候，光线好效果就好。
光线.en: When taking photos, good light makes the effect better.

光线.zh: 他把窗帘拉开，让光线照进来。
光线.en: He opened the curtains to let the light in.

光线.zh: 因为光线不足，我看不清书上写的是什么。
光线.en: Because the light was insufficient, I couldn't see clearly what was written in the book.

光线.zh: 这家咖啡馆的灯光线很柔和，适合和朋友聊天。
光线.en: The lighting in this café is very soft, perfect for chatting with friends.

删除.zh: 我不小心把照片删除了，你能帮我恢复吗？
删除.en: I accidentally deleted the photo; can you help me recover it?

删除.zh: 他把聊天记录全部删除了，我觉得很奇怪。
删除.en: He deleted all the chat history, and I found it very strange.

删除.zh: 为了腾出空间，我删除了手机里很多不用的应用。
删除.en: To free up space, I deleted many unused apps on my phone.

删除.zh: 你最好先备份一下，然后再删除那些旧邮件。
删除.en: You'd better back up first, then delete those old emails.

强度.en: The intensity of this training is too high.

强度.zh: 下雨的强度突然变大，我们只好躲进屋里。
强度.en: The intensity of the rain suddenly increased, so we had to take shelter indoors.

强度.zh: 根据光的强度不同，植物的生长速度也会变化。
强度.en: Depending on the light intensity, the growth rate of plants will also change.

强度.zh: 医生说运动强度要适中，不能一开始就太猛。
强度.en: The doctor said the exercise intensity should be moderate; you can't go too hard from the start.

强度.zh: 这个材料的强度很高，适合用来做桥梁。
强度.en: This material has high strength, suitable for building bridges.

车厢.en: This train car is very empty.

车厢.zh: 我们在第三节车厢见面吧。
车厢.en: Let's meet in the third carriage.

车厢.zh: 因为人太多，车厢里连站的地方都没有。
车厢.en: Because there were so many people, there wasn't even standing room in the carriage.

车厢.zh: 高铁的车厢很干净，而且座位也很舒服。
车厢.en: The high-speed train carriages are very clean, and the seats are also comfortable.

车厢.zh: 他习惯在车厢里看手机，但经常坐过站。
车厢.en: He's used to looking at his phone in the carriage, but he often misses his stop.

一次性.zh: 我很少用一次性塑料杯，觉得不环保。
一次性.en: I rarely use disposable plastic cups; I think they're not eco-friendly.

一次性.zh: 这个密码是一次性的，用完就失效了。
一次性.en: This password is one-time use; it becomes invalid after use.

一次性.zh: 一次性筷子虽然方便，但对环境不好。
一次性.en: Although disposable chopsticks are convenient, they are bad for the environment.

一次性.zh: 公司决定一次性付清所有员工的年终奖。
一次性.en: The company decided to pay all employees' year-end bonuses in one lump sum.

变动.zh: 最近公司的人事变动很大。
变动.en: There have been big personnel changes at the company recently.

变动.zh: 如果时间有变动，我会提前通知你。
变动.en: If there is a change in time, I will notify you in advance.

变动.zh: 因为天气变动，我们的航班延误了三个小时。
变动.en: Due to the weather change, our flight was delayed for three hours.

变动.zh: 他不太喜欢生活中有太多的变动，觉得不安稳。
变动.en: He doesn't like too many changes in life; he finds it unsettling.

失眠.zh: 压力太大容易导致失眠。
失眠.en: Too much stress can easily cause insomnia.

失眠.zh: 他因为失眠，白天上班一点精神都没有。
失眠.en: Because of insomnia, he had no energy at work during the day.

失眠.zh: 喝咖啡太晚的话，晚上可能会失眠。
失眠.en: If you drink coffee too late, you might get insomnia at night.

失眠.zh: 我试过很多方法治失眠，最后发现运动最管用。
失眠.en: I've tried many ways to cure insomnia, and in the end found that exercise works best.

烧烤.zh: 夏天我们经常在院子里自己烧烤。
烧烤.en: In summer, we often barbecue in the yard ourselves.

烧烤.zh: 这家店的烧烤味道特别好，每次都要排队。
烧烤.en: The barbecue at this restaurant tastes especially good; there's always a line.

烧烤.zh: 烧烤的时候要注意火候，不然容易烤焦。
烧烤.en: When barbecuing, you need to watch the heat, otherwise it's easy to burn.

烧烤.zh: 他最喜欢吃的烧烤是烤鸡翅和烤玉米。
烧烤.en: His favorite barbecue items are grilled chicken wings and grilled corn.

泉.en: This spring water is really cool.
There is a spring in the mountains.

泉.zh: 我们喝的矿泉水来自天然泉。
泉.en: The mineral water we drink comes from a natural spring.

泉.zh: 因为山脚有温泉，所以很多人来泡。
泉.en: Because there is a hot spring at the foot of the mountain, many people come to soak.

泉.zh: 这口泉的泉水非常清澈。
泉.en: The water from this spring is very clear.

新型.en: This is a new type of phone.
The new virus is very scary.

新型.zh: 这款新型电脑性能很好。
新型.en: This new model computer has great performance.

新型.zh: 虽然这是新型产品，但质量还不稳定。
新型.en: Although this is a new product, the quality is not stable yet.

新型.zh: 新型材料可以用于建筑。
新型.en: New materials can be used in construction.

互动.en: The interaction in class is good.

互动.zh: 这个游戏有很多互动环节。
互动.en: This game has many interactive segments.

互动.zh: 虽然我们没见过面，但在网上互动很多。
互动.en: Although we haven't met, we interact a lot online.

互动.zh: 观众和演员的互动很精彩。
互动.en: The interaction between the audience and the actors is wonderful.

优美.en: This song has a beautiful melody.

优美.zh: 这里的环境非常优美，适合散步。
优美.en: The environment here is very beautiful, suitable for walking.

优美.zh: 因为风景优美，所以很多人来拍照。
优美.en: Because the scenery is beautiful, many people come to take photos.
Her voice is beautiful and pleasant to hear.

铃声.en: The ringtone is too loud, right?
I set the ringtone to silent.

铃声.zh: 虽然铃声很小，但我还是听到了。
铃声.en: Although the ringtone was very low, I still heard it.
You should turn off the ringtone during class.

将近.en: He walked for nearly an hour.

将近.zh: 虽然将近十年没见，但我们还是好朋友。
将近.en: Although it's been nearly ten years without seeing each other, we are still good friends.
The cost is nearly two thousand yuan.

逃走.en: He took the chance and escaped.

逃走.zh: 虽然我们看得很紧，但还是让他逃走了。
逃走.en: Although we watched closely, he still escaped.
The little bird escaped from the cage.

分布.en: This kind of tree is widely distributed.

分布.zh: 中国的少数民族主要分布在西部地区。
分布.en: China's ethnic minorities are mainly distributed in the western regions.

分布.zh: 虽然这种动物分布很广，但数量在减少。
分布.en: Although this animal is widely distributed, its numbers are decreasing.

分布.zh: 这家公司的门店分布在全国各地。
分布.en: This company's stores are distributed all over the country.

必需.en: When going out, bring the necessary documents.

必需.zh: 虽然贵，但这是必需的花费。
必需.en: Although expensive, this is a necessary expense.

必需.zh: 对登山来说，安全装备是必需的。
必需.en: For mountaineering, safety equipment is essential.

研究所.en: He works at the research institute.
This research institute is very famous.

研究所.zh: 爸爸在生物研究所上班。
研究所.en: Dad works at a biology research institute.

研究所.zh: 虽然研究所不大，但成果很多。
研究所.en: Although the research institute is not big, it has many achievements.

研究所.zh: 他去年加入了那个研究所的团队。
研究所.en: He joined that research institute's team last year.

赛场.zh: 虽然赛场很大，但观众还是坐满了。
赛场.en: Although the arena is big, the spectators still filled it up.

赛场.zh: 比赛开始后，赛场上的气氛越来越紧张。
赛场.en: After the game started, the atmosphere in the arena became more tense.

赛场.zh: 他第一次在这么大的赛场打球，有点紧张。
赛场.en: He's playing in such a big arena for the first time, a bit nervous.

赛场.zh: 赛场的灯光太亮了，选手们都有点不适应。
赛场.en: The lights in the arena are too bright, the players are a bit uncomfortable.

人力.zh: 很多工厂用机器代替人力，效率更高。
人力.en: Many factories use machines to replace human labor, which is more efficient.

人力.zh: 因为人力不足，这个项目只能延期。
人力.en: Because of manpower shortage, this project has to be delayed.

人力.zh: 这家公司主要靠人力完成配送。
人力.en: This company mainly relies on human labor for delivery.

人力.zh: 传统农业需要大量人力，现在不一样了。
人力.en: Traditional farming needs a lot of manpower, but it's different now.

递.en: Please pass me this glass of water.

递.zh: 他悄悄地把纸条递到同桌手里。
递.en: He quietly passed the note into his deskmate's hand.

递.zh: 如果你看见他，麻烦帮我把这封信递给他。
递.en: If you see him, please help me hand this letter to him.

递.zh: 服务员递菜单的时候，我还没想好点什么。
递.en: When the waiter handed the menu, I hadn't decided what to order.

递.zh: 她把手机递过来，让我看照片。
递.en: She handed me her phone to look at the photos.

低头.en: He bowed his head to look at his phone.

低头.zh: 在困难面前，他从来不会轻易低头。
低头.en: In the face of difficulties, he never easily gives in.

低头.zh: 虽然他犯了错，但他还是不肯低头认错。
低头.en: Although he made a mistake, he still refuses to bow his head and admit it.

低头.zh: 走路的时候别老低头，小心撞到人。
低头.en: Don't keep your head down when walking, be careful not to bump into people.

子女.zh: 很多父母为了子女的教育花了很多钱。
子女.en: Many parents spend a lot of money on their children's education.

子女.zh: 她不但要照顾老人，还要养育年幼的子女。
子女.en: She not only has to take care of the elderly but also raise young children.

子女.zh: 现在年轻人的观念变了，对生育子女不太着急。
子女.en: Now young people's views have changed; they are not in a hurry to have children.

面向.zh: 这家公司的产品主要面向年轻消费者。
面向.en: This company's products are mainly targeted at young consumers.

面向.zh: 你只要面向南方，就能看到那座山。
面向.en: You just need to face south, then you'll see that mountain.

面向.zh: 他转过身，面向大家开始演讲。
面向.en: He turned around, facing everyone, and started speaking.

面向.zh: 这个课程是面向零基础学生的。
面向.en: This course is aimed at students with no foundation.

消费者.zh: 商家应该多听听消费者的意见。
消费者.en: Businesses should listen more to consumers' opinions.

消费者.zh: 因为很多消费者投诉，这家店被迫整改。
消费者.en: Because many consumers complained, this store was forced to rectify.

消费者.zh: 现在的消费者越来越看重产品质量。
消费者.en: Nowadays consumers increasingly value product quality.

消费者.zh: 价格太高的话，消费者就不会买了。
消费者.en: If the price is too high, consumers won't buy it.

不停.zh: 他不停地在房间里走来走去，看起来很着急。
不停.en: He keeps pacing back and forth in the room, looking anxious.

不停.zh: 即使我劝了他，他还是不停地抽烟。
不停.en: Even though I advised him, he still kept smoking.
The phone keeps ringing, so annoying.

不停.zh: 她不停地问问题，我都答不上来了。
不停.en: She kept asking questions, and I couldn't answer anymore.

种植.zh: 今年我们种植了很多玉米。
种植.en: This year we planted a lot of corn.

种植.zh: 这里的气候很适合种植咖啡。
种植.en: The climate here is very suitable for growing coffee.

种植.zh: 为了提高产量，他们开始采用新技术种植。
种植.en: To increase yield, they started using new technology for planting.

种植.zh: 种植树木可以改善环境。
种植.en: Planting trees can improve the environment.

种植.zh: 他退休后回到老家种植蔬菜。
种植.en: After retirement, he returned to his hometown to grow vegetables.

住房.zh: 现在的住房问题很严重。
住房.en: The housing problem is serious now.

住房.zh: 政府正在努力解决低收入家庭的住房困难。
住房.en: The government is working hard to solve the housing difficulties of low-income families.

住房.zh: 虽然房价很高，但住房仍然是刚需。
住房.en: Although housing prices are high, housing is still a rigid demand.

住房.zh: 他们租了一套小住房，勉强够住。
住房.en: They rented a small housing unit, barely enough to live in.

住房.zh: 这个城市的住房条件越来越好。
住房.en: The housing conditions in this city are getting better and better.

挣钱.en: He works hard to earn money every day.

挣钱.zh: 为了买房，他拼命挣钱，连周末都不休息。
挣钱.en: To buy a house, he works desperately to earn money, not even resting on weekends.

挣钱.zh: 挣钱虽然重要，但健康更重要。
挣钱.en: Earning money is important, but health is more important.

挣钱.zh: 我打算去大城市挣钱，然后寄回家给父母。
挣钱.en: I plan to go to a big city to earn money and then send it home to my parents.
She makes a living by painting.

台阶.en: Watch the steps at the door.

台阶.zh: 他给了她一个台阶下，结束了争吵。
台阶.en: He gave her a way out, ending the argument.

台阶.zh: 这个台阶有点高，我爬不上去。
台阶.en: This step is a bit high; I can't climb up.

台阶.zh: 既然他道歉了，你就顺着台阶下吧。
台阶.en: Since he apologized, just take the way out.

打听.zh: 他在到处打听她的消息，但没人知道。
打听.en: He's asking around for news about her, but no one knows.

打听.zh: 我想打听一下去故宫怎么走。
打听.en: I want to ask how to get to the Forbidden City.

打听.zh: 别到处打听别人的隐私，这样不礼貌。
打听.en: Don't pry into others' privacy; that's impolite.
He inquired for a long time.

此后.en: After that, he never came back.

此后.zh: 他辞了工作，此后一直在家休息。
此后.en: He quit his job and has been resting at home ever since.

此后.zh: 此后，他们再也没有见过面。
此后.en: After that, they never saw each other again.

此后.zh: 我告诉他真相，此后他对我很冷淡。
此后.en: I told him the truth, and after that he was very cold to me.

打包.en: These dishes need to be packed up.

打包.zh: 服务员，麻烦帮我把剩下的菜打包。
打包.en: Waiter, please help me pack up the leftovers.

打包.zh: 行李已经打包好了，我们出发吧。
打包.en: The luggage is already packed; let's go.

打包.zh: 如果吃不完，可以打包带走，不浪费。
打包.en: If you can't finish it, you can take it away to avoid waste.
Please help me pack it up.

促使.en: What prompted you to do this?

促使.zh: 这次失败促使他更加努力地学习。
促使.en: This failure prompted him to study even harder.

促使.zh: 老板的话促使我决定辞职。
促使.en: The boss's words prompted me to decide to resign.

促使.zh: 父母的鼓励促使他坚持完成了学业。
促使.en: His parents' encouragement prompted him to persist and finish his studies.
This incident prompted us to reflect.

定期.en: We need to have regular check-ups.

定期.zh: 他定期给父母寄钱，从不间断。
定期.en: He regularly sends money to his parents without ever stopping.

定期.zh: 这个会议是定期举行的。
银行建议我们定期更换密码，确保安全。
定期.en: The bank recommends we change passwords regularly to ensure security.
She goes to the gym regularly.

升高.zh: 随着全球变暖，海平面不断升高。
升高.en: With global warming, sea levels are continuously rising.

升高.zh: 他的血压突然升高，吓了我一跳。
升高.en: His blood pressure suddenly rose, giving me a scare.

升高.zh: 如果你把火调大，水温会迅速升高。
升高.en: If you turn up the heat, the water temperature will rise quickly.
The sun has risen higher, and it's getting hotter.

钓.en: We are fishing by the river.

钓.zh: 他周末喜欢去湖边钓鱼，放松心情。
钓.en: He likes to go fishing at the lake on weekends to relax.

钓.zh: 今天一条鱼都没钓到，真没意思。
钓.en: I didn't catch a single fish today; it's really boring.

钓.zh: 爷爷教我怎样在河里钓鱼，很有趣。
钓.en: Grandpa taught me how to fish in the river; it was very fun.

远处.en: There is a mountain in the distance.

远处.zh: 从远处看，那座房子像个小盒子。
远处.en: Seen from a distance, that house looks like a small box.

远处.zh: 他指着远处说：“那就是我的家。”
远处.en: He pointed into the distance and said, 'That is my home.'

远处.zh: 我听到远处传来一阵笑声，但看不清人。
远处.en: I heard laughter coming from afar, but couldn't see anyone clearly.
The lights in the distance are very bright.

动人.zh: 她的故事特别动人，我都哭了。
动人.en: Her story was so touching that I cried.

动人.zh: 这部电影的情节非常动人，让人感动。
动人.en: The plot of this movie is very touching, it makes people emotional.

动人.zh: 他弹的钢琴曲真的很动人。
动人.en: The piano piece he played was really moving.

动人.zh: 虽然画面简单，但那个广告很动人。
动人.en: Although the visuals are simple, that advertisement is very touching.

种类.en: There are many kinds of fruit in the supermarket.

种类.zh: 我喜欢不同种类的花，比如玫瑰和百合。
种类.en: I like different kinds of flowers, such as roses and lilies.

种类.zh: 这家店的衣服种类太少了。
种类.en: This store has too few types of clothes.

种类.zh: 电脑游戏有各种种类，你可以选择。
种类.en: There are all kinds of computer games, you can choose.

种类.zh: 因为我过敏，只能吃特定种类的食物。
种类.en: Because I have allergies, I can only eat certain types of food.

有毒.en: This type of mushroom is poisonous, you can't eat it.

有毒.zh: 工厂排出的废水有毒，污染环境。
有毒.en: The wastewater discharged by the factory is toxic and pollutes the environment.

有毒.zh: 有些植物看着漂亮，但其实有毒。
有毒.en: Some plants look beautiful, but they are actually poisonous.

有毒.zh: 他吃错了药，因为那个药有毒。
有毒.en: He took the wrong medicine because that medicine was poisonous.

有毒.zh: 别碰那条蛇，它可能有毒。
有毒.en: Don't touch that snake, it might be venomous.

老百姓.zh: 老百姓的日子越来越好了。
老百姓.en: The lives of ordinary people are getting better and better.

老百姓.zh: 这个政策对普通老百姓很有利。
老百姓.en: This policy is very beneficial to ordinary people.

老百姓.zh: 当官的要多听听老百姓的意见。
老百姓.en: Officials should listen more to the opinions of the common people.

老百姓.zh: 老百姓最关心的就是房价和物价。
老百姓.en: What ordinary people care about most is housing prices and the cost of living.

老百姓.zh: 虽然他是明星，但他说话很接地气，像老百姓一样。
老百姓.en: Although he is a celebrity, he speaks in a down-to-earth way, just like an ordinary person.

有益.en: Going to bed early and waking up early is good for your health.
Reading more is beneficial for growth.

有益.zh: 喝茶有益身心，而且味道也不错。
有益.en: Drinking tea is good for both mind and body, and it tastes good too.

有益.zh: 这种运动对心血管有益。
有益.en: This kind of exercise is good for the cardiovascular system.

有益.zh: 跟积极的人交朋友有益你的心态。
有益.en: Making friends with positive people is beneficial for your mindset.

户外.zh: 周末我们一起去户外烧烤吧。
户外.en: Let's go outdoor barbecue together this weekend.

户外.zh: 户外空气好，应该多出去走走。
户外.en: The outdoor air is good, you should go out and walk more.

户外.zh: 这个帐篷是专门用来户外露营的。
户外.en: This tent is specially used for outdoor camping.

户外.zh: 因为天气好，我们决定在户外吃午饭。
户外.en: Because the weather is nice, we decided to have lunch outdoors.

急需.en: I urgently need money right now.
The disaster area urgently needs food and medicine.

急需.zh: 公司急需一名翻译，你能来吗？
急需.en: The company is in urgent need of a translator, can you come?

急需.zh: 这个项目急需解决技术问题。
急需.en: This project urgently needs to solve technical issues.

急需.zh: 因为水管坏了，我们急需修理工。
急需.en: Because the water pipe is broken, we urgently need a plumber.

牛仔裤.zh: 他穿蓝色牛仔裤特别帅。
牛仔裤.en: He looks especially handsome in blue jeans.

牛仔裤.zh: 我昨天买了一条新牛仔裤。
牛仔裤.en: I bought a new pair of jeans yesterday.

牛仔裤.zh: 牛仔裤搭配白T恤很简单好看。
牛仔裤.en: Jeans paired with a white T-shirt are simple and look good.

牛仔裤.zh: 虽然牛仔裤很流行，但我不太喜欢穿。
牛仔裤.en: Although jeans are very popular, I don't really like wearing them.

凭借.zh: 她凭借出色的表现获得了奖金。
凭借.en: She got a bonus thanks to her outstanding performance.

凭借.zh: 我们只能凭借地图找到路。
凭借.en: We can only find the way by relying on the map.

凭借.zh: 他凭借一张旧照片找到了失散多年的亲人。
凭借.en: He found his long-lost relatives by relying on an old photo.

凭借.zh: 凭借丰富的经验，他很快解决了问题。
凭借.en: With his rich experience, he quickly solved the problem.

浏览.zh: 你浏览一下这份文件吧。
浏览.en: Take a quick look at this document.

浏览.zh: 我每天都会浏览新闻头条。
浏览.en: I browse the news headlines every day.

浏览.zh: 因为时间有限，我只快速浏览了报告。
浏览.en: Because time was limited, I only quickly skimmed through the report.

看作.en: I regard her as a little sister.

看作.zh: 很多人把努力工作看作成功的唯一途径。
看作.en: Many people regard hard work as the only way to success.

看作.zh: 别把别人的帮助看作理所当然。
看作.en: Don't take others' help for granted.

看作.zh: 他把这次失败看作一次学习机会。
看作.en: He sees this failure as a learning opportunity.

看作.zh: 父母常把孩子看作自己的全部。
看作.en: Parents often see their children as their everything.

橘子.zh: 这个橘子很甜，你尝尝看。
橘子.en: This orange is very sweet, try it.

橘子.zh: 橘子皮可以用来泡水喝。
橘子.en: Orange peel can be used to make tea.

橘子.zh: 我在超市买了五斤橘子。
橘子.en: I bought five jin of oranges at the supermarket.

橘子.zh: 他喜欢吃橘子，但不喜欢吃香蕉。
橘子.en: He likes eating oranges but doesn't like bananas.

剧场.en: We're going to the theater tonight.

剧场.zh: 这个剧场今晚有一场很精彩的演出。
剧场.en: There is a wonderful performance at this theater tonight.

剧场.zh: 剧场门口排了很长的队。
剧场.en: There's a long line at the theater entrance.

剧场.zh: 她第一次来这个剧场，觉得非常漂亮。
剧场.en: She came to this theater for the first time and thought it was very beautiful.

剧场.zh: 因为疫情，剧场暂时关闭了。
剧场.en: The theater is temporarily closed due to the pandemic.

斜.zh: 他斜靠在沙发上，看起来很累。
斜.en: He leaned sideways on the sofa, looking very tired.
The sunlight slants in through the window.

斜.zh: 那条路有点斜，开车要小心。
斜.en: That road is a bit slanted, drive carefully.

斜.zh: 他斜着眼看了我一眼，没说话。
斜.en: He glanced at me sideways without saying a word.

有害.zh: 长期熬夜对身体非常有害。
有害.en: Staying up late regularly is very harmful to the body.

有害.zh: 这种化学物质对环境有害。
有害.en: This chemical is harmful to the environment.
Don't throw harmful things around carelessly.
Eating too much sugar is harmful to your teeth.

看成.zh: 很多人把别人的帮助看成理所当然。
看成.en: Many people take others' help for granted.

看成.zh: 他把那根绳子看成了蛇，吓了一跳。
看成.en: He mistook that rope for a snake and got scared.

看成.zh: 你别把玩笑看成真心话。
看成.en: Don't take jokes as sincere words.

开业.zh: 新餐厅开业第一天就排起了长队。
开业.en: The new restaurant had a long line on its opening day.

开业.zh: 朋友的花店明天开业，我要去捧场。
开业.en: My friend's flower shop opens tomorrow, I'll go to support.

开业.zh: 开业大酬宾，全场打八折。
开业.en: Grand opening sale, 20% off on everything.

开业.zh: 这家公司开业三年了，生意越来越好。
开业.en: This company has been open for three years, and business is getting better.

浇.zh: 天太干了，我每天都要给菜浇两次水。
浇.en: It's too dry; I have to water the vegetables twice a day.

浇.zh: 浇完水后别忘了关水龙头。
浇.en: Don't forget to turn off the faucet after watering.

浇.zh: 他不小心把汤浇到桌子上了。
浇.en: He accidentally spilled soup on the table.

浇.zh: 这棵树的根需要多浇些水。
浇.en: This tree's roots need more water.

图书.zh: 我在图书馆借了几本图书。
图书.en: I borrowed some books from the library.

图书.zh: 学校最近买了一批新的图书。
图书.en: The school recently bought a batch of new books.

图书.zh: 这些图书都是关于历史的。
图书.en: These books are all about history.

图书.zh: 他喜欢去图书市场淘旧书。
图书.en: He likes going to the book market to hunt for used books.

图书.zh: 图书馆的图书种类很丰富。
图书.en: The library has a wide variety of books.

生动.zh: 这部电影用生动的画面讲述了战争的故事。
生动.en: This movie tells the story of war with vivid images.

生动.zh: 老师的讲解非常生动，大家都听入迷了。
生动.en: The teacher's explanation was so vivid that everyone was captivated.

生动.zh: 小说里的人物描写很生动，就像真的一样。
生动.en: The character descriptions in the novel are very vivid, as if real.

生动.zh: 她用生动的语言描述了她旅行的经历。
生动.en: She described her travel experiences in vivid language.

泪水.zh: 看到这一幕，我的泪水止不住地流。
泪水.en: Seeing this scene, my tears couldn't stop flowing.

泪水.zh: 他擦干了泪水，继续往前走。
泪水.en: He wiped away his tears and kept walking forward.

泪水.zh: 虽然她强忍着，但泪水还是掉了下来。
泪水.en: Although she held back, tears still fell.

泪水.zh: 听到那个消息，他的泪水一下子就涌了出来。
泪水.en: Upon hearing that news, his tears immediately welled up.

乙.en: I got a B on this exam.

乙.zh: 甲方和乙方的合同签好了。
乙.en: The contract between Party A and Party B is signed.

乙.zh: 我们选了乙方案，因为更省钱。
乙.en: We chose Plan B because it saves more money.

乙.zh: 血液类型有甲、乙、丙几种。
乙.en: Blood types include A, B, and O (or various types).

乙.zh: 如果甲不行，那就试试乙吧。
乙.en: If Plan A doesn't work, then try Plan B.

电器.zh: 我家的电器坏了，需要修一下。
电器.en: The appliance in my house is broken and needs repair.

电器.zh: 买电器最好去大商场，质量有保障。
电器.en: It's best to buy electrical appliances at a big mall, the quality is guaranteed.

电器.zh: 他特别喜欢研究各种新式电器。
电器.en: He really likes researching all kinds of new appliances.

电器.zh: 搬家的时候，我们处理掉了很多旧电器。
电器.en: When moving, we got rid of a lot of old electrical appliances.

梨.zh: 我买了几斤梨，分给大家吃。
梨.en: I bought a few jin of pears and shared them with everyone.

梨.zh: 秋天的时候，梨特别多汁。
梨.en: In autumn, pears are especially juicy.

梨.zh: 他把梨切成小块，放在水果盘里。
梨.en: He cut the pear into small pieces and put them in the fruit bowl.

梨.zh: 因为咳嗽，妈妈让我煮梨水喝。
梨.en: Because of my cough, Mom told me to drink boiled pear water.

步行.en: I walk to work every day.

步行.zh: 从这里步行到地铁站要十分钟。
步行.en: It takes ten minutes to walk from here to the subway station.

步行.zh: 周末我喜欢去步行街逛逛。
步行.en: On weekends I like to stroll on the pedestrian street.

步行.zh: 为了健康，他决定每天步行半小时。
步行.en: For health reasons, he decided to walk for half an hour every day.

步行.zh: 如果路不远，我们最好步行过去，还能锻炼身体。
步行.en: If it's not far, we'd better walk there, and we can also exercise.

热心.en: The neighbor is very enthusiastic and often helps out.

热心.zh: 他热心帮助每一位新同事。
热心.en: He enthusiastically helps every new colleague.

热心.zh: 虽然他不认识我，但还是热心地指了路。
热心.en: Although he didn't know me, he still kindly gave directions.

热心.zh: 因为她的热心，我们很快就适应了新环境。
热心.en: Thanks to her warmth, we quickly adapted to the new environment.

就业.en: The employment pressure is very high lately.

就业.zh: 他毕业后很快就找到了就业机会。
就业.en: He found a job opportunity soon after graduation.

就业.zh: 政府出台了很多政策来促进就业。
就业.en: The government has introduced many policies to promote employment.

就业.zh: 这个专业的就业前景怎么样？
就业.en: What is the employment outlook for this major?

就业.zh: 如果你有实习经验，就业会更容易一些。
就业.en: If you have internship experience, finding a job will be easier.

有利于.en: More exercise is beneficial to health.

有利于.zh: 早睡早起有利于保持良好的状态。
有利于.en: Going to bed early and waking up early helps maintain a good condition.

有利于.zh: 这个政策有利于小企业的发展。
有利于.en: This policy is beneficial to the development of small businesses.

有利于.zh: 多读书有利于开阔眼界。
有利于.en: Reading more books is beneficial for broadening one's horizons.

有利于.zh: 合作有利于双方，所以我们应该好好谈谈。
有利于.en: Cooperation benefits both sides, so we should talk it over.

时常.en: She often goes to that coffee shop.

时常.zh: 虽然工作忙，我们时常保持联系。
时常.en: Although work is busy, we often stay in touch.

时常.zh: 他时常提醒自己要耐心一点。
时常.en: He often reminds himself to be a little more patient.

时常.zh: 小时候，我时常跟爷爷去公园散步。
时常.en: When I was little, I often went for walks in the park with my grandpa.

彩色.en: He bought a box of colored pencils.

彩色.zh: 彩色电视现在已经很普遍了。
彩色.en: Color TVs are now very common.

彩色.zh: 她喜欢穿彩色衣服，看起来很有活力。
彩色.en: She likes to wear colorful clothes, which looks very energetic.

彩色.zh: 虽然打印机是黑白的，但她想要彩色的效果。
彩色.en: Although the printer is black and white, she wants a color effect.

纷纷.zh: 听说要放假，同学们纷纷讨论去哪儿玩。
纷纷.en: Hearing about the holiday, the students were all discussing where to go.

纷纷.zh: 这家店打折，顾客们纷纷抢购。
纷纷.en: This store had a sale, and customers rushed to buy in droves.

纷纷.zh: 虽然天气不好，但游客们还是纷纷来拍照。
纷纷.en: Although the weather was bad, tourists still came to take photos in succession.

纷纷.zh: 消息一传开，朋友们纷纷发来祝贺。
纷纷.en: As soon as the news spread, friends sent congratulations one after another.

高跟鞋.zh: 她穿了一双红色高跟鞋。
高跟鞋.en: She wore a pair of red high heels.

高跟鞋.zh: 穿高跟鞋走太久，脚会很疼。
高跟鞋.en: Walking too long in high heels will make your feet hurt.

高跟鞋.zh: 她买了一双新高跟鞋，因为要去参加婚礼。
高跟鞋.en: She bought a new pair of high heels because she is going to a wedding.

高跟鞋.zh: 虽然高跟鞋很好看，但我不喜欢走路不方便。
高跟鞋.en: Although high heels look nice, I don't like the inconvenience of walking.

高跟鞋.zh: 她每次穿高跟鞋上班，下班后就立刻换拖鞋。
高跟鞋.en: Every time she wears high heels to work, she immediately changes to slippers after work.

上涨.zh: 房价一直在上涨，很多人买不起房。
上涨.en: Housing prices have been rising, so many people can't afford a house.

上涨.zh: 因为成本上涨，这家餐厅提高了菜单价格。
上涨.en: Because costs have risen, this restaurant increased its menu prices.

上涨.zh: 股票上涨的时候，他很开心。
上涨.en: When the stock market goes up, he is very happy.

上涨.zh: 虽然工资没有上涨，但物价却涨得很快。
上涨.en: Although wages haven't increased, prices have risen quickly.

单元.zh: 这个课本一共有十个单元。
单元.en: This textbook has ten units in total.

单元.zh: 这个小区每个单元都有电梯。
单元.en: Every unit in this residential area has an elevator.

单元.zh: 我们学完第四单元之后，会有一个小测验。
单元.en: After we finish Unit 4, there will be a quiz.

单元.zh: 他家的门牌号是这个单元的三零一。
单元.en: His house number is 301 in this unit.

流传.en: This legend has been circulating for a long time.

流传.zh: 网上流传着很多不实的消息。
流传.en: There are many false rumors spreading online.

流传.zh: 这个歌谣在村里流传了几代人。
流传.en: This folk song has been passed down in the village for generations.

流传.zh: 虽然这个故事流传很广，但没人知道是不是真的。
流传.en: Although this story is widespread, no one knows if it's true.

流传.zh: 他写的那首诗歌在学校里流传开来。
流传.en: The poem he wrote spread around the school.

海关.zh: 我们过了海关才能上飞机。
海关.en: We have to go through customs before boarding the plane.
Customs inspection of luggage is very strict.

海关.zh: 她带了很多化妆品，结果被海关扣下了。
海关.en: She brought a lot of cosmetics, and they were detained by customs.

海关.zh: 如果你带太多现金，过海关时要申报。
海关.en: If you bring too much cash, you need to declare it when passing through customs.

海关.zh: 海关官员问了他几个问题，然后就放行了。
海关.en: The customs officer asked him a few questions and then let him go.

消极.en: He has been very negative emotionally lately.

消极.zh: 这件事对他产生了消极影响。
消极.en: This matter had a negative impact on him.

消极.zh: 遇到困难时，不要总是消极对待。
消极.en: When encountering difficulties, don't always deal with them passively.

消极.zh: 虽然情况不好，但他并没有变得消极。
消极.en: Although the situation is bad, he did not become negative.

消极.zh: 老板批评了他，他反而更消极工作了。
消极.en: After the boss criticized him, he became even more passive in his work.

简历.zh: 他投了简历，但一直没有回音。
简历.en: He submitted his resume but hasn't heard back.

简历.zh: 找工作之前，最好先更新一下简历。
简历.en: Before looking for a job, it's best to update your resume.

简历.zh: 因为简历写得很好，他很快就得到了面试机会。
简历.en: Because his resume was well-written, he quickly got an interview opportunity.

简历.zh: 她花了一整天修改简历，还让朋友帮忙检查。
简历.en: She spent a whole day revising her resume and even asked a friend to check it.

自觉.zh: 你要自觉一点，别总是让人提醒。
自觉.en: You need to be more self-disciplined, don't always need reminders.

自觉.zh: 大家都自觉排队，没有人插队。
自觉.en: Everyone lined up voluntarily, no one cut in line.

自觉.zh: 他自觉地把垃圾带走了。
自觉.en: He conscientiously took the trash away.

自觉.zh: 虽然老师不在，但同学们仍然自觉学习。
自觉.en: Although the teacher was not there, the students still studied on their own.

自觉.zh: 如果你不自觉地保持安静，别人会觉得很吵。
自觉.en: If you don't consciously keep quiet, others will find it noisy.

收看.en: There's a live broadcast tonight, remember to watch.

收看.zh: 很多人通过手机收看新闻。
收看.en: Many people watch the news through their phones.

收看.zh: 因为没时间，他只能收看回放。
收看.en: Because he had no time, he could only watch the replay.

收看.zh: 她每天都会准时收看天气预报。
收看.en: She watches the weather forecast on time every day.

海外.zh: 这家公司在海外有很多业务。
海外.en: This company has a lot of business overseas.

海外.zh: 虽然他在海外工作，但是每年都回家过年。
海外.en: Although he works overseas, he comes home every year for the New Year.

海外.zh: 我朋友从海外带回来一些特产。
海外.en: My friend brought back some local specialties from overseas.

海外.zh: 海外的生活虽然精彩，但也会想家。
海外.en: Life overseas is exciting, but you still get homesick.

摔倒.zh: 老奶奶在街上摔倒了，有人扶她。
摔倒.en: The old lady fell on the street, and someone helped her up.

摔倒.zh: 他跑步的时候不小心摔倒了，膝盖破了。
摔倒.en: He accidentally fell while running and scraped his knee.

摔倒.zh: 冰面太滑了，我差点摔倒。
摔倒.en: The ice was so slippery, I almost fell.

摔倒.zh: 因为地面很湿，她走路时摔倒了，手机也碎了。
摔倒.en: Because the ground was wet, she fell while walking and her phone broke.

专心.en: You need to listen attentively in class.

专心.zh: 他专心工作，没听见电话响。
专心.en: He was focused on work and didn't hear the phone ring.

专心.zh: 如果你不专心，就很容易出错。
专心.en: If you don't concentrate, it's easy to make mistakes.

专心.zh: 她专心地看着书，连饭都忘了吃。
专心.en: She was so absorbed in reading that she forgot to eat.

专心.zh: 为了考试，我不得不专心复习，连手机都关机了。
专心.en: For the exam, I had to concentrate on reviewing and even turned off my phone.

公务员.zh: 很多人想考公务员，因为工作稳定。
公务员.en: Many people want to become civil servants because the job is stable.

公务员.zh: 她当了五年公务员，最近升职了。
公务员.en: She has been a civil servant for five years and recently got promoted.

公务员.zh: 虽然公务员的工资不高，但是福利不错。
公务员.en: Although civil servants' salaries are not high, the benefits are good.

公务员.zh: 我朋友去年考上公务员了，现在在税务局工作。
公务员.en: My friend passed the civil service exam last year and now works at the tax bureau.

中介.zh: 他通过中介找到的工作。
中介.en: He found the job through an agency.

中介.zh: 买房的时候，中介费是一笔不小的开销。
中介.en: When buying a house, the agent's fee is a significant expense.

中介.zh: 这家中介的服务很好，推荐给你。
中介.en: This agency has great service; I recommend it to you.

中介.zh: 我想租房，但是不想找中介，太贵了。
中介.en: I want to rent a place, but I don't want to use an agent; it's too expensive.

中介.zh: 中介说这套房子很抢手，让我们赶紧决定。
中介.en: The agent said this apartment is in high demand and told us to decide quickly.

看望.en: I went to the hospital to visit him.

看望.zh: 春节的时候，我们回家看望父母。
看望.en: During the Spring Festival, we go home to visit our parents.

看望.zh: 她每个周末都去看望奶奶，陪她聊天。
看望.en: She visits her grandmother every weekend and chats with her.

看望.zh: 虽然很忙，他还是抽空去看望了老朋友。
看望.en: Although he was very busy, he took time to visit an old friend.

看望.zh: 等我放假了，一定要去乡下看望外公外婆。
看望.en: When I have a break, I definitely want to go to the countryside to visit my grandparents.

热量.en: This cake is high in calories.

热量.zh: 跑步可以消耗很多热量。
热量.en: Running can burn a lot of calories.

热量.zh: 吃东西前看看热量表，对减肥有帮助。
热量.en: Checking the calorie chart before eating can help with weight loss.

热量.zh: 虽然热量低，但营养很丰富。
热量.en: Although it's low in calories, it's very nutritious.

热量.zh: 夏天喝冰水，身体要消耗热量来加热它。
热量.en: Drinking ice water in summer makes your body burn calories to warm it up.

早晚.en: He will come back sooner or later.
I brush my teeth every morning and evening.

早晚.zh: 你早晚得面对这个问题。
早晚.en: Sooner or later, you'll have to face this problem.

早晚.zh: 早晚温差大，记得多穿点衣服。
早晚.en: The temperature difference between morning and evening is large; remember to wear more clothes.

早晚.zh: 如果你继续这样，早晚会后悔的。
早晚.en: If you keep doing this, you'll regret it sooner or later.

亏.en: This deal lost quite a bit of money.

亏.zh: 幸亏你提醒，不然我就亏了。
亏.en: Thanks for reminding me, otherwise I would have suffered a loss.

亏.zh: 他炒股亏了，心情很不好。
亏.en: He lost money in the stock market and is in a bad mood.

亏.zh: 虽然亏了一点，但总比全亏了好。
亏.en: Although I lost a little, it's better than losing everything.

亏.zh: 做生意有赚有亏，别太在意。
亏.en: In business, you win some and lose some; don't take it too seriously.

救护车.en: The ambulance arrived at the scene very quickly.

救护车.zh: 他心脏病发作，被救护车送去了医院。
救护车.en: He had a heart attack and was taken to the hospital by ambulance.

救护车.zh: 路上堵车，救护车开不过去。
救护车.en: There was a traffic jam, and the ambulance couldn't get through.

救护车.zh: 听到救护车的声音，大家自动让出了路。
救护车.en: When people heard the ambulance siren, they automatically made way.

键盘.zh: 我昨天买了一个新的机械键盘，手感很好。
键盘.en: I bought a new mechanical keyboard yesterday, it feels great.

键盘.zh: 如果你喜欢玩游戏，试试这个键盘。
键盘.en: If you like playing games, try this keyboard.

键盘.zh: 我不喜欢这个键盘的按键太硬。
键盘.en: I don't like that this keyboard's keys are too stiff.

实用.zh: 这件衣服既好看又实用，我经常穿。
实用.en: This clothing is both good-looking and practical, I wear it often.

实用.zh: 虽然这个工具不贵，但是很实用。
实用.en: Although this tool is not expensive, it is very practical.

实用.zh: 我觉得这个功能很实用，可以省很多时间。
实用.en: I think this function is very practical, can save a lot of time.

繁荣.zh: 随着经济发展，小城镇也越来越繁荣。
繁荣.en: With economic development, small towns are also becoming more prosperous.

繁荣.zh: 因为旅游业的发展，当地经济变得很繁荣。
繁荣.en: Because of the development of tourism, the local economy has become very prosperous.

繁荣.zh: 这条商业街晚上特别繁荣，人来人往。
繁荣.en: This commercial street is especially bustling at night, with people coming and going.

递给.en: Please hand the book to me.
He handed the keys to me.

递给.zh: 她一边说话一边把文件递给我。
递给.en: She handed me the document while talking.

递给.zh: 他递给我一张纸条，上面写着地址。
递给.en: He handed me a note, on it was written the address.

册.en: I bought three volumes of books.
The content of this volume is very interesting.

册.zh: 这套书一共有十册，我只看完了一册。
册.en: This set of books has ten volumes total, I only finished one.

册.zh: 图书馆里有很多册历史书。
册.en: There are many volumes of history books in the library.

长度.zh: 你量一下这根绳子的长度。
长度.en: Measure the length of this rope.

长度.zh: 虽然宽度不一样，但长度是一样的。
长度.en: Although the width is different, the length is the same.

长度.zh: 这条路的长度大概有两公里。
长度.en: The length of this road is about two kilometers.

被子.en: The quilt has been aired already.
She folded the quilt very neatly.

被子.zh: 今天太冷了，我需要再拿一床被子。
被子.en: Today is too cold, I need to get another quilt.

被子.zh: 因为天气潮湿，所以被子需要经常晒。
被子.en: Because the weather is humid, the quilt needs to be aired often.

车库.en: The car is parked in the garage.
There's no car in the garage.

车库.zh: 我家有一个很大的车库。
车库.en: My house has a very big garage.

车库.zh: 如果你要开车，先把车从车库开出来。
车库.en: If you want to drive, first pull the car out of the garage.

车库.zh: 新建的小区都有地下车库。
车库.en: Newly built residential areas all have underground garages.

签订.zh: 他们签订了一个三年的租约。
两家公司今天签订了一份合作协议。
签订.en: Two companies signed a cooperation agreement today.

签订.zh: 经过多次谈判，双方终于签订了协议。
签订.en: After many rounds of negotiation, both parties finally signed the agreement.

迎.en: A gust of wind blew in the face.

迎.zh: 既然客人来了，我们快去迎一下。
迎.en: Since the guests have arrived, let's quickly go welcome them.

迎.zh: 新年到了，大家都在迎新年。
迎.en: The New Year has arrived, everyone is welcoming the new year.

鸭子.zh: 我家楼下有只鸭子，每天都叫。
鸭子.en: There's a duck downstairs at my place that quacks every day.

鸭子.zh: 我们点了一只烤鸭，但鸭子太肥了。
鸭子.en: We ordered a roast duck, but it was too fatty.

鸭子.zh: 虽然我喜欢吃鸭子，但自己不会做。
鸭子.en: Although I like eating duck, I can't cook it myself.

车主.zh: 那个车主把车停在路中间了。
车主.en: That car owner parked right in the middle of the road.

车主.zh: 如果你是车主，请把车挪一下。
车主.en: If you are the owner, please move your car.

车主.zh: 因为车主没留电话，我们只能等。
车主.en: Because the owner didn't leave a phone number, we can only wait.

车主.zh: 这辆车被刮了，车主正在找监控。
车主.en: This car got scratched, and the owner is looking for surveillance footage.

赏.en: Let's go to the park to enjoy the flowers.
How about enjoying the moon tonight?
He likes to enjoy the scenery by the lake.

赏.zh: 周末我们一起去赏樱花，顺便拍照。
赏.en: This weekend let's go see the cherry blossoms and take photos while we're at it.

赏.zh: 虽然下雨了，但我们还是去赏了梅花。
赏.en: Even though it was raining, we still went to admire the plum blossoms.

引进.zh: 这家工厂引进了先进技术。
引进.en: This factory has introduced advanced technology.

引进.zh: 学校引进了几位外教老师。
引进.en: The school brought in a few foreign teachers.

引进.zh: 为了提升效率，我们引进了自动化设备。
引进.en: To improve efficiency, we introduced automated equipment.

引进.zh: 虽然引进新系统需要成本，但长期看很划算。
引进.en: Although introducing a new system costs money, it's worth it in the long run.

排列.en: These books are arranged by size.
Arrange the seats into two rows.
The names are arranged alphabetically by last name.

排列.zh: 电脑会自动排列文件顺序。
排列.en: The computer will automatically arrange the file order.

排列.zh: 他喜欢把玩具排列得整整齐齐。
排列.en: He likes to arrange his toys neatly in order.

用不着.en: You don't need to worry about this.
Bringing so much stuff is unnecessary.

用不着.zh: 明天用不着穿太多衣服。
用不着.en: You won't need to wear too many clothes tomorrow.

用不着.zh: 我自己能搞定，用不着帮忙。
用不着.en: I can handle it myself, no need for help.

用不着.zh: 既然大家都知道了，用不着再解释一遍。
用不着.en: Since everyone already knows, there's no need to explain again.

充电.en: My phone is dead, I need to charge it.
I forgot the charger, what now?

充电.zh: 我习惯睡前给手机充电。
充电.en: I'm used to charging my phone before bed.

充电.zh: 因为明天要出远门，记得把充电宝充满。
充电.en: Since we're going on a trip tomorrow, remember to fully charge the power bank.

用途.en: Do you know what it's used for?
This medicine is used for pain relief.

用途.zh: 不同用途的笔要分开放。
用途.en: Pens for different purposes should be stored separately.

用途.zh: 这款软件的主要用途是处理图片，还能编辑视频。
用途.en: The main use of this software is to process images, and it can also edit videos.

促销.en: The mall is having a promotion.

促销.zh: 促销期间买东西很划算。
促销.en: It's a good deal to buy things during a promotion.

促销.zh: 这家店促销活动到月底。
促销.en: This store's promotion runs until the end of the month.

促销.zh: 因为促销，我忍不住买了好多东西。
促销.en: Because of the promotion, I couldn't resist buying a lot of things.

促销.zh: 促销商品虽然便宜，但要注意保质期。
促销.en: Promotional items are cheap, but you need to check the expiration date.

加热.en: Heat up the rice a bit.
The microwave heats things up quickly.
The milk needs to be heated before drinking.
Food tastes better after being heated.

加热.zh: 如果不加热，这道菜吃起来太凉了。
加热.en: If you don't heat it up, this dish will be too cold to eat.

称赞.zh: 老师常常称赞他学习认真。
称赞.en: The teacher often praises him for studying diligently.

称赞.zh: 大家都称赞这家餐厅的菜很好吃。
称赞.en: Everyone praises the food at this restaurant as very delicious.

称赞.zh: 虽然她没说什么，但心里很希望得到称赞。
称赞.en: Although she didn't say anything, she really hoped to receive praise in her heart.

称赞.zh: 你这次做得这么好，值得被称赞。
称赞.en: You did so well this time; you deserve to be praised.

称赞.zh: 他因为帮助了老人，受到邻居们的称赞。
称赞.en: He was praised by the neighbors because he helped an elderly person.

电动.zh: 我买了一辆电动自行车。
这个电动牙刷充一次电能用一个月。
电动.en: This electric toothbrush can last a month on one charge.

电动.zh: 现在很多人出门都骑电动滑板车。
电动.en: Nowadays many people ride electric scooters when going out.

电动.zh: 因为汽油涨价，他决定换成电动汽车。
电动.en: Because gas prices rose, he decided to switch to an electric car.

电动.zh: 弟弟喜欢玩各种电动玩具，特别是遥控车。
电动.en: My younger brother likes to play with all kinds of electric toys, especially remote control cars.

赠送.zh: 这家店买一送一，赠送的商品也很不错。
赠送.en: This store has a buy-one-get-one-free offer, and the free gift is also quite good.

赠送.zh: 他生日那天，朋友们赠送了很多礼物。
赠送.en: On his birthday, his friends gave him many gifts.

赠送.zh: 参加活动的人都能免费赠送一个小礼品。
赠送.en: Everyone who participates in the event can receive a free small gift.

赠送.zh: 这本书是作者签名版，买书时还会赠送书签。
赠送.en: This book is a signed edition by the author, and it comes with a free bookmark.

赠送.zh: 为了感谢老顾客，商场会赠送购物券。
赠送.en: To thank regular customers, the mall gives away shopping vouchers.

不得了.zh: 外面吵得不得了，我根本睡不着。
不得了.en: It's so noisy outside, I simply can't sleep.

不得了.zh: 他考上清华了，他爸妈高兴得不得了。
不得了.en: He got into Tsinghua University; his parents are extremely happy.

不得了.zh: 这件事要是传出去，那可不得了。
不得了.en: If this matter gets out, that would be a big deal.

不得了.zh: 最近天气热得不得了，每天都想开空调。
不得了.en: The weather has been terribly hot lately; I feel like turning on the air conditioner every day.

不得了.zh: 她发现自己丢了钱包，急得不得了。
不得了.en: She realized she had lost her wallet and was extremely anxious.

标题.zh: 这篇文章的标题很吸引人。
标题.en: The title of this article is very attractive.

标题.zh: 你写报告的时候，记得加一个清楚的标题。
标题.en: When you write a report, remember to add a clear title.

标题.zh: 新闻标题常常为了吸引眼球而夸大事实。
标题.en: News headlines often exaggerate the facts to grab attention.

标题.zh: 我看完电影，却忘了电影叫什么标题。
标题.en: I finished watching the movie, but I forgot what the title was.

标题.zh: 这个视频的标题写了‘必看’，我觉得有点夸张。
标题.en: The title of this video says 'must watch'; I think it's a bit exaggerated.

预报.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雨。
预报.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

预报.zh: 没有预报的话，我们不知道明天要不要带伞。
预报.en: Without a forecast, we wouldn't know whether to bring an umbrella tomorrow.

预报.zh: 地震预报目前还不太准确，很难提前预知。
预报.en: Earthquake forecasts are currently not very accurate; it's hard to predict in advance.

预报.zh: 你看了明天的降雨预报吗？可能有大雨。
预报.en: Did you check tomorrow's rainfall forecast? There might be heavy rain.

预报.zh: 交通预报提醒大家，下班高峰期可能会堵车。
预报.en: The traffic forecast reminds everyone that there may be traffic jams during the evening rush hour.

窄.zh: 这条路太窄了，车子进不去。
窄.en: This road is too narrow; cars can't get in.

窄.zh: 他家的门很窄，搬大沙发得侧着进来。
窄.en: The door of his house is very narrow; to move the big sofa in, you have to turn it sideways.

窄.zh: 虽然巷子很窄，但是两边有很多小店。
窄.en: Although the alley is very narrow, there are many small shops on both sides.

窄.zh: 这件衣服肩膀的地方有点窄，穿着不太舒服。
窄.en: This shirt is a bit narrow at the shoulders; it's not very comfortable to wear.

窄.zh: 以前人们的思想比较窄，现在开放多了。
窄.en: In the past, people's thinking was relatively narrow; now it's much more open.

点心.zh: 我下午喜欢喝杯茶，配两块点心。
点心.en: I like to have a cup of tea with a couple of pastries in the afternoon.

点心.zh: 这家店的广式点心做得特别地道。
点心.en: The Cantonese dim sum at this restaurant is especially authentic.

点心.zh: 她周末自己做了些小点心，带给同事们尝尝。
点心.en: She made some small pastries over the weekend and brought them for her colleagues to try.

点心.zh: 去朋友家做客，带一盒点心当礼物很不错。
点心.en: When visiting a friend's home, bringing a box of pastries as a gift is a good idea.

点心.zh: 早茶的时候，我们点了虾饺、烧卖好几样点心。
点心.en: During morning tea, we ordered several types of dim sum like shrimp dumplings and siu mai.

番茄.zh: 我最喜欢吃的菜是番茄炒蛋。
番茄.en: My favorite dish is scrambled eggs with tomatoes.

番茄.zh: 超市的番茄今天特价，买了一大袋。
番茄.en: The tomatoes at the supermarket are on sale today; I bought a big bag.

番茄.zh: 这个番茄酱味道很浓，适合做意大利面。
番茄.en: This ketchup has a strong flavor and is suitable for making pasta.

番茄.zh: 他种了几棵番茄在阳台上，已经结果了。
番茄.en: He planted a few tomato plants on the balcony, and they have already borne fruit.

番茄.zh: 做沙拉的时候，我习惯加一些番茄和黄瓜。
番茄.en: When making salad, I usually add some tomatoes and cucumbers.

比喻.en: This metaphor is used very appropriately.

比喻.zh: 他说话很喜欢用比喻，让人容易理解。
比喻.en: He likes to use metaphors when speaking, making it easy for people to understand.

比喻.zh: 老师说‘人生就像一场旅行’是一个常见的比喻。
比喻.en: The teacher said 'Life is like a journey' is a common metaphor.

比喻.zh: 写作文的时候，多用一些比喻可以更生动。
比喻.en: When writing an essay, using more metaphors can make it more vivid.

比喻.zh: 她用一个比喻来形容她当时的感受，非常贴切。
比喻.en: She used a metaphor to describe her feelings at that time, and it was very apt.

新郎.en: The groom looks very handsome today.

新郎.zh: 婚礼上，新郎激动得说不出话来。
新郎.en: At the wedding, the groom was so excited he couldn't speak.

新郎.zh: 新郎和新娘在台上互相交换了戒指。
新郎.en: The groom and the bride exchanged rings on stage.

新郎.zh: 大家都夸新郎长得又高又帅。
新郎.en: Everyone praised the groom for being tall and handsome.

新郎.zh: 新郎的朋友们正在为他准备一个惊喜。
新郎.en: The groom's friends are preparing a surprise for him.

到期.zh: 这个优惠券下个月就要到期了，快用吧。
到期.en: This coupon expires next month, better use it soon.

到期.zh: 房租到期了，我明天去交。
到期.en: The rent is due; I'll pay it tomorrow.

到期.zh: 合同到期之后，公司没有跟我续约。
到期.en: After the contract expired, the company didn't renew it with me.

到期.zh: 你的会员卡还有三天就到期了。
到期.en: Your membership card expires in just three days.

修建.en: The village is building a new road.

修建.zh: 工人们正在修建一座新的立交桥。
修建.en: Workers are constructing a new overpass.

修建.zh: 这座公园是去年才修建好的。
修建.en: This park was only finished being built last year.

修建.zh: 他们计划在河边修建一个大型游泳馆。
修建.en: They plan to build a large swimming pool by the river.

修建.zh: 因为修建地铁，这条路封了半年。
修建.en: This road has been closed for half a year due to subway construction.

高大.en: He has a tall and sturdy build.

高大.zh: 那个篮球运动员特别高大。
高大.en: That basketball player is exceptionally tall and big.

高大.zh: 这座建筑看起来很雄伟高大。
高大.en: This building looks very grand and towering.

高大.zh: 虽然他很高大，但是性格很温柔。
高大.en: Although he is tall and big, he has a gentle personality.

高大.zh: 我站在高大的城墙下面，感到自己很渺小。
高大.en: Standing beneath the tall city wall, I felt very small.

为主.en: This restaurant's dishes are mainly spicy.

为主.zh: 这次招聘以有经验的人为主。
为主.en: This recruitment focuses primarily on experienced people.

为主.zh: 他的工作以写报告为主。
为主.en: His work mainly involves writing reports.

为主.zh: 在学校里，学习还是以课堂为主。
为主.en: At school, learning is still mainly done in the classroom.

为主.zh: 我们的讨论应以解决问题为主。
为主.en: Our discussion should focus primarily on solving problems.

光临.zh: 欢迎下次再来光临我们店。
光临.en: You are welcome to visit our store again next time.

光临.zh: 周末有空的话，欢迎光临我家吃饭。
光临.en: If you're free this weekend, you're welcome to come over for dinner.

光临.zh: 这家餐厅经常有名人光临。
光临.en: This restaurant often has famous people visiting.

光临.zh: 感谢各位光临今天的婚礼。
光临.en: Thank you all for attending today's wedding.

逐步.zh: 我们要逐步解决这个问题。
逐步.en: We need to solve this problem step by step.

逐步.zh: 他们正在逐步推广新的系统。
逐步.en: They are gradually rolling out the new system.

逐步.zh: 随着时间推移，他的病逐步痊愈了。
逐步.en: As time went on, his illness gradually healed.

逐步.zh: 公司计划逐步扩大海外市场。
逐步.en: The company plans to gradually expand into overseas markets.

动画.zh: 最近有一部国产动画非常火。
动画.en: Recently, a domestically produced animated film has become very popular.

动画.zh: 他长大后梦想是做动画导演。
动画.en: He dreams of becoming an animation director when he grows up.

动画.zh: 小时候，我每天放学回家就看动画。
动画.en: When I was little, I watched cartoons every day after school.

整齐.en: The desks and chairs in the classroom are very neat.
Her books are arranged very neatly.

整齐.zh: 士兵们排着整齐的队伍走过广场。
整齐.en: The soldiers marched across the square in neat formation.

整齐.zh: 请把衣服叠整齐放回衣柜里。
整齐.en: Please fold the clothes neatly and put them back in the closet.

整齐.zh: 他把房间收拾得很整齐。
整齐.en: He cleaned the room and made it very tidy.

常识.en: Many people lack common sense in daily life.

常识.zh: 遇到火灾时，要懂得逃生常识。
常识.en: In case of a fire, you need to know common sense about escape.

常识.zh: 这种常识你应该从小就知道。
常识.en: You should have known this kind of common sense since childhood.

常识.zh: 作为成年人，这些法律常识必须知道。
常识.en: As an adult, you must know these basic legal facts.

可见.en: So you don't really know him.

可见.zh: 他每天都来得很早，可见他很有责任心。
可见.en: He comes very early every day, so he is very responsible.

可见.zh: 她考试及格了，可见复习很有用。
可见.en: She passed the exam, so reviewing is very useful.

可见.zh: 天气这么冷，可见冬天真的来了。
可见.en: It's so cold, so winter has really come.

无奈.en: With no choice, he had to give up.

无奈.zh: 他不想去，但无奈家人不同意。
无奈.en: He didn't want to go, but reluctantly his family disagreed.

无奈.zh: 无奈时间不够，我们只能下次再聊。
无奈.en: Unfortunately there wasn't enough time, we can only talk next time.

无奈.zh: 她无奈地摇摇头，什么也没说。
无奈.en: She helplessly shook her head and said nothing.

研制.en: They are developing a new medicine.

研制.zh: 这款手机研制了好几年。
研制.en: This phone took several years to develop.

研制.zh: 科学家们花了很多钱来研制疫苗。
研制.en: Scientists spent a lot of money to develop the vaccine.

研制.zh: 这个公司专门研制自动驾驶汽车。
研制.en: This company specializes in developing self-driving cars.

研制.zh: 经过多次失败，他们终于研制成功了。
研制.en: After many failures, they finally succeeded in the development.

成年.en: After becoming an adult, he moved out.

成年.zh: 成年人的世界没有容易二字。
成年.en: In the adult world, there is no such thing as easy.

成年.zh: 她成年那天，收到了很多礼物。
成年.en: On the day she became an adult, she received many gifts.

成年.zh: 虽然成年了，但他还是像个小孩子。
成年.en: Although he is an adult, he still acts like a child.

职工.en: All employees of the company participated.
The employee benefits are very good.

职工.zh: 这个工厂有五百多名职工。
职工.en: This factory has over five hundred employees.

职工.zh: 职工们对加班很有意见。
职工.en: The staff have strong opinions about overtime.

职工.zh: 公司给每位职工都买了保险。
职工.en: The company bought insurance for every employee.

木头.en: This table is made of wood.
He stood like a block of wood.

木头.zh: 这些木头可以用来做家具。
木头.en: These pieces of wood can be used to make furniture.
Wooden houses are warm in winter and cool in summer.

木头.zh: 别那么木头木脑的，快过来帮忙！
木头.en: Don't be so wooden-headed, come over and help!

格外.en: Your performance today is especially good.

格外.zh: 她今天穿得格外漂亮，好像要去约会。
格外.en: She dressed especially pretty today, as if going on a date.

格外.zh: 因为放假，大家的心情都格外轻松。
格外.en: Because of the holiday, everyone's mood is especially relaxed.
He is especially careful, afraid of making mistakes.

大象.zh: 我在动物园看到了大象。
大象.en: I saw elephants at the zoo.

大象.zh: 泰国有很多大象，游客可以骑它们。
大象.en: Thailand has many elephants; tourists can ride them.

大象.zh: 小朋友们都喜欢看大象表演。
大象.en: Children all like to watch elephant shows.

讲座.zh: 我去听了一场英语讲座。
这个讲座是关于如何理财的。
讲座.en: This lecture is about how to manage finances.

讲座.zh: 讲座结束后，大家可以提问。
讲座.en: After the lecture, everyone can ask questions.

讲座.zh: 他每个周末都会去听历史讲座。
讲座.en: He goes to history lectures every weekend.

长远.en: You need to have long-term vision.
We need to make long-term plans.

长远.zh: 投资不能只看眼前，要考虑长远利益。
长远.en: Investment can't only look at the present; you must consider long-term benefits.

长远.zh: 从长远来看，这个决定是正确的。
长远.en: From a long-term perspective, this decision is correct.

长远.zh: 公司需要找到长远的发展方向。
长远.en: The company needs to find a long-term development direction.

迷路.en: I'm lost, can you help me?

迷路.zh: 小时候我在商场里迷路过一次。
迷路.en: I got lost in the mall once when I was a child.

迷路.zh: 如果你迷路了，就打开导航吧。
迷路.en: If you get lost, just turn on the navigation.

迷路.zh: 昨天去新公司面试，结果迷路迟到了。
迷路.en: Yesterday I went for an interview at a new company, but I got lost and was late.

迷路.zh: 虽然我方向感很差，但很少迷路。
迷路.en: Although I have a poor sense of direction, I rarely get lost.

印刷.en: This book is printed very clearly.

印刷.zh: 我们需要印刷五百份宣传单。
印刷.en: We need to print five hundred flyers.

印刷.zh: 现在的印刷技术越来越先进了。
印刷.en: Printing technology nowadays is getting more and more advanced.

印刷.zh: 因为印刷错误，这批海报要重做。
印刷.en: Due to a printing error, this batch of posters needs to be redone.

印刷.zh: 他开了一家印刷店，生意还不错。
印刷.en: He opened a printing shop, and the business is doing quite well.

外形.zh: 这个杯子的外形很可爱。
外形.en: The shape of this cup is very cute.

外形.zh: 新型汽车的外形更流线型了。
外形.en: The new car has a more streamlined shape.

外形.zh: 虽然外形不同，但功能是一样的。
外形.en: Although the shapes are different, the functions are the same.

外形.zh: 我喜欢这个手机的外形，但颜色不太喜欢。
外形.en: I like the design of this phone, but I don't really like the color.

外形.zh: 这款音箱不仅外形时尚，音质也很好。
外形.en: This speaker is not only stylish in appearance, but also has great sound quality.

制成.zh: 这个雕像是用大理石制成的。
制成.en: This statue is made of marble.

制成.zh: 他们用旧瓶子制成了一盏灯。
制成.en: They made a lamp out of old bottles.

制成.zh: 这种纸是由竹子制成的，很环保。
制成.en: This type of paper is made from bamboo, it's very eco-friendly.

制成.zh: 如果你把这些原料混合，就能制成一种新药。
制成.en: If you mix these ingredients, you can make a new medicine.

赠.en: This book was given to me by a friend.

赠.zh: 公司赠每位员工一张购物卡。
赠.en: The company gave each employee a shopping card.

赠.zh: 他赠了我一幅自己画的油画。
赠.en: He gave me an oil painting he painted himself.

赠.zh: 参加活动的人都会获赠一份小礼品。
赠.en: Everyone who participates in the event will receive a small gift.

赠.zh: 她赠给图书馆一批珍贵的古籍。
赠.en: She donated a batch of precious ancient books to the library.

舍不得.zh: 我舍不得扔掉这件旧衣服。
舍不得.en: I can't bear to throw away this old clothes.

舍不得.zh: 她舍不得孩子离开家去外地读书。
舍不得.en: She can't bear to let her child leave home to study elsewhere.

舍不得.zh: 这顿饭太好吃了，我真舍不得吃完。
舍不得.en: This meal is so delicious, I really hate to finish it.

舍不得.zh: 虽然手机旧了，但我舍不得换新的。
舍不得.en: Although my phone is old, I'm reluctant to replace it with a new one.

舍不得.zh: 因为舍不得花钱，他很久没买新鞋了。
舍不得.en: Because he hates to spend money, he hasn't bought new shoes in a long time.

大爷.zh: 楼下的大爷每天早晨都练太极。
大爷.en: The old man downstairs practices tai chi every morning.

大爷.zh: 这位大爷八十岁了，身体还特别好。
大爷.en: This old gentleman is eighty years old and still in great shape.

大爷.zh: 小区里的大爷们喜欢在树下下棋。
大爷.en: The old men in the neighborhood like to play chess under the tree.

大爷.zh: 隔壁大爷教我种花，他特别有经验。
大爷.en: The old man next door taught me how to grow flowers; he is very experienced.

熟人.en: He is an acquaintance of mine.
What a coincidence to run into an acquaintance here.

熟人.zh: 我不太喜欢跟熟人借钱。
熟人.en: I don't really like borrowing money from acquaintances.

熟人.zh: 因为有熟人帮忙，事情办得很顺利。
熟人.en: Because an acquaintance helped, things went very smoothly.

熟人.zh: 虽然我们算是熟人，但平时很少联系。
熟人.en: Although we are considered acquaintances, we rarely keep in touch.

报到.en: I'll report to the company tomorrow.

报到.zh: 新生要在九月一号报到。
报到.en: New students need to register on September 1st.

报到.zh: 他刚报到就被派去出差了。
报到.en: He was sent on a business trip right after he reported for duty.

报到.zh: 请你在八点之前到前台报到。
报到.en: Please report to the front desk before eight o'clock.

报到.zh: 因为路上堵车，我到学校报到晚了半个小时。
报到.en: Because of traffic jam, I was half an hour late for registration at school.

初期.en: The initial phase of the project went very smoothly.
The cure rate for cancer in its early stages is very high.

初期.zh: 公司初期只有五个员工。
初期.en: The company only had five employees in its early days.

初期.zh: 感冒初期多喝热水就能好。
初期.en: In the early stage of a cold, drinking plenty of hot water can help you recover.

初期.zh: 虽然初期遇到了很多困难，但我们坚持下来了。
初期.en: Although we encountered many difficulties in the early stages, we persevered.

搞好.en: You need to first improve the relationship.

搞好.zh: 我们得搞好这次活动才行。
搞好.en: We have to make this event go well.

搞好.zh: 只有搞好基础，以后才能发展。
搞好.en: Only by solidifying the foundation can we develop later.

搞好.zh: 你要是能搞好这个项目，老板肯定高兴。
搞好.en: If you can handle this project well, the boss will definitely be happy.

搞好.zh: 他为了搞好同事关系，经常请大家吃饭。
搞好.en: In order to improve relations with coworkers, he often treats everyone to dinner.

敲门.en: Someone is knocking on the door.

敲门.zh: 她轻轻敲了敲门，没人答应。
敲门.en: She knocked lightly on the door, but no one answered.

敲门.zh: 如果你不敲门就直接进，会很不礼貌。
敲门.en: If you just walk in without knocking, it's very rude.

敲门.zh: 晚上十点有人敲门，我心里有点害怕。
敲门.en: Someone knocked on the door at ten at night, and I was a bit scared.

因而.zh: 他生病了，因而没来上课。
因而.en: He was sick, so he didn't come to class.

因而.zh: 这条路在修，因而我们只能绕道。
因而.en: This road is under repair, so we have to take a detour.

因而.zh: 他工作很努力，因而得到了晋升。
因而.en: He worked very hard, and therefore got a promotion.

因而.zh: 天气突然变冷，因而很多人都感冒了。
因而.en: The weather suddenly turned cold, so many people caught colds.

因而.zh: 她没有提前准备，因而考试时很紧张。
因而.en: She didn't prepare in advance, so she was very nervous during the exam.

在线.zh: 我每天都在线学习英语。
在线.en: I study English online every day.

在线.zh: 这个游戏需要在线才能玩。
在线.en: This game requires being online to play.

在线.zh: 如果你在线的话，我们视频聊吧。
在线.en: If you're online, let's video chat.

在线.zh: 现在很多人都喜欢在线购物，方便又省时间。
在线.en: Now many people like online shopping—it's convenient and saves time.

河流.zh: 我们家乡有一条很长的河流。
河流.en: There is a very long river in my hometown.
Both banks of the river are lined with willow trees.

河流.zh: 由于污染，这条河流已经不能游泳了。
河流.en: Because of pollution, you can no longer swim in this river.

河流.zh: 他喜欢沿着河流散步，觉得心情很平静。
河流.en: He likes to walk along the river; he finds it very calming.

通行.en: This road is closed to traffic.

通行.zh: 这个证件可以通行所有区域。
通行.en: This ID allows passage through all areas.

通行.zh: 施工期间，车辆无法通行。
通行.en: During construction, vehicles cannot pass through.

通行.zh: 只有持票的人才能通行这个入口。
通行.en: Only people with tickets can enter through this gate.

通行.zh: 大雪封路，山里已经无法通行了。
通行.en: The road is blocked by heavy snow, and you can no longer get through the mountains.

学历.zh: 现在很多工作都要求本科学历。
学历.en: Many jobs nowadays require a bachelor's degree.

学历.zh: 他虽然学历不高，但能力很强。
学历.en: Although he doesn't have a high degree, he is very capable.

学历.zh: 公司招聘时特别看重学历和经验。
学历.en: The company values education and experience a lot when hiring.

学历.zh: 他靠自己的努力拿到了研究生学历。
学历.en: He earned a master's degree through his own hard work.

一代.en: This is a memory of a generation.

一代.zh: 新一代手机比旧款快很多。
一代.en: The new generation of phones is much faster than the old ones.

一代.zh: 他们那一代人都吃过很多苦。
一代.en: People of that generation all suffered a lot.

一代.zh: 这个游戏风靡了一代人。
一代.en: This game was wildly popular for a generation.

一代.zh: 每一代人都有自己的梦想和挑战。
一代.en: Every generation has its own dreams and challenges.

纪念日.zh: 今天是我们的结婚纪念日。
他们每年都庆祝这个纪念日。
纪念日.en: They celebrate this anniversary every year.

纪念日.zh: 这个纪念日对他们来说非常重要。
纪念日.en: This anniversary is very important to them.

纪念日.zh: 她在纪念日那天给妈妈准备了礼物。
纪念日.en: She prepared a gift for her mom on that anniversary day.

纪念日.zh: 为了纪念日，他特意订了一家高级餐厅。
纪念日.en: For the anniversary, he specially booked a high-end restaurant.

增大.en: The volume needs to be increased.

增大.zh: 运动可以增大你的肺活量。
增大.en: Exercise can increase your lung capacity.

增大.zh: 随着时间推移，风险也会增大。
增大.en: As time goes on, the risk will also increase.

增大.zh: 他通过锻炼来增大肌肉。

美术.en: My younger brother likes fine arts.

美术.zh: 她周末去美术班学画画，因为想当画家。
美术.en: She goes to art class on weekends because she wants to become a painter.

美术.zh: 美术老师让我们下节课带水彩颜料。
美术.en: The art teacher asked us to bring watercolor paints for the next class.

美术.zh: 虽然我不太懂美术，但是看画展挺有意思的。
美术.en: Although I don't know much about fine arts, visiting an art exhibition is quite interesting.

美术.zh: 这家书店二楼卖美术用品，比如画笔和画纸。
美术.en: This bookstore sells art supplies on the second floor, such as brushes and drawing paper.

聘请.en: The company hired a new manager.

聘请.zh: 学校聘请了一位外教来教英语口语。
聘请.en: The school hired a foreign teacher to teach spoken English.

聘请.zh: 因为项目需要，他们临时聘请了两位工程师。
聘请.en: Because the project needed it, they temporarily hired two engineers.

聘请.zh: 如果聘请专家指导，效果会好很多。
聘请.en: If we hire an expert for guidance, the results will be much better.

聘请.zh: 那家公司正在聘请程序员。
聘请.en: That company is currently hiring programmers.

门诊.en: The outpatient clinic opens at eight o'clock.

门诊.zh: 他感冒了，去门诊挂号看医生。
门诊.en: He caught a cold and went to the outpatient clinic to register and see a doctor.

门诊.zh: 我早上先去门诊拿药，然后再去上班。
门诊.en: I'll first go to the outpatient clinic to get medicine in the morning, then go to work.

门诊.zh: 这家医院的门诊服务很不错，排队时间短。
门诊.en: This hospital's outpatient service is very good, with short waiting times.
The outpatient doctor is very patient.

故乡.zh: 每年春节我都回故乡看望父母。
故乡.en: Every Spring Festival I go back to my hometown to visit my parents.

故乡.zh: 虽然我在大城市工作，但心里一直想念故乡。
故乡.en: Although I work in a big city, I always miss my hometown in my heart.

故乡.zh: 故乡的变化很大，很多老房子都拆了。
故乡.en: My hometown has changed a lot; many old houses have been demolished.

故乡.zh: 他常常谈起故乡的小河。
故乡.en: He often talks about the small river in his hometown.

家务.zh: 她每天下班回家还要做家务，很辛苦。
家务.en: She still has to do housework after returning home from work every day; it's very tiring.

家务.zh: 如果大家分担家务，家里就会更整洁。
家务.en: If everyone shares the housework, the home will be tidier.

家务.zh: 家务活很多，比如洗碗、拖地、洗衣服。
家务.en: There is a lot of housework, such as washing dishes, mopping the floor, and doing laundry.

海鲜.zh: 我们去海边旅游的时候吃了很多新鲜海鲜。
海鲜.en: When we traveled to the seaside, we ate a lot of fresh seafood.

海鲜.zh: 虽然海鲜很美味，但有些人吃了会过敏。
海鲜.en: Although seafood is delicious, some people get allergic reactions after eating it.

海鲜.zh: 这家餐馆的海鲜品种特别多，有虾、蟹、鱼。
海鲜.en: This restaurant has a great variety of seafood, including shrimp, crab, and fish.

邮票.zh: 我收集了很多外国邮票，都是从网上买的。
邮票.en: I have collected many foreign stamps, all bought online.

邮票.zh: 如果你要寄信，需要先贴上邮票才能投递。
邮票.en: If you want to send a letter, you need to put a stamp on it before mailing.

邮票.zh: 这套纪念邮票发行量很少，很有收藏价值。
邮票.en: This set of commemorative stamps had a very limited print run and is highly collectible.
The post office sells all kinds of stamps.

开幕.zh: 电影节的开幕式请了很多明星来助阵。
开幕.en: The opening ceremony of the film festival invited many celebrities to support it.

开幕.zh: 因为天气不好，运动会的开幕推迟到了下午。
开幕.en: Because of bad weather, the opening of the sports meet was postponed to the afternoon.

开幕.zh: 这家新店开幕第一天就排起了长队。
开幕.en: This new store had a long line on its opening day.
The opening ceremony was very splendid.

树木.zh: 公园里的树木长得非常茂盛，夏天很凉快。
树木.en: The trees in the park are very lush, making it cool in summer.

树木.zh: 如果不保护树木，环境会变得越来越差。
树木.en: If we don't protect trees, the environment will get worse and worse.

树木.zh: 这些古老的树木已经有几百年的历史了。
树木.en: These ancient trees have a history of several hundred years.
Both sides of the road are planted with trees.

武术.zh: 中国武术有很多门派，比如少林和武当。
武术.en: Chinese martial arts have many schools, such as Shaolin and Wudang.

武术.zh: 虽然武术看起来很难，但坚持练习就能进步。
武术.en: Although martial arts look difficult, you can improve with persistent practice.

武术.zh: 他从小喜欢武术，现在已经是武术教练了。
武术.en: He has liked martial arts since childhood, and now he is already a martial arts coach.
The martial arts performance was very exciting.

开幕式.en: What time does the opening ceremony start?

开幕式.zh: 明天的开幕式有谁参加？
开幕式.en: Who is attending tomorrow's opening ceremony?

开幕式.zh: 因为下雨，开幕式推迟了。
开幕式.en: The opening ceremony was postponed because of the rain.

开幕式.zh: 虽然开幕式很热闹，但我还是觉得有点无聊。
开幕式.en: Although the opening ceremony was lively, I still found it a bit boring.

开幕式.zh: 奥运会的开幕式非常精彩。
开幕式.en: The Olympic opening ceremony was very spectacular.

特有.en: This is a snack unique to Sichuan.

特有.zh: 熊猫是中国特有的动物。
特有.en: The panda is an animal unique to China.

特有.zh: 这种植物是这个地区特有的。
特有.en: This plant is unique to this region.

特有.zh: 每个地方都有自己特有的文化。
特有.en: Every place has its own unique culture.

特有.zh: 因为气候不同，这里特有的一些水果在别处吃不到。
特有.en: Because the climate is different, some fruits unique to here cannot be eaten elsewhere.

领带.zh: 他今天打了一条蓝色领带。
领带.en: He wore a blue tie today.
This tie is a birthday gift.

领带.zh: 你帮我系一下领带好吗？
领带.en: Can you help me tie my tie?

领带.zh: 我觉得红领带配白衬衫很好看。
领带.en: I think a red tie looks great with a white shirt.

领带.zh: 因为要去面试，他特意买了条新领带。
领带.en: Because he had a job interview, he specially bought a new tie.

闹钟.en: The alarm clock is ringing, get up quickly!
I set the alarm clock for seven o'clock.

闹钟.zh: 我的闹钟坏了，今天迟到了。
闹钟.en: My alarm clock broke, so I was late today.

闹钟.zh: 虽然设了闹钟，但我还是没听见。
闹钟.en: Even though I set the alarm clock, I still didn't hear it.

闹钟.zh: 出国旅行时，我习惯用手机当闹钟。
闹钟.en: When traveling abroad, I'm used to using my phone as an alarm clock.

熬夜.en: Don't stay up late; it's bad for your health.
He stayed up late last night watching the ball game.

熬夜.zh: 考试前我经常熬夜复习。
熬夜.en: I often stay up late reviewing before exams.

熬夜.zh: 因为工作太多，他不得不熬夜。
熬夜.en: Because there was too much work, he had to stay up late.

熬夜.zh: 虽然知道熬夜不好，但有时控制不了。
熬夜.en: Although I know staying up late is bad, sometimes I can't help it.

折扣.zh: 这个商场最近有折扣活动。
折扣.en: This mall has a discount event recently.

折扣.zh: 我用会员卡拿到了更多折扣。
折扣.en: I got more discounts with my membership card.

折扣.zh: 虽然折扣很大，但我还是没买。
折扣.en: Even though the discount was big, I still didn't buy it.

折扣.zh: 网上买东西折扣多，但要小心质量。
折扣.en: There are many discounts when shopping online, but you have to be careful about quality.

主观.en: You can't be too subjective when making judgments.

主观.zh: 他的观点很主观，缺乏客观依据。
主观.en: His opinion is very subjective and lacks objective basis.

主观.zh: 虽然这是主观感受，但我也理解。
主观.en: Although this is a subjective feeling, I also understand it.

主观.zh: 我们要尽量客观，减少主观影响。
主观.en: We should try to be objective and reduce subjective influence.

缩短.en: This road shortens the time by ten minutes.

缩短.zh: 我们需要缩短会议时间。
缩短.en: We need to shorten the meeting time.

缩短.zh: 因为工期紧张，他们缩短了休息时间。
缩短.en: Because the project deadline was tight, they shortened the break time.

缩短.zh: 新技术可以缩短生产周期。
缩短.en: New technology can shorten the production cycle.

缩短.zh: 虽然想缩短距离，但没办法。
缩短.en: Although I want to shorten the distance, there's no way to do it.

先后.zh: 我们先后做了两次实验。
先后.en: We did two experiments in succession.

先后.zh: 这两个问题先后被解决。
先后.en: These two problems were solved one after another.
Three people came looking for me in succession.

先后.zh: 因为顺序不同，先后结果也不一样。
先后.en: Because the order is different, the outcomes in succession are also different.

气球.en: Children like to play with balloons.

气球.zh: 生日派对上有很多彩色气球。
气球.en: There were many colorful balloons at the birthday party.

气球.zh: 虽然气球很漂亮，但容易爆炸。
气球.en: Although balloons are very pretty, they are easy to pop.

气球.zh: 她吹了一个大大的红色气球。
气球.en: She blew up a big red balloon.

敢于.zh: 他敢于承认自己的错误。
敢于.en: He dares to admit his own mistakes.

敢于.zh: 你敢不敢于在大家面前演讲？
敢于.en: Do you dare to give a speech in front of everyone?

敢于.zh: 只有敢于尝试，才有可能成功。
敢于.en: Only by daring to try is it possible to succeed.

敢于.zh: 她是个敢于挑战传统观念的人。
敢于.en: She is a person who dares to challenge traditional ideas.

敢于.zh: 虽然很危险，但他还是敢于一个人去探险。
敢于.en: Although it was very dangerous, he still dared to go exploring alone.

摩托.en: He rides a motorcycle to work.

摩托.zh: 我表弟买了一辆新摩托，颜色很酷。
摩托.en: My cousin bought a new motorcycle, and the color is very cool.

摩托.zh: 路上摩托太多，开车要小心。
摩托.en: There are too many motorcycles on the road, so drive carefully.

摩托.zh: 他每天骑摩托接送孩子上下学，风雨无阻。
摩托.en: He rides a motorcycle to pick up and drop off his children from school every day, rain or shine.

烤肉.zh: 周末朋友聚会，我们打算在家自己烤肉。
烤肉.en: For the weekend gathering with friends, we plan to barbecue at home.

烤肉.zh: 这家店的烤肉酱味道很棒，我每次都点。
烤肉.en: The barbecue sauce at this restaurant tastes great; I order it every time.

烤肉.zh: 烤肉的时候要注意火候，不然容易烤焦。
烤肉.en: When grilling meat, you need to watch the heat, otherwise it's easy to burn it.

长途.zh: 这个周末我要跑一趟长途。
长途.en: This weekend I have to make a long-distance trip.

长途.zh: 长途开车很累，最好有人换着开。
长途.en: Long-distance driving is very tiring; it's best to have someone to swap driving.

长途.zh: 他坐长途火车回老家过年。
长途.en: He took a long-distance train back to his hometown for the New Year.

长途.zh: 长途电话费现在比以前便宜多了。
长途.en: Long-distance phone charges are now much cheaper than before.

长途.zh: 虽然路途遥远，但他坚持每年都做一次长途旅行。
长途.en: Although the journey is far, he insists on taking a long-distance trip every year.

书房.en: His study is full of books.

书房.zh: 这个书房虽然不大，但是很安静。
书房.en: This study is not big, but it's very quiet.

书房.zh: 她把书房布置得很温馨，适合工作。
书房.en: She arranged the study very cozily, suitable for working.

书房.zh: 我每天都会在书房里待两个小时，处理邮件和读书。
书房.en: I spend two hours in the study every day, dealing with emails and reading.

广大.zh: 广大市民都支持这个决定。
广大.en: The general public supports this decision.

广大.zh: 这款手机深受广大年轻人的喜爱。
广大.en: This phone is very popular among the vast number of young people.

广大.zh: 广大农民朋友今年收成不错，都很高兴。
