广大.en: The vast number of farmer friends have had a good harvest this year and are all very happy.

广大.zh: 我们希望广大读者能多提宝贵意见。
广大.en: We hope that the broad readership can offer valuable suggestions.

总数.en: The total number of students in the class is thirty.

总数.zh: 我们统计了报名人数，总数超过两百。
总数.en: We counted the number of registrations, and the total exceeded two hundred.

总数.zh: 今年公司的销售额总数比去年增长了百分之十。
总数.en: This year, the company's total sales increased by ten percent compared to last year.

总数.zh: 他把所有物品的价格加起来，算出了总数。
总数.en: He added up the prices of all the items and calculated the total.

剪刀.en: This pair of scissors is very sharp.

剪刀.zh: 我用剪刀把包装打开了。
剪刀.en: I used the scissors to open the package.

剪刀.zh: 剪刀放哪了？我找不到了。
剪刀.en: Where are the scissors? I can't find them.

剪刀.zh: 剪纸需要一把好用的剪刀，不然剪不直。
剪刀.en: Paper cutting needs a good pair of scissors, otherwise you can't cut straight.

合影.zh: 这张合影里有很多老朋友。
合影.en: This group photo has many old friends in it.

合影.zh: 他拿出手机，邀请全家人一起合影留念。
合影.en: He took out his phone and invited the whole family to take a group photo as a souvenir.

食用.en: This kind of mushroom is edible.

食用.zh: 食用之前请先清洗干净。
食用.en: Please wash it clean before consumption.

食用.zh: 这个油是专门用来食用的，不是工业用油。
食用.en: This oil is specifically for edible use, not industrial oil.

食用.zh: 过期食品不可食用，容易引起中毒。
食用.en: Expired food is not edible and can easily cause poisoning.

食用.zh: 这种植物虽然好看，但它的果实不能食用。
食用.en: Although this plant looks nice, its fruit is not edible.

熟练.zh: 虽然刚学不久，但他操作机器已经很熟练了。
熟练.en: Although he just learned not long ago, he is already very skilled at operating the machine.

熟练.zh: 她打字非常熟练，一分钟能打一百多个字。
熟练.en: She types very proficiently, can type over 100 words per minute.

熟练.zh: 我对这个软件还不够熟练，需要多练习。
熟练.en: I'm not yet proficient with this software, I need more practice.

熟练.zh: 熟练的工人能很快完成工作。
熟练.en: Skilled workers can finish the job quickly.

过期.zh: 这些药品已经过期了，不能再用了。
过期.en: These medicines have expired and can no longer be used.

过期.zh: 虽然看起来还好，但食品过期了就不能吃。
过期.en: Although it looks okay, if food is expired you can't eat it.

过期.zh: 你的驾照过期了，快去换新的。
过期.en: Your driver's license expired, go get a new one soon.

过期.zh: 我把过期的杂志都扔掉了。
过期.en: I threw away all the expired magazines.

大于.zh: 这个数必须大于零才能继续计算。
大于.en: This number must be greater than zero to continue the calculation.

大于.zh: 如果温度大于三十度，我就不出门了。
大于.en: If the temperature is greater than 30 degrees, I won't go out.

大于.zh: 他的年龄大于我，但他看起来比我年轻。
大于.en: His age is greater than mine, but he looks younger than me.
In math, the greater-than sign is '>'.

中期.en: This is the mid-term report of the project.

中期.zh: 到了中期，我们需要检查一下进度。
中期.en: When we reach the mid-term, we need to check the progress.

中期.zh: 因为前期准备充分，中期执行得很顺利。
中期.en: Because the preparation in the early stage was sufficient, the mid-term execution went smoothly.

中期.zh: 他打算在中期考试后请假去旅行。
中期.en: He plans to take leave to travel after the mid-term exams.

中期.zh: 这个世纪中期发生了很多大事。
中期.en: Many big events happened in the middle of this century.

里头.en: There is something inside the box.

里头.zh: 他口袋里头装了很多零钱。
里头.en: He has a lot of change in his pocket.

里头.zh: 不仅外面好看，里头也很精致。
里头.en: Not only does it look good outside, but the inside is also exquisite.

里头.zh: 这本书里头有很多有用的信息。
里头.en: This book contains a lot of useful information.

里头.zh: 把钥匙放在抽屉里头吧。
里头.en: Put the keys in the drawer.

及格.en: I passed the exam this time.

及格.zh: 他成绩不好，但刚好及格了。
及格.en: His grades were not good, but he just barely passed.

及格.zh: 虽然复习了很久，但还是没及格。
及格.en: Although I reviewed for a long time, I still didn't pass.

及格.zh: 及格线是六十分，你考了六十一分。
及格.en: The passing line is 60 points, you scored 61.

及格.zh: 老师说他再努力一点就能及格。
及格.en: The teacher said if he tries a bit harder, he can pass.

存放.zh: 请把食物存放在冰箱里。
存放.en: Please store the food in the fridge.

存放.zh: 贵重物品最好存放在保险柜里。
存放.en: Valuables are best stored in a safe.

存放.zh: 因为空间有限，我们只能存放少量货物。
存放.en: Because space is limited, we can only store a small amount of goods.

存放.zh: 这些文件需要存放在干燥的地方。
存放.en: These documents need to be stored in a dry place.

存放.zh: 他把旧书存放在地下室里。
存放.en: He stored the old books in the basement.

讲究.en: She is very particular about dressing.

讲究.zh: 这家餐厅很讲究食材的新鲜。
讲究.en: This restaurant pays great attention to the freshness of ingredients.

讲究.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但他们并不讲究质量。
讲究.en: Although the price is cheap, they are not particular about quality.

讲究.zh: 喝茶有很多讲究，比如水温、时间。
讲究.en: Drinking tea has many specifics, such as water temperature and time.

讲究.zh: 他做事很讲究方法，所以效率高。
讲究.en: He is very particular about methods, so he is efficient.

科研.en: He mainly engages in scientific research work.

科研.zh: 这所大学在科研方面投入了很多资金。
科研.en: This university has invested a lot of funds in scientific research.

科研.zh: 由于科研经费充足，他们取得了重大突破。
科研.en: Because the research funding was sufficient, they achieved a major breakthrough.

科研.zh: 科研人员需要经常阅读最新文献。
科研.en: Researchers need to regularly read the latest literature.

科研.zh: 她决定毕业后继续做科研。
科研.en: She decided to continue doing research after graduation.

高效.zh: 我们需要找到一种高效的解决方案。
高效.en: We need to find an efficient solution.

高效.zh: 如果团队合作好，工作会更高效。
高效.en: If the team cooperates well, work will be more efficient.

高效.zh: 这台机器高效节能，很受欢迎。
高效.en: This machine is efficient and energy-saving, very popular.

高效.zh: 他利用高效的学习方法，很快就掌握了新知识。
高效.en: He used efficient learning methods and quickly mastered new knowledge.

虫子.en: There is a bug on the floor.

虫子.zh: 我最怕虫子了，看到就躲。
虫子.en: I'm most afraid of bugs; I hide as soon as I see one.

虫子.zh: 菜里居然有条虫子，太恶心了。
虫子.en: There's actually a worm in the vegetables, so disgusting.

虫子.zh: 虽然虫子很小，但它也会咬人。
虫子.en: Although the bug is very small, it can still bite people.

虫子.zh: 花园里的虫子太多了，我得买点杀虫剂。
虫子.en: There are too many bugs in the garden; I need to buy some insecticide.

此前.en: I didn't expect you would come before this.
He had never been abroad before this.

此前.zh: 此前我们已经讨论过这个问题了。
此前.en: We had already discussed this issue before this.

此前.zh: 因为此前下过雨，路上很滑。
此前.en: Because it had rained before this, the road was very slippery.

此前.zh: 这款手机此前卖得很好，但现在不行了。
此前.en: This phone model sold very well before this, but not now.

词汇.en: Learning a foreign language requires memorizing a lot of vocabulary.

词汇.zh: 这篇文章里有很多生僻词汇。
词汇.en: This article has many rare vocabulary words.

词汇.zh: 他每天用app背两百个词汇。
词汇.en: He uses an app to memorize two hundred vocabulary words every day.

词汇.zh: 如果你想提高写作，先丰富自己的词汇。
词汇.en: If you want to improve your writing, first enrich your vocabulary.

大米.en: Today I bought two jin of rice.

大米.zh: 超市里的大米又涨价了。
大米.en: The rice in the supermarket has gone up in price again.

大米.zh: 我们家的米缸快空了，得再买点大米。
大米.en: Our rice jar is almost empty; we need to buy more rice.

大米.zh: 他喜欢用大米煮粥，再加点红枣。
大米.en: He likes to cook rice porridge and add some red dates.

傍晚.en: The scenery at dusk is especially beautiful.

傍晚.zh: 他每天傍晚都去公园散步。
傍晚.en: He goes for a walk in the park every evening.

傍晚.zh: 等到傍晚，气温就会凉快一些。
傍晚.en: By the time evening comes, the temperature will be a bit cooler.

傍晚.zh: 虽然现在是傍晚，但天还亮着。
傍晚.en: Although it's evening now, the sky is still bright.

失恋.en: He recently went through a breakup.

失恋.zh: 失恋之后她哭了好几天。
失恋.en: After the breakup, she cried for several days.

失恋.zh: 闺蜜失恋了，我得陪陪她。
失恋.en: My best friend is heartbroken; I need to keep her company.

失恋.zh: 失恋虽然痛苦，但时间会治好一切。
失恋.en: Although a breakup is painful, time heals everything.

失恋.zh: 他因为失恋而辞掉了工作。
失恋.en: He quit his job because of a breakup.

工艺.en: This craft piece is very exquisite.

工艺.zh: 他学的专业是工艺设计。
这个花瓶的制作工艺很复杂。
工艺.en: The craftsmanship of this vase is very complex.

工艺.zh: 老师傅教我们传统的陶瓷工艺。
工艺.en: The master teaches us traditional ceramic craftsmanship.

工艺.zh: 虽然工艺古老，但至今仍有人使用。
工艺.en: Although the craftsmanship is ancient, people still use it today.

不要紧.en: You have a cold? It's not serious, right?
He said it's okay, it doesn't matter.

不要紧.zh: 虽然迟到了，但只要不耽误工作就不要紧。
不要紧.en: Although we're late, as long as it doesn't delay work, it's fine.

不要紧.zh: 你不用担心，伤口不大，不要紧。
不要紧.en: Don't worry, the wound is small, it's not serious.

领取.en: Please come here to collect the tickets.

领取.zh: 他领取了上个月的工资。
毕业时我们要领取毕业证书。
领取.en: Upon graduation, we need to pick up our diplomas.

领取.zh: 凭身份证可以免费领取一份资料。
领取.en: With your ID card, you can claim a free copy of the material.

领取.zh: 如果通过了考试，你就可以领取驾照。
领取.en: If you pass the exam, you can collect your driver's license.

行人.en: There are many pedestrians on the road.

行人.zh: 那个路口经常有行人闯红灯。
行人.en: Pedestrians often run red lights at that intersection.

行人.zh: 虽然是绿灯，也要注意看看旁边的行人。
行人.en: Even if the light is green, you should also watch out for nearby pedestrians.

行人.zh: 街道两旁的行人都在匆匆赶路。
行人.en: The pedestrians on both sides of the street are all hurrying along.

初级.en: I just started learning elementary Chinese.

初级.zh: 这本教材是给初级学生用的。
初级.en: This textbook is for elementary-level students.

初级.zh: 虽然我学的是初级课程，但是进步很快。
初级.en: Although I'm taking the elementary course, I'm improving quickly.

初级.zh: 初级班的学生每天都要练习发音。
初级.en: Students in the elementary class practice pronunciation every day.

初级.zh: 如果初级考试通过了，就可以升中级班。
初级.en: If you pass the elementary exam, you can move up to the intermediate class.

外公.en: My maternal grandfather is eighty years old this year.

外公.zh: 外公喜欢每天早上去公园散步。
外公.en: Grandpa likes to go to the park for a walk every morning.

外公.zh: 因为外公住在乡下，所以我们经常周末去看他。
外公.en: Because Grandpa lives in the countryside, we often visit him on weekends.

外公.zh: 外公做的红烧肉特别好吃。
外公.en: The braised pork that Grandpa makes is especially delicious.

外公.zh: 我小时候，外公常常给我讲故事。
外公.en: When I was little, Grandpa often told me stories.

增多.en: Recently, the number of tourists has clearly increased.

增多.zh: 因为天气变暖，犯罪率持续增多。
增多.en: Because the weather is getting warmer, the crime rate keeps increasing.

增多.zh: 如果再不控制，犯罪率会持续增多。
增多.en: If we don't control it, the crime rate will continue to increase.

增多.zh: 超市里的商品种类增多了不少。
增多.en: The variety of goods in the supermarket has increased a lot.

增多.zh: 参加活动的人数增多了，所以场地需要扩大。
增多.en: The number of participants increased, so the venue needs to be expanded.

展出.zh: 美术馆正在展出新作品。
展出.en: The art museum is exhibiting new works.

展出.zh: 这次展出吸引了很多观众。
虽然展出时间很短，但是反响很热烈。
展出.en: Although the exhibition was very short, the response was enthusiastic.

展出.zh: 我们学校在图书馆展出了学生画作。
展出.en: Our school exhibited student paintings in the library.

展出.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去公园看花卉展出。
展出.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go to the park to see the flower exhibition.

路人.en: That passerby showed me the way.

路人.zh: 路人看到事故都停下来帮忙。
路人.en: Passersby saw the accident and stopped to help.

路人.zh: 虽然我只是个路人，但我也很关心这件事。
路人.en: Although I'm just a passerby, I care about this matter too.

路人.zh: 街头采访中，很多路人表达了对环保的看法。
路人.en: In the street interview, many passersby expressed their views on environmental protection.

路人.zh: 如果你问路，尽量找看起来友善的路人。
路人.en: If you ask for directions, try to find a passerby who looks friendly.

信封.en: Please put the letter in the envelope.

信封.zh: 这个信封上贴着漂亮的邮票。
信封.en: There is a beautiful stamp stuck on this envelope.

信封.zh: 我在抽屉里找到了一个旧信封，里面还有照片。
信封.en: I found an old envelope in the drawer, and there were still photos inside.

信封.zh: 他写好了地址，然后把信封封上了。
信封.en: He wrote the address, then sealed the envelope.

信封.zh: 因为信封太小，所以信纸折了好几次。
信封.en: Because the envelope was too small, the letter paper was folded several times.

不能不.zh: 这件事我不能不告诉你。
不能不.en: I have to tell you about this matter.

不能不.zh: 面对困难，我们不能不坚强。
不能不.en: Facing difficulties, we have to be strong.

不能不.zh: 虽然很累，但是为了家人，我不能不努力工作。
不能不.en: Although I'm very tired, for my family, I have to work hard.

不能不.zh: 你犯了错，就不能不承担责任。
不能不.en: If you made a mistake, you have to take responsibility.

不能不.zh: 如果他想成功，就不能不付出更多努力。
不能不.en: If he wants to succeed, he has to put in more effort.

优质.zh: 这家店卖的都是优质产品。
优质.en: This store sells only high-quality products.

优质.zh: 优质服务让顾客非常满意。
优质.en: High-quality service makes customers very satisfied.

优质.zh: 虽然价格高一点，但优质的材料更耐用。
优质.en: Although the price is a bit higher, high-quality materials are more durable.

优质.zh: 我们公司一直追求优质的教育资源。
优质.en: Our company has always pursued high-quality educational resources.

优质.zh: 如果选择优质食材，做出来的菜味道更好。
优质.en: If you choose high-quality ingredients, the dishes will taste better.

硬件.zh: 这台电脑硬件配置很高。
硬件.en: This computer has very high hardware specifications.

硬件.zh: 手机硬件升级后运行更快了。
硬件.en: After the phone's hardware was upgraded, it runs faster.

硬件.zh: 虽然软件免费，但硬件需要自己购买。
硬件.en: Although the software is free, you need to buy the hardware yourself.

硬件.zh: 公司正在投资更新办公硬件。
硬件.en: The company is investing in updating office hardware.

硬件.zh: 如果硬件损坏，数据可能会丢失。
硬件.en: If the hardware is damaged, data may be lost.

改正.zh: 老师让他改正作业里的错字。
改正.en: The teacher told him to correct the wrong characters in his homework.

改正.zh: 虽然他知道问题，但是一直没有改正。
改正.en: Although he knows the problem, he hasn't corrected it yet.

改正.zh: 如果你能及时改正，大家还是会原谅你的。
改正.en: If you can correct it in time, everyone will still forgive you.

改正.zh: 我们要互相提醒，帮助对方改正缺点。
改正.en: We should remind each other and help each other correct shortcomings.

拖鞋.zh: 快换上拖鞋，别把地板踩脏了。
拖鞋.en: Quickly put on slippers, don't dirty the floor.

拖鞋.zh: 我的拖鞋放在门口了，你帮我拿一下。
拖鞋.en: My slippers are at the door; can you grab them for me?

拖鞋.zh: 酒店里的一次性拖鞋穿着不太舒服。
拖鞋.en: The disposable slippers in the hotel are not very comfortable to wear.

拖鞋.zh: 他回家第一件事就是脱掉皮鞋换上拖鞋。
拖鞋.en: The first thing he does when he gets home is take off his leather shoes and put on slippers.

拖鞋.zh: 虽然外面下雨，但穿着拖鞋出门容易滑倒。
拖鞋.en: Although it's raining outside, going out in slippers can easily cause slipping.

游泳池.zh: 夏天我喜欢去游泳池游泳。
游泳池.en: In summer, I like to go swimming in the pool.

游泳池.zh: 这个游泳池的水很干净，每天都有专人清理。
游泳池.en: The water in this swimming pool is very clean; it's cleaned by staff every day.

游泳池.zh: 游泳池边上有很多人在晒太阳。
游泳池.en: There are many people sunbathing by the swimming pool.

游泳池.zh: 因为不会游泳，所以他只在游泳池的浅水区玩。
游泳池.en: Because he can't swim, he only plays in the shallow end of the pool.

游泳池.zh: 我们小区新开了一个室内游泳池，冬天也能游。
游泳池.en: Our neighborhood has a new indoor swimming pool, so you can swim even in winter.

信箱.zh: 信箱里有一封信，记得拿一下。
信箱.en: There's a letter in the mailbox; remember to get it.

信箱.zh: 这个邮箱的信箱已经满了，得清理一下。
信箱.en: This mailbox is full; it needs to be cleaned out.

信箱.zh: 他把钥匙忘在信箱里了，只好找物业帮忙。
信箱.en: He left his keys in the mailbox and had to ask the property management for help.

信箱.zh: 现在很少有人用实体信箱，大家都发电子邮件了。
信箱.en: Nowadays few people use physical mailboxes; everyone sends emails.

信箱.zh: 虽然有了快递柜，但信箱还是用来收账单和明信片。
信箱.en: Although there are parcel lockers, the mailbox is still used for receiving bills and postcards.

山区.zh: 山区里的空气特别新鲜。
山区.en: The air in the mountain area is especially fresh.

山区.zh: 很多山区学校缺乏教学资源。
山区.en: Many schools in mountainous areas lack teaching resources.

山区.zh: 他们开车去山区露营，晚上看到了很多星星。
山区.en: They drove to the mountain area for camping and saw many stars at night.

山区.zh: 因为交通不便，山区里的孩子上学要走很远的路。
山区.en: Because transportation is inconvenient, children in mountainous areas have to walk a long way to school.

山区.zh: 虽然山区风景很美，但生活条件比较艰苦。
山区.en: Although the mountain scenery is beautiful, the living conditions are quite tough.

明信片.zh: 这张明信片是从日本寄来的。
明信片.en: This postcard was sent from Japan.

明信片.zh: 我每到一个地方都会买一张明信片留作纪念。
明信片.en: Every time I go to a new place, I buy a postcard as a souvenir.

明信片.zh: 明信片上写着祝你们新婚快乐。
明信片.en: The postcard says 'Wishing you a happy wedding'.

明信片.zh: 他喜欢收集明信片，已经收藏了上百张了。
明信片.en: He likes collecting postcards and has already collected over a hundred.

明信片.zh: 虽然现在手机很方便，但我还是觉得寄明信片更有心意。
明信片.en: Although smartphones are convenient now, I still think sending postcards is more heartfelt.

好评.en: This restaurant has a lot of good reviews.

好评.zh: 商品质量不错，所以收到了不少好评。
好评.en: The product quality is good, so it has received many positive reviews.

好评.zh: 看到好评如潮，我就放心下单了。
好评.en: Seeing the overwhelming good reviews, I placed my order with confidence.

好评.zh: 服务员态度特别好，难怪网上全是好评。
好评.en: The service staff's attitude is excellent; no wonder all the online reviews are positive.

好评.zh: 虽然价格贵了一点，但用过的人都说好评，所以我也买了。
好评.en: Although the price is a bit high, everyone who has used it gives good reviews, so I bought it too.

驾照.en: Have you got your driver's license?

驾照.zh: 他考了三次才通过驾照考试。
驾照.en: He passed the driver's license test only after three attempts.

驾照.zh: 开车的时候一定要随身携带驾照。
驾照.en: You must always carry your driver's license when driving.

驾照.zh: 因为忘了带驾照，他被交警罚款了。
驾照.en: Because he forgot his driver's license, he was fined by the traffic police.

驾照.zh: 现在很多年轻人刚满十八岁就去学车考驾照。
驾照.en: Nowadays many young people start learning to drive and get their license as soon as they turn eighteen.

水分.en: This fruit has a lot of moisture.

水分.zh: 夏天要多喝水来补充水分。
水分.en: In summer, you need to drink more water to replenish fluids.

水分.zh: 报告里的数据水分太大，根本不可信。
水分.en: The data in the report has too much exaggeration; it's simply not credible.

水分.zh: 黄瓜含有大量水分，吃了容易解渴。
水分.en: Cucumbers contain a lot of water; eating them can quench your thirst easily.

水分.zh: 他说话总是有水分，你别全信。
水分.en: He always exaggerates when he speaks; don't believe everything he says.

爱护.en: We must take care of public facilities.

爱护.zh: 请爱护花草树木，不要随意采摘。
爱护.en: Please take care of the flowers and trees; don't pick them arbitrarily.

爱护.zh: 老师从小就教我们要爱护环境。
爱护.en: Teachers taught us from a young age to protect the environment.

爱护.zh: 这本书已经很旧了，你要爱护它。
爱护.en: This book is already very old; you need to take good care of it.

爱护.zh: 虽然宠物很可爱，但也要有责任心去爱护它们。
爱护.en: Although pets are cute, you also need to have a sense of responsibility to care for them.

辈.en: He is the elder generation in our family.
The older generation are very frugal.

辈.zh: 我们这一辈年轻人喜欢尝试新鲜事物。
辈.en: Our generation of young people likes to try new things.

辈.zh: 论辈分，你应该叫他叔叔。
辈.en: In terms of generation, you should call him uncle.

辈.zh: 虽然年龄差不多，但按辈分来说他是我的侄子。
辈.en: Although we're about the same age, in terms of generation he is my nephew.

黄瓜.en: Help me buy two cucumbers on your way back.

黄瓜.zh: 夏天我喜欢凉拌黄瓜吃。
黄瓜.en: In summer, I like to eat cold cucumber salad.

黄瓜.zh: 冰箱里还有黄瓜，你切一下当配菜吧。
黄瓜.en: There are cucumbers in the fridge; slice them as a side dish.

黄瓜.zh: 他炒了一盘黄瓜鸡蛋，虽然简单但很好吃。
黄瓜.en: He stir-fried a plate of cucumber and eggs; it's simple but delicious.

单一.zh: 他的饮食很单一，几乎天天吃面。
单一.en: His diet is very monotonous; he eats noodles almost every day.

单一.zh: 公司业务太单一，风险很大。
单一.en: The company's business is too singular, and the risk is high.

单一.zh: 虽然工作内容单一，但他做得很认真。
单一.en: Although the work content is monotonous, he does it very carefully.

单一.zh: 别只吃一种水果，营养太单一了，要多样化。
单一.en: Don't just eat one kind of fruit; the nutrition is too limited—diversify.

二手.zh: 我在网上买了个二手手机。
二手.en: I bought a second-hand phone online.

二手.zh: 二手烟对小孩身体不好。
二手.en: Second-hand smoke is bad for children's health.

二手.zh: 他喜欢逛二手书店，能淘到便宜书。
二手.en: He likes browsing second-hand bookstores; he can find cheap books.

二手.zh: 虽然这是二手家具，但保养得很好，跟新的一样。
二手.en: Although this is second-hand furniture, it's well-maintained and looks like new.

现代化.zh: 我们学校设备越来越现代化了。
现代化.en: Our school's equipment is becoming more and more modernized.

现代化.zh: 城市现代化带来很多便利，但污染也更严重了。
现代化.en: Urban modernization brings a lot of convenience, but pollution has also become more serious.

现代化.zh: 老家的医院经过改造，现在完全现代化了。
现代化.en: The hospital in my hometown has been renovated and is now fully modernized.

现代化.zh: 现代化农业用无人机撒农药，效率高多了。
现代化.en: Modernized agriculture uses drones to spray pesticides, which is much more efficient.

优良.zh: 这个品种的苹果品质优良。
优良.en: This variety of apple has excellent quality.

优良.zh: 她养成了优良的生活习惯，早睡早起。
优良.en: She has developed excellent living habits—going to bed early and waking up early.

优良.zh: 这家公司因为服务优良，回头客特别多。
优良.en: This company has excellent service, so it has many repeat customers.

优良.zh: 虽然条件艰苦，但他保持了优良的作风。
优良.en: Although conditions were tough, he maintained excellent conduct.

儿女.en: He has both a son and a daughter.

儿女.zh: 儿女长大了，父母就轻松了。
儿女.en: When children grow up, parents become free.

儿女.zh: 她为了儿女放弃了工作，在家当全职妈妈。
儿女.en: She gave up her job for her children and became a full-time mom at home.

儿女.zh: 不管儿女多大，在父母眼里永远是孩子。
儿女.en: No matter how old children are, they are always kids in their parents' eyes.

儿女.zh: 他工作太忙，很少有时间陪儿女。
儿女.en: He's too busy with work and rarely has time to spend with his children.

账号.en: What is your bank account number?

账号.zh: 这个游戏账号我借给朋友玩了。
账号.en: I lent this game account to a friend to play.

账号.zh: 注册账号时最好用自己常用的邮箱。
账号.en: When registering an account, it's best to use your usual email.

账号.zh: 他的社交账号被盗了，气得他不行。
账号.en: His social media account was hacked, and he was furious.

住宿.en: We booked three nights of accommodation.

住宿.zh: 旅游旺季住宿价格会涨很多。
住宿.en: During the peak tourist season, accommodation prices rise a lot.

住宿.zh: 学校提供住宿，但需要提前申请。
住宿.en: The school provides accommodation, but you need to apply in advance.

住宿.zh: 这次出差公司报销住宿费和交通费。
住宿.en: For this business trip, the company reimburses accommodation and transportation costs.

站台.en: The train hasn't arrived at the platform yet.

站台.zh: 她在站台等了一个小时。
站台.en: She waited on the platform for an hour.
Please go to Platform 3 to wait for the train.

站台.zh: 站台上人很多，我差点挤不上车。
站台.en: There were so many people on the platform that I almost couldn't get on the train.

站台.zh: 送朋友的时候，他在站台一直挥手直到火车看不见。
站台.en: When seeing off his friend, he kept waving on the platform until the train was out of sight.

跑道.en: The plane is taxiing on the runway.

跑道.zh: 他每天在操场跑道上跑十圈。
跑道.en: He runs ten laps on the track every day.

跑道.zh: 新修的跑道又宽又平，跑步很舒服。
跑道.en: The newly built track is wide and flat, very comfortable for running.

跑道.zh: 因为跑道结冰，机场临时关闭了。
跑道.en: The airport was temporarily closed because the runway was icy.

跑道.zh: 运动会的跑道旁边围满了加油的同学。
跑道.en: The sides of the track at the sports meet were packed with cheering classmates.

创业.en: He wants to start a business.

创业.zh: 他创业三年了，公司做得很成功。
创业.en: He has been running his business for three years, and the company is very successful.

创业.zh: 创业虽然很辛苦，但很有成就感。
创业.en: Although starting a business is hard, it gives a sense of achievement.

创业.zh: 很多人创业失败是因为没做好准备。
创业.en: Many people fail in starting a business because they weren't prepared.

创业.zh: 她决定和好朋友一起创业，开一家咖啡店。
创业.en: She decided to start a business with her best friend, opening a coffee shop.

暴雨.en: There was a heavy rainstorm yesterday.

暴雨.zh: 因为暴雨，航班都取消了。
暴雨.en: Flights were cancelled because of the heavy rainstorm.
After the heavy rainstorm, the streets were all covered in water.

暴雨.zh: 天气预报说明天有暴雨，记得带伞。
暴雨.en: The weather forecast says there will be a heavy rainstorm tomorrow, remember to bring an umbrella.

暴雨.zh: 这场暴雨下了一整夜，真可怕。
暴雨.en: This heavy rainstorm lasted all night, it was really scary.

本领.en: Learning a skill is very important.

本领.zh: 他最大的本领就是做饭特别好吃。
本领.en: His greatest skill is cooking really delicious food.

本领.zh: 没有真本领，很难找到好工作。
本领.en: Without real skills, it's hard to find a good job.

本领.zh: 她靠自己的本领，一个人完成了这个项目。
本领.en: She relied on her own skills and completed this project by herself.

勤奋.zh: 勤奋的人运气不会太差。
勤奋.en: Hardworking people don't have too bad luck.

勤奋.zh: 他从小就特别勤奋，每天学习到很晚。
勤奋.en: He has been especially hardworking since he was young, studying until very late every day.

勤奋.zh: 虽然天赋很重要，但勤奋更关键。
勤奋.en: Although talent is important, hard work is more crucial.

勤奋.zh: 老师经常告诉我们，成功需要勤奋和坚持。
勤奋.en: The teacher often tells us that success requires hard work and persistence.

原有.zh: 公司保留了原有的员工。
原有.en: The company kept the original employees.
The original problem hasn't been solved yet.

原有.zh: 他们决定恢复原有的制度。
原有.en: They decided to restore the original system.

原有.zh: 这个房子原有的装修已经很旧了。
原有.en: The original decoration of this house is already very old.

床单.en: She changes the bedsheet once a week.

床单.zh: 新买的床单摸起来很舒服。
床单.en: The newly bought bedsheet feels very comfortable.

床单.zh: 我把床单洗了，今晚要晾干。
床单.en: I washed the bedsheet, and I need to dry it tonight.

试用.zh: 这个产品可以免费试用。
试用.en: This product can be tried for free.

试用.zh: 他还在试用期，工资不高。
试用.en: He is still on probation, so his salary is not high.

试用.zh: 你先试用一下这个软件。
试用之后觉得效果不错。
试用.en: After trying it out, I think the effect is good.

试用.zh: 公司规定试用期为三个月。
试用.en: The company stipulates that the probation period is three months.

雨水.en: There is a lot of rainwater.
Rainwater flows down from the roof.
This year's rainfall is more than last year's.

雨水.zh: 雨水可以收集起来浇花。
雨水.en: Rainwater can be collected to water the flowers.

雨水.zh: 雨水打在窗户上，声音很好听。
雨水.en: The rainwater hits the window, and the sound is very pleasant.

旅行社.zh: 我们在旅行社订了机票。
旅行社.en: We booked the plane tickets through the travel agency.

旅行社.zh: 旅行社安排好了全程的行程。
旅行社.en: The travel agency arranged the entire itinerary.

旅行社.zh: 他毕业后在一家旅行社工作。
旅行社.en: After graduation, he works at a travel agency.

旅行社.zh: 朋友推荐了一家便宜的旅行社。
旅行社.en: A friend recommended a cheap travel agency.

急诊.en: She went to the emergency room.
There are many people in the emergency room.

急诊.zh: 他肚子疼得厉害，被送进了急诊。
急诊.en: He had severe stomach pain and was sent to the emergency room.

急诊.zh: 如果不是急诊，需要排队很久。
急诊.en: If it's not an emergency, you need to wait in line for a long time.

急诊.zh: 医生在急诊室忙了一整夜。
急诊.en: The doctor was busy in the emergency room all night.

柜子.en: There are a lot of clothes in the cupboard.

柜子.zh: 我把书放在柜子上面了。
柜子.en: I put the book on top of the cabinet.

柜子.zh: 这个柜子有点旧了，我想换一个新的。
柜子.en: This cabinet is a bit old, so I want to get a new one.

柜子.zh: 你帮我看看柜子后面有没有钥匙。
柜子.en: Help me check if there are keys behind the cabinet.

柜子.zh: 厨房的柜子该整理了，因为里面太乱了。
柜子.en: The kitchen cabinet needs to be organized because it's too messy inside.

陆地.zh: 飞机终于降落在陆地上。
陆地.en: The plane finally landed on land.

陆地.zh: 乌龟既能在水里游，也能在陆地上走。
陆地.en: Turtles can swim in water and also walk on land.

陆地.zh: 经过三天航行，我们看到了陆地。
陆地.en: After three days of sailing, we saw land.

陆地.zh: 这片陆地原来是一个岛屿的一部分。
陆地.en: This piece of land was originally part of an island.

陆地.zh: 从船上看到陆地时，大家都非常兴奋。
陆地.en: When they saw land from the ship, everyone was very excited.

乘车.en: Please fasten your seatbelt when riding in a vehicle.
I commute by vehicle every day.

乘车.zh: 他乘车去北京，大概需要五个小时。
乘车.en: He is going to Beijing by vehicle, which takes about five hours.

乘车.zh: 如果你乘车的话，记得提前买票。
乘车.en: If you're taking a vehicle, remember to buy tickets in advance.

乘车.zh: 老人乘车可以免费，只要出示证件。
乘车.en: Senior citizens can ride for free as long as they show their ID.

沙子.en: There is a lot of sand on the beach.
I got sand in my shoes.

沙子.zh: 孩子喜欢在沙子里堆城堡。
沙子.en: Kids like to build castles in the sand.

沙子.zh: 风把沙子吹得到处都是。
建房子需要水泥和沙子，还有水。
沙子.en: Building a house requires cement, sand, and water.

学科.zh: 数学是我最喜欢的学科。
大学里有很多不同的学科。
学科.en: There are many different subjects in university.

学科.zh: 这门学科很难，但很有用。
学科.en: This subject is difficult but very useful.

学科.zh: 他选择了经济学作为主要学科。
学科.en: He chose economics as his major subject.

学科.zh: 每个学科都有自己独特的研究方法。
学科.en: Each subject has its own unique research methods.

邮局.en: The post office is next to the bank.
I'm going to the post office to mail a letter.
This post office is already closed.

邮局.zh: 你帮我把这个包裹送到邮局去好吗？
邮局.en: Can you help me take this package to the post office?

邮局.zh: 邮局的营业时间是上午九点到下午五点。
邮局.en: The post office's business hours are from 9 AM to 5 PM.

提倡.zh: 我们应该提倡绿色出行。
现在很多地方都提倡垃圾分类。
提倡.en: Many places now advocate for garbage sorting.

提倡.zh: 政府提倡健康的生活方式，鼓励大家多运动。
提倡.en: The government promotes a healthy lifestyle and encourages people to exercise more.

提倡.zh: 他提倡用环保材料代替塑料，以减少污染。
提倡.en: He advocates using eco-friendly materials instead of plastic to reduce pollution.

产量.en: This year's grain output is very high.

产量.zh: 工厂的产量比去年增加了。
产量.en: The factory's output increased compared to last year.

产量.zh: 因为天气不好，水果产量下降了。
产量.en: Due to bad weather, fruit production decreased.

产量.zh: 提高产量不能以牺牲质量为代价。
产量.en: Increasing output cannot come at the cost of quality.

产量.zh: 这家公司产量大，但质量也很稳定。
产量.en: This company has high output, but its quality is also stable.

南北.en: This railway runs from north to south.

南北.zh: 中国南北气候差异很大。
南北.en: The climate difference between north and south China is huge.
Can you tell the north from the south direction?

南北.zh: 南北方的饮食习惯很不一样。
南北.en: The eating habits in the north and south are very different.

请教.en: I'd like to ask you a question.

请教.zh: 这件事我要请教一下专家。
请教.en: I need to consult an expert about this matter.

请教.zh: 请教一下，这附近有地铁站吗？
请教.en: Excuse me, is there a subway station nearby?

请教.zh: 他经常向老师请教学习方法。
请教.en: He often asks his teacher for study advice.

请教.zh: 如果有不懂的地方，一定要及时请教别人。
请教.en: If there's something you don't understand, be sure to ask someone in time.

昆虫.zh: 花园里有很多昆虫在飞。
昆虫.en: There are many insects flying in the garden.

昆虫.zh: 虽然昆虫很小，但它们在生态系统中很重要。
昆虫.en: Although insects are very small, they are very important in the ecosystem.

昆虫.zh: 小朋友在草地上观察各种昆虫。
昆虫.en: The children are observing various insects on the grass.

昆虫.zh: 如果你不把食物收好，会引来昆虫。
昆虫.en: If you don't put the food away, it will attract insects.

概括.zh: 这篇文章概括了主要观点。
概括.en: This article summarizes the main points.

概括.zh: 他只用了几句话就概括了整个故事。
概括.en: He summarized the whole story in just a few sentences.

概括.zh: 我概括一下今天开会的内容，主要有三点。
概括.en: Let me summarize today's meeting content; there are mainly three points.

概括.zh: 虽然报告很长，但最后一段概括得很清楚。
概括.en: Although the report is long, the last paragraph summarizes it very clearly.

餐饮.en: The food and drink here are good.

餐饮.zh: 我弟弟在餐饮行业工作。
餐饮.en: My younger brother works in the catering industry.

餐饮.zh: 这家酒店提供全天餐饮服务。
餐饮.en: This hotel offers all-day dining service.

餐饮.zh: 为了降低成本，他们调整了餐饮菜单。
餐饮.en: To reduce costs, they adjusted the catering menu.

餐饮.zh: 如果你对餐饮有特殊要求，请提前告诉我们。
餐饮.en: If you have any special dietary requirements, please tell us in advance.

舍得.en: He is willing to spend money on good books.

舍得.zh: 有时候你要舍得放弃才能得到更好的。
舍得.en: Sometimes you have to be willing to give up to get something better.

舍得.zh: 虽然很贵，但他舍得为孩子买这个玩具。
舍得.en: Although it's very expensive, he is willing to buy this toy for his child.

南极.zh: 科学家每年都去南极考察。
南极.en: Scientists go to Antarctica for research every year.

南极.zh: 他梦想有一天能去南极看极光。
南极.en: He dreams of going to Antarctica to see the aurora one day.

南极.zh: 因为气候变暖，南极的冰川正在融化。
南极.en: Because of global warming, the glaciers in Antarctica are melting.

大妈.zh: 广场上有很多大妈在跳舞。
大妈.en: There are many aunties dancing on the square.

大妈.zh: 楼下的大妈每天早上都去公园散步。
大妈.en: The auntie downstairs goes for a walk in the park every morning.

大妈.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但大妈们还是坚持锻炼。
大妈.en: Although the weather is very cold, the aunties still insist on exercising.

大妈.zh: 邻居大妈帮我收了个快递，真是太谢谢她了。
大妈.en: The neighbor auntie received a package for me, I'm so grateful to her.

随手.en: Please close the door behind you.

随手.zh: 他随手把钥匙放在桌上。
随手.en: He casually put the keys on the table.
Remember to turn off the lights when you leave.

随手.zh: 她随手拍了一张照片发到朋友圈。
随手.en: She casually took a picture and posted it on her Moments.

随手.zh: 虽然只是随手写了几笔，但字很好看。
随手.en: Although it was just a few casual strokes, the handwriting is very beautiful.

纪录片.zh: 我喜欢看关于动物的纪录片。
纪录片.en: I like watching documentaries about animals.

纪录片.zh: 他花了一年时间拍摄这部纪录片。
纪录片.en: He spent a year filming this documentary.

纪录片.zh: 如果时间允许，我想多看几部纪录片。
纪录片.en: If time permits, I want to watch a few more documentaries.

纪录片.zh: 昨晚看了一部关于太空的纪录片，学到了很多。
纪录片.en: Last night I watched a documentary about space and learned a lot.

汗水.en: He is sweating all over his head.
I sweated a lot after exercising.

汗水.zh: 每一份成功背后都有汗水。
汗水.en: Behind every success there is sweat.

汗水.zh: 农民伯伯的汗水换来了我们的粮食。
汗水.en: The farmers' sweat has brought us our food.

汗水.zh: 虽然流了很多汗水，但看到成果就值得了。
汗水.en: Although I sweated a lot, it was worth it when I saw the results.

姥姥.en: My grandma is eighty this year.

姥姥.zh: 每个周末我都去看姥姥。
姥姥.en: I go to visit my grandma every weekend.

姥姥.zh: 姥姥一边织毛衣一边给我讲故事。
姥姥.en: Grandma knitted a sweater while telling me stories.

姥姥.zh: 虽然姥姥年纪大了，但她每天都很开心。
姥姥.en: Although grandma is old, she is happy every day.

离职.zh: 因为公司裁员，他不得不主动离职。
离职.en: Because of layoffs, he had to resign voluntarily.
Have you completed the resignation procedures?

离职.zh: 他离职以后，很快就找到了新工作。
离职.en: After resigning, he quickly found a new job.

离职.zh: 我想离职，但是老板不让我走。
离职.en: I want to resign, but the boss won't let me go.

桔子.zh: 我买了一袋桔子，分给同事们吃。
桔子.en: I bought a bag of tangerines and shared with colleagues.
Tangerines are easier to peel than oranges.

桔子.zh: 他喜欢吃桔子，但不喜欢吃苹果。
桔子.en: He likes eating tangerines but doesn't like apples.

桔子.zh: 这个季节的桔子又大又甜，你尝尝。
桔子.en: The tangerines this season are big and sweet, try some.

转告.zh: 你帮我转告她，明天开会改时间了。
转告.en: Help me tell her that tomorrow's meeting time changed.

转告.zh: 这话不是我说的，是别人转告我的。
转告.en: I didn't say that; someone else relayed it to me.

转告.zh: 我已经转告他了，他知道了。
转告.en: I've already passed the message to him, he knows.

带动.zh: 这个项目带动了当地经济的发展。
带动.en: This project drove the local economy's development.

带动.zh: 老师带头学习，带动了全班同学。
带动.en: The teacher led by example and motivated the whole class.

带动.zh: 促销活动带动了销量增长。
如果没有人带动，这个计划很难进行。
带动.en: If no one drives it, this plan is hard to carry out.

团长.en: The leader agreed to this plan.

团长.zh: 我们团长明天要去北京开会。
团长.en: Our leader is going to Beijing for a meeting tomorrow.

团长.zh: 团长，大家的意见您都听到了吗？
团长.en: Leader, have you heard everyone's opinions?

团长.zh: 他是这次访问团的团长。
团长.en: He is the head of this visiting delegation.

团长.zh: 团长让我通知大家，集合时间改了。
团长.en: The leader asked me to inform everyone that the assembly time changed.

调皮.zh: 小时候我很调皮，经常被妈妈骂。
调皮.en: When I was little, I was very naughty and often scolded by mom.
Don't be too naughty, careful not to fall.

调皮.zh: 那只猴子特别调皮，总是抢游客的东西。
调皮.en: That monkey is especially mischievous, always grabbing tourists' things.

调皮.zh: 他虽然调皮，但学习很好。
调皮.en: Although he is naughty, his studies are good.

城区.en: My home is in the urban area.

城区.zh: 城区和郊区的房价差很多。
城区.en: Housing prices differ a lot between urban and suburban areas.

城区.zh: 这个城区最近新开了很多餐厅。
城区.en: Many new restaurants have opened in this urban area recently.

城区.zh: 他从小在城区长大，对这里很熟悉。
城区.en: He grew up in the urban area and knows it well.

城区.zh: 城区的交通比乡镇方便多了。
城区.en: Urban transportation is much more convenient than in towns.

大批.en: A large number of tourists flooded into the scenic area.

大批.zh: 公司今年招聘了大批新员工。
大批.en: The company recruited a large number of new employees this year.

大批.zh: 因为暴雨，大批航班被取消了。
大批.en: Due to heavy rain, a large number of flights were cancelled.

大批.zh: 市场上大批的水果都降价了。
大批.en: A large quantity of fruits in the market have lowered prices.

大批.zh: 这次活动吸引了大批年轻人参加。
大批.en: This event attracted a large number of young people to participate.

正如.en: Just as you said, he is right.

正如.zh: 正如天气预报说的，今天会下雨。
正如.en: Just as the weather forecast said, it will rain today.

正如.zh: 正如大家所想，她果然考了第一名。
正如.en: Just as everyone thought, she indeed got first place.

正如.zh: 正如我担心的那样，工程延期了。
正如.en: Just as I feared, the project was delayed.
Life isn't exactly as you wish.

寿司.zh: 这家店的寿司非常新鲜好吃。
寿司.en: The sushi at this shop is very fresh and delicious.

寿司.zh: 他第一次吃寿司，觉得味道很特别。
寿司.en: He ate sushi for the first time and found the taste very special.

寿司.zh: 寿司配上酱油和芥末更好吃。
寿司.en: Sushi tastes better with soy sauce and wasabi.

寿司.zh: 虽然我很喜欢吃寿司，但太贵了。
寿司.en: Although I really like eating sushi, it's too expensive.

物业.en: The property management fee is too expensive.
The property management in our neighborhood is very good.

物业.zh: 我找物业修了一下水管。
物业.en: I asked the property management to fix the water pipe.

物业.zh: 因为物业不负责，所以小区很脏。
物业.en: Because the property management is irresponsible, the neighborhood is very dirty.

物业.zh: 物业说下个月要涨管理费。
物业.en: The property management said the management fee will increase next month.

游览.zh: 我们昨天去游览了长城。
游览.en: We visited the Great Wall yesterday.

游览.zh: 游览的时候要注意安全。
游览.en: You should pay attention to safety when touring.

游览.zh: 这次游览让我大开眼界。
游览.en: This tour really opened my eyes.

游览.zh: 虽然下雨，但我还是去游览了西湖。
游览.en: Although it was raining, I still went to visit West Lake.

游览.zh: 他喜欢在假期里游览不同的城市。
游览.en: He likes to tour different cities during the holidays.

悠久.zh: 这座城市的文化很悠久。
悠久.en: This city's culture is very ancient.

悠久.zh: 北京是一座历史悠久的城市。
悠久.en: Beijing is a city with a long history.

悠久.zh: 因为历史悠久，这里吸引了很多游客。
悠久.en: Because of its long history, this place attracts many tourists.

悠久.zh: 这个学校有悠久的传统和丰富的经验。
悠久.en: This school has a long tradition and rich experience.

制订.en: The company is formulating a new plan.

制订.zh: 他们制订了详细的时间表。
需要制订一个更好的方案。
制订.en: We need to formulate a better plan.

制订.zh: 经过讨论，我们制订了新的规则。
制订.en: After discussion, we formulated new rules.

制订.zh: 政府将制订法律来保护环境。
制订.en: The government will formulate laws to protect the environment.

外观.zh: 外观虽然好看，但质量一般。
外观.en: Although it looks good, the quality is average.

外观.zh: 我喜欢这辆车的外观设计。
外观.en: I like the exterior design of this car.
The new building has a very modern appearance.

外观.zh: 只看外观的话，它显得很高级。
外观.en: Just looking at the appearance, it seems very high-end.

陆续.en: The guests arrived one after another.
Everyone walked into the classroom one after another.

陆续.zh: 考试结束后，学生陆续离开。
陆续.en: After the exam ended, the students left one by one.
Spring has come, and the flowers are blooming one after another.

陆续.zh: 因为信号不好，消息陆续才收到。
陆续.en: Because the signal was poor, the messages were received only gradually.

试卷.en: This exam paper is too difficult.
The teacher is grading the exam papers.
I handed the exam paper to the teacher.
During the exam, you need to write your name on the paper.

试卷.zh: 虽然复习了，但试卷还是没做完。
试卷.en: Although I reviewed, I still didn't finish the exam paper.

加深.zh: 这次旅行加深了我们的友谊。
练习可以帮助加深记忆。
通过交流，我们加深了对彼此的了解。
加深.en: Through communication, we deepened our understanding of each other.

加深.zh: 这个实验加深了我对物理的兴趣。
加深.en: This experiment deepened my interest in physics.

调研.zh: 调研结果显示很多人不满意。
调研.en: The research results show that many people are dissatisfied.

调研.zh: 我们需要先调研再决定。
调研.en: We need to do research first before deciding.

调研.zh: 因为时间不够，调研进行得很快。
调研.en: Because time was insufficient, the research was conducted quickly.

调研.zh: 这次调研涉及了多个城市和人群。
调研.en: This research covered multiple cities and groups of people.

水产品.en: I rarely eat aquatic products recently.
The aquatic products in the supermarket are very fresh.

水产品.zh: 沿海城市水产品种类多。
水产品.en: Coastal cities have a wide variety of aquatic products.

水产品.zh: 因为过敏，我不能吃水产品。
水产品.en: Because of allergies, I can't eat aquatic products.

水产品.zh: 这家餐厅的水产品都是当天捕捞的。
水产品.en: The aquatic products at this restaurant are all caught the same day.

胆小.zh: 他太胆小了，连虫子都怕。
胆小.en: He is too timid, even afraid of bugs.
Don't be so timid, just give it a try.

胆小.zh: 他因为胆小，所以从来不敢一个人走夜路。
胆小.en: Because he is timid, he never dares to walk alone at night.

胆小.zh: 我小时候很胆小，现在好多了。
胆小.en: I was very timid as a child, but now I'm much better.

影视.en: I like watching TV shows and movies.

影视.zh: 最近影视行业的发展很快。
影视.en: The film and television industry has been developing rapidly recently.

影视.zh: 不仅影视作品，连音乐也很受欢迎。
影视.en: Not only film and TV works, but also music is very popular.

影视.zh: 他从事影视工作很多年了。
影视.en: He has been working in film and television for many years.

影视.zh: 这部影视作品是根据真实故事改编的。
影视.en: This film/TV work is adapted from a true story.

酒鬼.zh: 他爸爸是个酒鬼，天天喝酒。
酒鬼.en: His father is a drunkard, drinking every day.

酒鬼.zh: 虽然他是个酒鬼，但工作很认真。
酒鬼.en: Although he is a drunkard, he is very serious about his work.

酒鬼.zh: 别学他变成酒鬼，对身体不好。
酒鬼.en: Don't follow his example and become a drunkard, it's bad for your health.

酒鬼.zh: 那个酒鬼又在路边睡着了。
酒鬼.en: That drunkard fell asleep by the roadside again.

超速.zh: 如果你超速，就会被扣分。
超速.en: If you speed, you'll get points deducted.

超速.zh: 超速很危险，容易出车祸。
超速.en: Speeding is very dangerous and can easily cause accidents.

超速.zh: 警察在高速上查超速的车。
超速.en: The police are checking for speeding cars on the highway.

除夕.en: On New Year's Eve, we have the reunion dinner.

除夕.zh: 除夕晚上我们全家人一起看春晚。
除夕.en: On New Year's Eve, our whole family watches the Spring Festival Gala together.

除夕.zh: 因为除夕是团圆的日子，所以大家都回家。
除夕.en: Because New Year's Eve is a day for reunion, everyone goes home.
On New Year's Eve, the streets are very lively.

除夕.zh: 除夕夜里，烟花照亮了天空。
除夕.en: On New Year's Eve night, fireworks light up the sky.

国庆.en: National Day has a seven-day holiday.

国庆.zh: 每年国庆，天安门广场都有升旗仪式。
国庆.en: Every National Day, there is a flag-raising ceremony at Tiananmen Square.

国庆.zh: 虽然国庆人多，但是大家都想出去玩。
国庆.en: Although there are many people during National Day, everyone still wants to go out and have fun.

国庆.zh: 国庆期间，高速公路免费。
国庆.en: During National Day, the expressway is free.

国庆.zh: 我们计划国庆去北京旅游。
国庆.en: We plan to travel to Beijing during National Day.

华语.zh: 华语电影在国际上越来越受欢迎。
华语.en: Chinese-language films are becoming more and more popular internationally.

华语.zh: 不但华语歌好听，而且歌词也美。
华语.en: Not only are Chinese songs nice to listen to, but the lyrics are also beautiful.

华语.zh: 他的华语说得非常流利。
在新加坡，华语是官方语言之一。
华语.en: In Singapore, Chinese is one of the official languages.

问卷.zh: 我们做了一份问卷来调查大家的意见。
问卷.en: We created a questionnaire to survey everyone's opinions.

问卷.zh: 如果你有空，可以帮我填一下问卷吗？
问卷.en: If you have time, could you help me fill out the questionnaire?

问卷.zh: 问卷的结果显示大部分人满意。
问卷.en: The questionnaire results show that most people are satisfied.

问卷.zh: 这份问卷有十个问题，很简单。
问卷.en: This questionnaire has ten questions and is very simple.

果实.en: The tree is full of fruit.

果实.zh: 努力就会收获成功的果实。
果实.en: Hard work will reap the fruits of success.

果实.zh: 虽然过程辛苦，但果实很甜美。
果实.en: Although the process is hard, the fruit is very sweet.
Autumn fruits are big and sweet.

果实.zh: 农民们忙着采摘成熟的果实。
果实.en: The farmers are busy picking ripe fruit.

日历.en: Take a look at the calendar.

日历.zh: 我在日历上标记了重要日子。
日历.en: I marked important dates on the calendar.

日历.zh: 因为日历显示明天是周末，所以我很开心。
日历.en: Because the calendar shows tomorrow is the weekend, I'm very happy.

日历.zh: 新年的日历已经挂上墙了。
日历.en: The new year's calendar is already hung on the wall.

日历.zh: 手机上的日历比纸质的方便多了。
日历.en: The calendar on the phone is much more convenient than the paper one.

往返.en: I went back and forth to school twice today.

往返.zh: 因为路程不远，所以我每天往返骑车。
往返.en: Because the distance is not far, I ride my bike back and forth every day.

往返.zh: 这张票是往返的，你不用再买回程票。
往返.en: This ticket is round trip, you don't need to buy a return ticket.

往返.zh: 他每天往返于家和公司。
往返.en: He goes back and forth between home and company every day.

往返.zh: 虽然往返只需要一个小时，但我还是觉得很累。
往返.en: Although the round trip only takes an hour, I still feel very tired.

增进.zh: 一起旅行可以增进朋友之间的了解。
增进.en: Traveling together can enhance understanding between friends.

增进.zh: 如果你多参加活动，就能增进跟同学的关系。
增进.en: If you participate in more activities, you can enhance relationships with classmates.

增进.zh: 这次合作增进了我们两个团队的信任。
增进.en: This cooperation enhanced the trust between our two teams.

深远.zh: 他的决定对公司未来有深远的意义。
深远.en: His decision has far-reaching significance for the company's future.

深远.zh: 虽然只是个小事，但它的后果却很深远。
深远.en: Although it's just a small matter, its consequences are far-reaching.

深远.zh: 那次谈话给我留下了深远的印象。
深远.en: That conversation left a profound impression on me.

音量.en: Please turn up the volume a bit.

音量.zh: 我听不清，你能把音量开大吗？
音量.en: I can't hear clearly, can you turn up the volume?

音量.zh: 如果音量太大，邻居会投诉的。
音量.en: If the volume is too loud, the neighbors will complain.

音量.zh: 这个电视的音量太小了。
音量.en: This TV's volume is too low.

音量.zh: 在图书馆里，手机音量要调到最小。
音量.en: In the library, the phone volume should be turned to the minimum.

碰见.en: I ran into an old classmate yesterday.

碰见.zh: 在超市碰见邻居，我们聊了一会儿。
碰见.en: I ran into my neighbor at the supermarket and we chatted for a while.

碰见.zh: 虽然很少出门，但我还是碰见了一个朋友。
碰见.en: Although I rarely go out, I still ran into a friend.

碰见.zh: 我没想到会在这里碰见你。
碰见.en: I didn't expect to run into you here.

年夜饭.en: The New Year's Eve dinner is very important.

年夜饭.zh: 我们全家每年都一起吃年夜饭。
年夜饭.en: Our whole family eats the New Year's Eve dinner together every year.

年夜饭.zh: 虽然很忙，但年夜饭我一定回家吃。
年夜饭.en: Although very busy, I definitely go home for the New Year's Eve dinner.
The New Year's Eve dinner prepared many dishes.

年夜饭.zh: 今年年夜饭我们订了饭店的包间。
年夜饭.en: This year's New Year's Eve dinner we booked a private room at the restaurant.

深厚.zh: 多年合作让我们建立了深厚的友谊。
深厚.en: Years of cooperation have built a deep friendship between us.

深厚.zh: 虽然不常见面，但我们的感情依然深厚。
深厚.en: Although we don't see each other often, our feelings remain deep.

深厚.zh: 他对中国文化的了解非常深厚。
深厚.en: His understanding of Chinese culture is very profound.

涨价.en: Pork has gone up in price recently.

涨价.zh: 因为原材料涨价，这家店也提价了。
涨价.en: Because raw materials have gone up in price, this store also raised prices.

涨价.zh: 如果油价继续涨价，我就要考虑坐公交了。
涨价.en: If gas prices continue to rise, I will consider taking the bus.

涨价.zh: 涨价之后，来买东西的顾客少了很多。
涨价.en: After the price increase, the number of customers coming to buy things decreased a lot.

样式.en: This piece of clothing has a nice style.

样式.zh: 我喜欢这款手机的样式和颜色。
样式.en: I like the style and color of this phone model.

样式.zh: 虽然样式很好看，但是质量一般。
样式.en: Although the style is very nice, the quality is average.
The new style is very popular.

样式.zh: 这家店有各种不同样式的家具。
样式.en: This store has various different styles of furniture.

亲情.en: Family affection is the most precious.

亲情.zh: 无论走多远，亲情永远割不断。
亲情.en: No matter how far you go, family affection can never be cut off.

亲情.zh: 虽然有时会吵架，但亲情让我们永远是一家人。
亲情.en: Although we sometimes quarrel, family affection makes us forever a family.
I cherish this family affection very much.

亲情.zh: 在外地工作久了，才更懂得亲情的可贵。
亲情.en: After working away from home for a long time, I understand the value of family affection even more.

住址.zh: 请把你的住址写在这张纸上。
住址.en: Please write your address on this paper.

住址.zh: 因为换了住址，所以收不到信。
住址.en: Because I changed my address, I can't receive letters.
The new address is very close to the company.

大奖赛.en: The World Cup Grand Prix is exciting.
She won the Go Grand Prix.
There's a piano grand prix tomorrow.

大奖赛.zh: 要不是下雨，大奖赛会按时开始。
大奖赛.en: If it weren't raining, the grand prix would start on time.

大奖赛.zh: 这个大奖赛的奖金很高。
大奖赛.en: The prize money for this grand prix is high.

要不是.zh: 要不是你帮我，我就完了。
要不是.en: If it weren't for your help, I would be finished.

要不是.zh: 要不是下雨，我们就去公园了。
要不是.en: If it weren't raining, we would have gone to the park.

要不是.zh: 要不是她提醒，我差点忘了。
要不是.en: If she hadn't reminded me, I almost forgot.
If it weren't too expensive, I would have bought it.
If it weren't for the traffic jam, I would have arrived early.

近日.en: Recently the weather is very hot.
He's been busy with work recently.
Recently his mood has been not very good.

近日.zh: 因为近日太累，所以请假了。
近日.en: Because I've been too tired recently, I took leave.

贺卡.en: This greeting card is very delicate.

贺卡.zh: 她收到了很多新年贺卡。
贺卡.en: She received many New Year cards.

贺卡.zh: 我亲手做了一张贺卡给她。
贺卡.en: I made a card for her by hand.

贺卡.zh: 因为忘了买贺卡，所以只好自己画。
贺卡.en: Because I forgot to buy a card, I had to draw one myself.

火锅.en: Let's go eat hot pot tonight.
Hot pot is a Chinese specialty.
Eating hot pot in winter is most comfortable.

火锅.zh: 我们点了很多火锅食材。
火锅.en: We ordered a lot of hot pot ingredients.

书法.en: Calligraphy is a traditional Chinese art.
His calligraphy is written very well.
The teacher teaches us to practice calligraphy.

小于.en: This house is smaller than that one.
His income is less than mine.

小于.zh: 因为价格小于预算，所以买了。
小于.en: Because the price was less than the budget, I bought it.

小于.zh: 温度小于零度时水会结冰。
小于.en: When the temperature is less than zero, water freezes.

竹子.en: There are many bamboos planted in the yard.

竹子.zh: 他用竹子做了一个篮子。
竹子.en: He made a basket out of bamboo.

竹子.zh: 竹子在中国的文化中很有意义。
竹子.en: Bamboo has great significance in Chinese culture.

丰富多彩.en: This activity is colorful and varied.

丰富多彩.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他的生活依然丰富多彩。
丰富多彩.en: Although work is busy, his life is still rich and colorful.

丰富多彩.zh: 这里的文化活动丰富多彩，吸引了很多游客。
丰富多彩.en: The cultural activities here are rich and varied, attracting many tourists.
Her experiences are rich and colorful.

丰富多彩.zh: 我喜欢丰富多彩的假期，而不是整天待在家里。
丰富多彩.en: I like varied vacations, not staying at home all day.

长处.zh: 每个人的长处都不一样。
你要学会发挥自己的长处。
长处.en: You need to learn to use your strengths.
His strong point is being very patient.

长处.zh: 虽然她数学不好，但她的长处是写作。
长处.en: Although she is not good at math, her strength is writing.

长处.zh: 我们应该多看别人的长处。
长处.en: We should look more at others' strengths.

升温.en: The weather is starting to warm up.

升温.zh: 他们的关系最近在升温。
升温.en: Their relationship has been warming up recently.

升温.zh: 随着讨论升温，气氛变得紧张。
升温.en: As the discussion heated up, the atmosphere became tense.

升温.zh: 这个地区的经济在慢慢升温。
升温.en: The economy in this region is slowly heating up.

升温.zh: 夏天一到，气温迅速升温。
升温.en: When summer arrives, the temperature quickly rises.

时差.en: I'm still adjusting to jet lag.
There is a time difference between the US and China.

时差.zh: 因为时差，我晚上睡不着。
时差.en: Because of jet lag, I can't sleep at night.

时差.zh: 坐长途飞机后，时差让我很难受。
时差.en: After a long flight, jet lag makes me feel terrible.

时差.zh: 如果你不调整时差，旅行会很累。
时差.en: If you don't adjust to the time difference, travel will be tiring.

学分.zh: 他为了凑学分选了一门简单的课。
学分.en: He chose an easy course to get credits.
If credits are insufficient, you cannot graduate.

学分.zh: 这学期我打算多修几个学分。
学分.en: This semester I plan to take a few more credits.

能干.zh: 她是一个非常能干的人。
能干.en: She is a very capable person.

能干.zh: 你真的很能干，这么快就完成了。
能干.en: You are really capable, finishing so quickly.

能干.zh: 虽然他年轻，但做事很能干。
能干.en: Although he is young, he is very capable at work.

能干.zh: 我们公司需要一些能干的管理人员。
能干.en: Our company needs some capable managers.

能干.zh: 她不仅聪明，而且特别能干。
能干.en: She is not only smart but also very capable.

出汗.en: It's easy to sweat after exercise.

出汗.zh: 天气太热了，我一直在出汗。
出汗.en: It's too hot, I've been sweating all the time.
He was so nervous that his palms were sweating.
Sweating is good for the body.

出汗.zh: 如果你跑步出汗了，记得多喝水。
出汗.en: If you sweat from running, remember to drink more water.

风俗.zh: 每个地方的风俗都不一样。
风俗.en: Customs are different in every place.

风俗.zh: 入乡随俗，要尊重当地的风俗。
风俗.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do; respect local customs.

风俗.zh: 虽然时代变了，但很多风俗依然保留。
风俗.en: Although times have changed, many customs are still retained.

风俗.zh: 过春节的很多风俗现在还在流行。
风俗.en: Many customs of the Spring Festival are still popular now.

近年来.zh: 近年来，中国的变化很大。
近年来.en: In recent years, China has changed a lot.

近年来.zh: 近年来，虽然工作很忙，但喜欢旅行的人越来越多。
近年来.en: In recent years, although work is busy, more and more people like to travel.

近年来.zh: 近年来，因为政府支持，我的家乡发展很快。
近年来.en: In recent years, thanks to government support, my hometown has developed quickly.

近年来.zh: 近年来，由于科技的发展，很多人的生活变得更方便了。
近年来.en: In recent years, due to technological development, many people's lives have become more convenient.

近年来.zh: 近年来，环保问题受到更多关注。
近年来.en: In recent years, environmental issues have received more attention.

油炸.en: Fried food is not very healthy.
I like eating fried chicken wings.

油炸.zh: 这个店卖的油炸小吃特别好吃。
油炸.en: The fried snacks sold at this shop are especially delicious.

油炸.zh: 妈妈告诉我少吃油炸的东西。
油炸.en: Mom told me to eat less fried stuff.

油炸.zh: 油炸食品虽然香，但不能吃太多。
油炸.en: Although fried food is fragrant, you can't eat too much.

班主任.zh: 班主任今天又批评我了。
班主任.en: The homeroom teacher criticized me again today.

班主任.zh: 我们的班主任特别耐心，大家都很喜欢她。
班主任.en: Our homeroom teacher is very patient, and everyone likes her a lot.

班主任.zh: 因为班主任临时有事，所以下午的班会取消了。
班主任.en: Because the homeroom teacher had something come up, the afternoon class meeting was canceled.

班主任.zh: 班主任让我们每个周末都写一篇周记。
班主任.en: The homeroom teacher makes us write a weekly journal every weekend.

班主任.zh: 这次家长会，班主任跟很多家长都单独聊了孩子的情况。
班主任.en: At this parent-teacher meeting, the homeroom teacher talked individually with many parents about their children's situations.

协议书.zh: 我们俩私下写了一份协议书，把财产分清楚了。
协议书.en: The two of us privately wrote an agreement to clearly divide the property.

协议书.zh: 租房的时候一定要看清楚协议书上的条款再签字。
协议书.en: When renting a house, you must read the terms in the agreement carefully before signing.

协议书.zh: 因为有一方违约，那份协议书现在已经作废了。
协议书.en: Because one party breached the contract, that agreement is now void.

协议书.zh: 双方都同意后，协议书才具有法律效力。
协议书.en: Only after both parties agree does the agreement have legal effect.

教材.zh: 这些教材都是我去年用过的。
教材.en: These textbooks are all ones I used last year.

教材.zh: 学校今年换了一套新教材，内容比以前难多了。
教材.en: The school switched to a new set of textbooks this year, and the content is much harder than before.

教材.zh: 老师让我们自己购买教材，因为学校不发。
教材.en: The teacher asked us to buy the textbooks ourselves because the school doesn't provide them.

教材.zh: 除了课本，老师还推荐了几本辅助教材。
教材.en: Besides the textbook, the teacher also recommended a few supplementary materials.

教材.zh: 这本教材的语法解释很详细，适合自学。
教材.en: This textbook has very detailed grammar explanations and is suitable for self-study.

开水.en: Please give me a cup of boiled water.

开水.zh: 刚烧好的开水很烫，你小心点儿。
开水.en: The freshly boiled water is very hot, be careful.

开水.zh: 感冒了多喝开水，对身体好。
开水.en: When you have a cold, drink more boiled water; it's good for your health.

开水.zh: 这个水壶是专门用来烧开水的。
开水.en: This kettle is specifically for boiling water.

开水.zh: 你要是觉得冷，我就去给你倒杯开水暖暖手。
开水.en: If you feel cold, I'll go pour you a cup of boiled water to warm your hands.

书架.zh: 我的书架已经放不下书了。
书架.en: My bookshelf can't hold any more books.

书架.zh: 他在网上买了一个小书架，放在卧室角落里。
书架.en: He bought a small bookshelf online and put it in the corner of the bedroom.

书架.zh: 这个书架虽然不大，但是能装很多书。
书架.en: This bookshelf, though not big, can hold a lot of books.

书架.zh: 我习惯把常用的书放在书架最下面那层。
书架.en: I'm used to putting frequently used books on the bottom shelf of the bookshelf.

书架.zh: 搬家的时候书架被碰坏了，所以我又买了一个新的。
书架.en: The bookshelf got damaged during the move, so I bought a new one.

响声.zh: 半夜听到响声，吓得我都不敢睡觉。
响声.en: Hearing a noise in the middle of the night scared me so much I couldn't sleep.

响声.zh: 楼上装修的响声太大了，我根本没法专心工作。
响声.en: The noise from the renovation upstairs is too loud; I simply can't concentrate on work.

响声.zh: 突然一声巨大的响声，把大家都吓了一跳。
响声.en: Suddenly a loud noise startled everyone.

响声.zh: 如果你听到任何奇怪的响声，记得赶紧通知保安。
响声.en: If you hear any strange noises, remember to notify the security guard immediately.

押金.zh: 租房的时候要交一个月的押金。
押金.en: When renting a house, you need to pay one month's deposit.

押金.zh: 退房当天房东就把押金退给我了。
押金.en: The landlord returned the deposit to me on the day I moved out.

押金.zh: 因为墙上有个洞，房东扣了我一部分押金。
押金.en: Because there was a hole in the wall, the landlord deducted part of my deposit.

押金.zh: 租车公司说如果没有违章，押金会在一个月内退还。
押金.en: The car rental company said that if there are no violations, the deposit will be refunded within a month.

押金.zh: 交押金之前最好问清楚什么情况下会扣钱。
押金.en: Before paying a deposit, it's best to ask clearly under what circumstances money will be deducted.

物价.en: Prices have been rising really fast recently.

物价.zh: 这里物价太高了，我每个月都存不下钱。
物价.en: The prices here are too high; I can't save any money each month.

物价.zh: 因为物价上涨，很多餐馆都调整了菜单价格。
物价.en: Because of rising prices, many restaurants have adjusted their menu prices.

物价.zh: 跟大城市比，小城市的物价要便宜很多。
物价.en: Compared to big cities, prices in small towns are much cheaper.

物价.zh: 政府正在想办法控制物价，让大家的生活压力小一点。
物价.en: The government is trying to control prices so that people's living pressure can be reduced.

书桌.en: My desk is a bit messy.

书桌.zh: 他每天都会把书桌收拾得干干净净。
书桌.en: He cleans up his desk every day until it's spotless.

书桌.zh: 因为书桌太小了，所以我换了一张大的。
书桌.en: Because the desk was too small, I replaced it with a bigger one.

书桌.zh: 我在书桌上放了一盆绿萝，看起来很有生气。
书桌.en: I put a pot of pothos on my desk; it looks very lively.

书桌.zh: 晚上在书桌前学习的时候，最好把台灯打开。
书桌.en: When studying at the desk at night, it's best to turn on the desk lamp.

台灯.zh: 把台灯往左边挪一点，光线会更均匀。
台灯.en: Move the desk lamp a little to the left; the light will be more even.

台灯.zh: 这个台灯可以调节亮度，很适合晚上看书。
台灯.en: This desk lamp has adjustable brightness; it's very suitable for reading at night.

台灯.zh: 因为光线太暗了，我又买了一个新的台灯放在床头。
台灯.en: Because the light was too dim, I bought a new desk lamp and put it by the bedside.

台灯.zh: 如果你长时间用眼，记得把台灯调亮一点，保护视力。
台灯.en: If you use your eyes for a long time, remember to turn the desk lamp brighter to protect your eyesight.

桃花.zh: 春天到了，桃花开了很多。
桃花.en: Spring has arrived, and the peach blossoms have bloomed a lot.

桃花.zh: 今年桃花开得特别早，可能是因为天气暖和。
桃花.en: The peach blossoms bloomed especially early this year, probably because the weather is warm.

桃花.zh: 公园里的桃花真好看，我们去拍照吧。
桃花.en: The peach blossoms in the park are really beautiful, let's go take photos.

桃花.zh: 他送了我一枝桃花，我很开心。
桃花.en: He gave me a peach blossom branch, and I'm very happy.

桃花.zh: 去年这时候桃花还没开，今年已经满树都是了。
桃花.en: At this time last year the peach blossoms hadn't bloomed yet, but this year the trees are already full of them.

不易.en: This matter is not easy to do.

不易.zh: 想要学好中文很不易，需要坚持。
不易.en: Wanting to learn Chinese well is not easy, you need perseverance.

不易.zh: 他性格不易改变，你别劝了。
不易.en: His personality is not easy to change, don't try to persuade him.

不易.zh: 生活不易，我们要珍惜每一天。
不易.en: Life is not easy, we should cherish every day.

不易.zh: 找到一份满意的工作不易，所以我会努力。
不易.en: Finding a satisfactory job is not easy, so I will work hard.

一路顺风.zh: 明天你就要走了，一路顺风啊。
一路顺风.en: You're leaving tomorrow, have a smooth trip.

一路顺风.zh: 出差路上小心，一路顺风。
一路顺风.en: Be careful on your business trip, safe travels.

一路顺风.zh: 朋友出国前，我跟他说了句一路顺风。
一路顺风.en: Before my friend went abroad, I said 'safe travels' to him.

一路顺风.zh: 你开车去那么远，一定要一路顺风。
一路顺风.en: You're driving that far, you must have a safe trip.

宽度.en: What is the width of this river?

宽度.zh: 门的宽度不够，沙发搬不进去。
宽度.en: The width of the door isn't enough, the sofa can't be moved in.

宽度.zh: 你需要测量桌子的宽度，再买桌布。
宽度.en: You need to measure the width of the table before buying a tablecloth.

宽度.zh: 道路的宽度有限，开车要小心。
宽度.en: The width of the road is limited, drive carefully.

宽度.zh: 这个盒子的宽度和高度差不多，但长度更长。
宽度.en: This box's width and height are about the same, but the length is longer.

橡皮.zh: 写错了用橡皮擦掉就行。
橡皮.en: If you write it wrong, just erase it with an eraser.

橡皮.zh: 这块橡皮很好用，擦得很干净。
橡皮.en: This eraser works well, it erases very cleanly.

橡皮.zh: 考试时别忘了带橡皮和铅笔。
橡皮.en: Don't forget to bring an eraser and pencil for the exam.

橡皮.zh: 我买了块新橡皮，可是不知道放哪儿了。
橡皮.en: I bought a new eraser, but I don't know where I put it.

胡须.zh: 爸爸今天刮了胡须，看起来年轻了。
胡须.en: Dad shaved his beard today, and he looks younger.

胡须.zh: 留胡须的人看起来比较成熟。
胡须.en: People with beards look more mature.

胡须.zh: 他修剪了胡须，显得干净多了。
胡须.en: He trimmed his beard, and it looks much neater.

胡须.zh: 我不喜欢留胡须，因为扎得慌。
胡须.en: I don't like keeping a beard because it feels prickly.

年前.zh: 年前我们得把工作做完。
年前.en: We need to finish the work before the new year.

年前.zh: 年前大家都忙着准备过年。
年前.en: Before the new year, everyone is busy preparing for the Spring Festival.
This account must be settled before the new year.

年前.zh: 年前我买了一堆年货，冰箱都塞满了。
年前.en: Before the new year I bought a bunch of New Year goodies, and the fridge is stuffed full.

年前.zh: 年前的事情太多了，根本忙不过来。
年前.en: There are too many things before the new year, I simply can't keep up.

元旦.en: Where are we going to go for New Year's Day?

元旦.zh: 元旦那天公司放假，我们可以休息。
元旦.en: The company is off on New Year's Day, so we can rest.

元旦.zh: 今年元旦我打算在家睡觉。
元旦.en: This New Year's Day I plan to sleep at home.

元旦.zh: 元旦过后就是春节，大家都等着放假。
元旦.en: After New Year's Day comes the Spring Festival, and everyone is waiting for the holiday.

元旦.zh: 元旦的时候街上人特别多，很热闹。
元旦.en: On New Year's Day there are especially many people on the streets, it's very lively.

普及.en: Nowadays mobile phones are very widespread.

普及.zh: 电脑在乡村还没完全普及。
普及.en: Computers haven't been fully popularized in rural areas yet.

普及.zh: 垃圾分类的知识需要普及给每个人。
普及.en: Knowledge about garbage sorting needs to be popularized to everyone.

普及.zh: 智能手机普及后，大家都离不开它了。
普及.en: After smartphones became popular, everyone can't live without them.

普及.zh: 虽然互联网已经很普及，但有些老人还不会用。
普及.en: Although the internet is already very widespread, some elderly people still don't know how to use it.

亲朋好友.en: He invited many family and friends.

亲朋好友.zh: 过年时亲朋好友会来家里拜年。
亲朋好友.en: During the New Year, family and friends come to the house to pay New Year's greetings.

亲朋好友.zh: 我结婚那天，亲朋好友都来了。
亲朋好友.en: On my wedding day, all my family and friends came.

亲朋好友.zh: 离开家乡后，很少见到亲朋好友了。
亲朋好友.en: After leaving my hometown, I rarely see family and friends.

亲朋好友.zh: 遇到困难时，亲朋好友都会伸出援手。
亲朋好友.en: When facing difficulties, family and friends will always lend a helping hand.

厚度.en: The thickness of this wooden board is not enough.

厚度.zh: 你量一下这堵墙的厚度。
厚度.en: Measure the thickness of this wall.

厚度.zh: 因为书太厚了，厚度有三厘米。
厚度.en: Because the book is too thick, its thickness is three centimeters.

厚度.zh: 冬天要穿厚度更大的羽绒服才保暖。
厚度.en: In winter, you need a down jacket with greater thickness to keep warm.

厚度.zh: 虽然这个垫子厚度很薄，但是坐着很舒服。
厚度.en: Although this cushion is very thin in thickness, it's comfortable to sit on.

汇率.zh: 他出国前查了一下汇率。
汇率.en: He checked the exchange rate before going abroad.

汇率.zh: 如果汇率一直涨，进口商品会更贵。
汇率.en: If the exchange rate keeps rising, imported goods will become more expensive.

汇率.zh: 最近汇率波动很大，换钱要小心。
汇率.en: The exchange rate has been fluctuating a lot lately, so be careful when exchanging money.

汇率.zh: 因为美元汇率下跌，他决定先不换人民币。
汇率.en: Because the dollar exchange rate fell, he decided not to exchange for Chinese yuan yet.

工艺品.zh: 这家店卖很多手工艺品。
她送了我一个漂亮的工艺品。
工艺品.en: She gave me a beautiful handicraft.

工艺品.zh: 虽然价格不贵，但这个工艺品做工很精细。
工艺品.en: Although the price is not high, this handicraft has fine workmanship.

工艺品.zh: 在旅游景点买工艺品要记得砍价。
工艺品.en: When buying handicrafts at tourist spots, remember to bargain.

工艺品.zh: 这些工艺品都是当地工匠亲手做的，很有特色。
工艺品.en: These handicrafts are all handmade by local artisans and are very unique.

鼠标.en: This wireless mouse works very well.

鼠标.zh: 如果你不习惯，可以换个带线的鼠标。
鼠标.en: If you're not used to it, you can switch to a wired mouse.

鼠标.zh: 他买了新鼠标，因为旧的反应太慢。
鼠标.en: He bought a new mouse because the old one was too slow to respond.

鼠标.zh: 用鼠标的时候记得垫鼠标垫，不然会磨损。
鼠标.en: When using a mouse, remember to use a mouse pad, otherwise it will wear out.

中医.en: My friend studies traditional Chinese medicine.

中医.zh: 中医看舌头和脉搏来诊断。
中医.en: Traditional Chinese medicine diagnoses by looking at the tongue and feeling the pulse.

中医.zh: 虽然西医快，但中医调理身体效果更好。
中医.en: Although Western medicine is fast, traditional Chinese medicine is better for regulating the body.

中医.zh: 她最近腰痛，打算去看中医。
中医.en: She has back pain recently and plans to see a traditional Chinese medicine doctor.

中医.zh: 中医讲究阴阳平衡，所以开的药都很温和。
中医.en: Traditional Chinese medicine emphasizes the balance of yin and yang, so the prescriptions are very mild.

年初.en: I set many goals at the beginning of the year.

年初.zh: 公司年初会开年度会议。
年初.en: The company holds an annual meeting at the beginning of the year.

年初.zh: 因为年初工作忙，他一直没时间休息。
年初.en: Because work was busy at the beginning of the year, he didn't have time to rest.

年初.zh: 年初的时候，很多人会去庙里祈福。
年初.en: At the beginning of the year, many people go to temples to pray for blessings.

年初.zh: 这个计划是年初制定的，现在要调整一下。
年初.en: This plan was made at the beginning of the year, and now it needs some adjustments.

乘务员.en: The flight attendant is serving meals.
That flight attendant provided great service.

乘务员.zh: 如果有需要，请按铃叫乘务员。
乘务员.en: If you need anything, press the call button for the flight attendant.

乘务员.zh: 高铁上的乘务员很耐心地回答了问题。
乘务员.en: The train attendant on the high-speed rail patiently answered the questions.

乘务员.zh: 因为飞机颠簸，乘务员提醒大家系好安全带。
乘务员.en: Because the plane was bumpy, the flight attendant reminded everyone to fasten their seatbelts.

岸上.en: The boat finally reached the shore.
The children are picking up shells on the shore.

岸上.zh: 游泳的时候不要离岸上太远。
岸上.en: When swimming, don't go too far from the shore.

岸上.zh: 如果水太冷，就在岸上晒太阳吧。
岸上.en: If the water is too cold, just sunbathe on the shore.

岸上.zh: 他们划船到湖心，又从岸上带了很多食物。
岸上.en: They rowed to the center of the lake and also brought a lot of food from the shore.

急忙.en: Don't be in a hurry, speak slowly.

急忙.zh: 听到电话响，她急忙去接。
急忙.en: Hearing the phone ring, she hurriedly answered it.

急忙.zh: 因为快迟到了，他急忙吃了两口早饭。
急忙.en: Because he was almost late, he hurriedly ate a couple of bites of breakfast.

急忙.zh: 我急忙把文件收好，结果漏了一份重要的。
急忙.en: I hurriedly put away the documents, but ended up missing an important one.

售价.en: What is the selling price of this bag?
The selling price of the new phone is very expensive.

售价.zh: 虽然售价高，但质量确实好。
售价.en: Although the selling price is high, the quality is indeed good.

售价.zh: 这件衣服原价五百，现在售价只要两百。
售价.en: This piece of clothing was originally five hundred, now the selling price is only two hundred.

售价.zh: 因为成本上涨，这批商品的售价也提高了。
售价.en: Because costs have risen, the selling price of this batch of goods has also increased.

吸管.zh: 他用吸管喝奶茶，喝得很快。
吸管.en: He drank milk tea with a straw, very quickly.

吸管.zh: 超市里卖各种颜色的吸管，我买了一些。
吸管.en: The supermarket sells straws in all colors, so I bought some.

吸管.zh: 小孩子用吸管喝酸奶不会弄脏衣服。
吸管.en: Kids won't get their clothes dirty when drinking yogurt with a straw.

吸管.zh: 别咬吸管，那样会把吸管咬坏的。
吸管.en: Don't bite the straw, or you'll damage it.

窗台.en: The book is on the windowsill.

窗台.zh: 猫喜欢趴在窗台上晒太阳。
窗台.en: The cat likes to lie on the windowsill and bask in the sun.

窗台.zh: 窗台上摆了一盆花，看起来很漂亮。
窗台.en: There's a potted flower on the windowsill, and it looks beautiful.

窗台.zh: 她把衣服晾在窗台上，风一吹就干了。
窗台.en: She hung the clothes on the windowsill, and they dried as soon as the wind blew.

窗台.zh: 别把贵重物品放在窗台上，小心掉下去。
窗台.en: Don't put valuables on the windowsill, or they might fall off.

国庆节.en: We have seven days off for National Day.

国庆节.zh: 今年国庆节我打算去北京旅游。
国庆节.en: This National Day, I plan to travel to Beijing.

国庆节.zh: 国庆节期间，街上到处都是国旗。
国庆节.en: During the National Day holiday, there are national flags everywhere on the streets.

国庆节.zh: 虽然国庆节很热闹，但我更喜欢待在家里。
国庆节.en: Although National Day is very lively, I prefer to stay at home.

国庆节.zh: 国庆节快到了，我们准备买个蛋糕庆祝。
国庆节.en: National Day is coming soon, and we're going to buy a cake to celebrate.

中外.zh: 这家餐厅中外顾客都很多。
中外.en: This restaurant has many customers, both Chinese and foreign.

中外.zh: 这本书介绍了中外历史的不同之处。
中外.en: This book introduces the differences between Chinese and foreign histories.

中外.zh: 中外文化交流活动下个月开始报名。
中外.en: Registration for the China-foreign cultural exchange activity starts next month.

中外.zh: 他既懂中文又懂英文，能做中外翻译。
中外.en: He knows both Chinese and English, so he can work as a Chinese-foreign translator.

中外.zh: 中外游客都喜欢去长城玩。
中外.en: Both Chinese and foreign tourists enjoy visiting the Great Wall.

学年.en: The new academic year starts in September.

学年.zh: 这个学年我选了五门课。
学年.en: I've chosen five courses this academic year.

学年.zh: 学年结束时学校会举行毕业典礼。
学年.en: The school holds a graduation ceremony at the end of the academic year.

学年.zh: 因为疫情，上个学年我们一直在上网课。
学年.en: Because of the pandemic, we had online classes all last academic year.

学年.zh: 学年中间的寒假是休息的最好时机。
学年.en: The winter break in the middle of the academic year is the best time to rest.

中级.en: I'm studying intermediate Chinese this year.

中级.zh: 中级班的学生已经能聊简单的话题了。
中级.en: Students in the intermediate class can already talk about simple topics.

中级.zh: 这本教材适合中级水平的学习者。
中级.en: This textbook is suitable for intermediate-level learners.

中级.zh: 他通过了中级考试，准备学高级课程。
中级.en: He passed the intermediate exam and is preparing to study advanced courses.

中级.zh: 虽然我只是中级水平，但交流没问题。
中级.en: Although I'm only at an intermediate level, communication is no problem.

首次.en: This is my first time coming to China.

首次.zh: 她首次登台演出时特别紧张。
首次.en: She was very nervous when she performed on stage for the first time.

首次.zh: 公司首次推出这款产品就大受欢迎。
首次.en: The company launched this product for the first time, and it was a huge hit.

首次.zh: 他首次独自出国旅行，心里有点害怕。
首次.en: He was a little scared when he traveled abroad alone for the first time.

首次.zh: 首次见面，我们聊了很多共同爱好。
首次.en: At our first meeting, we talked a lot about common interests.

豆浆.en: Drinking a cup of soy milk in the morning is very healthy.

豆浆.zh: 我喜欢把油条泡在豆浆里吃。
豆浆.en: I like to dip fried dough sticks in soy milk and eat them.

豆浆.zh: 这家店的豆浆是自己磨的，特别香。
豆浆.en: The soy milk at this shop is freshly ground, and it's especially fragrant.

豆浆.zh: 她不爱喝豆浆，所以每次都要牛奶。
豆浆.en: She doesn't like soy milk, so she always asks for milk.

豆浆.zh: 豆浆和鸡蛋一起吃会有什么问题吗？
豆浆.en: Are there any problems with eating soy milk and eggs together?

近代.zh: 近代中国发生了很大变化。
近代.en: Modern China has undergone great changes.

近代.zh: 这本书讲的是近代欧洲的历史。
近代.en: This book is about the history of modern Europe.

近代.zh: 近代科技发展非常迅速，改变了生活方式。
近代.en: Modern technology developed very rapidly, changing people's lifestyles.

近代.zh: 他研究近代文学，对鲁迅特别感兴趣。
近代.en: He studies modern literature and is especially interested in Lu Xun.

近代.zh: 从古代到近代，人们的交通工具变化很大。
近代.en: From ancient times to modern times, people's means of transportation have changed greatly.

胡同.zh: 北京的胡同里藏着很多故事。
我们穿过几条胡同才找到那家小店。
胡同.en: We walked through several hutongs before finding that small shop.

胡同.zh: 胡同里的老房子现在都成了景点。
胡同.en: The old houses in the hutongs have now become tourist attractions.

胡同.zh: 如果你来北京，一定要去胡同里走走。
胡同.en: If you come to Beijing, be sure to take a walk in the hutongs.

特产.zh: 我来北京一定要买一些特产带回去。
特产.en: I must buy some local specialties to bring back when I come to Beijing.

特产.zh: 虽然这是特产，但是价格太贵了。
特产.en: Although this is a local specialty, the price is too expensive.

特产.zh: 朋友从云南给我带了茶叶特产。
特产.en: My friend brought tea as a local specialty from Yunnan.

特产.zh: 如果你去四川，别忘了买火锅底料特产。
特产.en: If you go to Sichuan, don't forget to buy the hotpot base local specialty.

配送.zh: 我下单后，配送员两个小时就送到了。
配送.en: After I placed the order, the delivery person arrived in two hours.

配送.zh: 因为下大雨，配送可能会延迟。
配送.en: Because of heavy rain, delivery might be delayed.

配送.zh: 这家店提供免费配送服务。
配送.en: This store offers free delivery service.
Which delivery time do you choose?

中华.en: Chinese culture is vast and profound.

中华.zh: 我特别喜欢中华传统节日，比如春节。
中华.en: I really like traditional Chinese festivals, such as Spring Festival.

中华.zh: 虽然我住在国外，但我依然热爱中华美食。
中华.en: Although I live abroad, I still love Chinese cuisine.

中华.zh: 中华料理在世界各地都很受欢迎。
中华.en: Chinese cuisine is very popular all over the world.

中华.zh: 这本书介绍了中华五千年历史。
中华.en: This book introduces five thousand years of Chinese history.

人民币.zh: 我从银行取了两千人民币。
人民币.en: I withdrew two thousand Renminbi from the bank.

人民币.zh: 因为汇率变化，人民币现在更值钱了。
人民币.en: Because of exchange rate changes, Renminbi is now more valuable.

人民币.zh: 这个包花了三百人民币。
人民币.en: This bag cost three hundred Renminbi.

人民币.zh: 你身上有人民币现金吗？
人民币.en: Do you have Renminbi cash on you?

着凉.zh: 昨天没穿外套，结果着凉了。
着凉.en: Yesterday I didn't wear a jacket, and as a result I caught a cold.

着凉.zh: 如果晚上不盖被子，很容易着凉。
着凉.en: If you don't cover yourself with a blanket at night, you can easily catch a cold.
Drink more hot water, be careful not to catch a cold.

着凉.zh: 他因为着凉所以请了一天假。
着凉.en: He took a day off because he caught a cold.

登机牌.zh: 办完托运后，我拿到了登机牌。
登机牌.en: After checking in my luggage, I got my boarding pass.

登机牌.zh: 虽然电子登机牌很方便，但我还是喜欢纸质版。
登机牌.en: Although electronic boarding passes are convenient, I still prefer paper ones.

登机牌.zh: 你的登机牌放在座位前面的口袋里。
登机牌.en: Your boarding pass is in the seat pocket in front of you.
What if I lose my boarding pass?

中药.en: He is drinking Chinese herbal medicine.

中药.zh: 我感冒了，医生给我开了三天的中药。
中药.en: I caught a cold, and the doctor prescribed three days of Chinese medicine.

中药.zh: 虽然中药味道苦，但对身体很好。
中药.en: Although Chinese medicine tastes bitter, it is good for the body.

中药.zh: 这家中药店开了二十年了。
中药.en: This Chinese medicine shop has been open for twenty years.

中药.zh: 你相信中药能治好这个病吗？
中药.en: Do you believe Chinese medicine can cure this disease?

盒饭.zh: 公司楼下卖盒饭，十二块钱一份。
盒饭.en: They sell boxed meals downstairs from the office, twelve yuan each.

盒饭.zh: 因为时间紧，我们只能吃盒饭。
盒饭.en: Because time was tight, we could only eat boxed meals.

盒饭.zh: 这个盒饭里有鸡肉和青菜。
盒饭.en: This boxed meal has chicken and vegetables.

盒饭.zh: 坐火车时，我经常买盒饭吃。
盒饭.en: When taking the train, I often buy boxed meals to eat.

国画.zh: 爷爷送我一幅他画的国画。
国画.en: My grandfather gave me a traditional Chinese painting he painted.

国画.zh: 虽然国画看起来很简単，但需要很多练习。
国画.en: Although traditional Chinese painting looks simple, it requires a lot of practice.

国画.zh: 这幅国画画的是一群金鱼。
国画.en: This traditional Chinese painting depicts a group of goldfish.

国画.zh: 我们在博物馆看到很多古代国画。
国画.en: We saw many ancient traditional Chinese paintings at the museum.

保质期.en: This bread's expiration date has passed.

保质期.zh: 买食品之前一定要看保质期。
保质期.en: Before buying food, you must check the expiration date.

保质期.zh: 如果保质期快到了，商店会打折。
保质期.en: If the expiration date is approaching, the store will offer discounts.

保质期.zh: 牛奶的保质期只有七天。
保质期.en: Milk's shelf life is only seven days.

保质期.zh: 请问这个产品的保质期到什么时候？
保质期.en: Excuse me, what is the expiration date of this product?

池子.en: There are fish in the pond.

池子.zh: 他们把池子的水抽干了准备清理。
池子.en: They drained the water from the pond to clean it.

池子.zh: 虽然池子不大，但养了很多金鱼。
池子.en: Although the pond is not big, it has a lot of goldfish.

池子.zh: 这个游泳馆的池子很深，要小心。
池子.en: This swimming pool is very deep, be careful.

池子.zh: 池子旁边种了几棵柳树。
池子.en: Next to the pond are several willow trees.

厘米.en: It's enough with just two more centimeters.

厘米.zh: 这张桌子比墙宽了五厘米，放不下。
厘米.en: This table is five centimeters wider than the wall, so it doesn't fit.

厘米.zh: 因为身高只差一厘米，所以他没被录取。
厘米.en: Because his height was only one centimeter short, he wasn't admitted.

厘米.zh: 这条鱼的尾巴长大概十厘米。
厘米.en: This fish's tail is about ten centimeters long.

厘米.zh: 窗帘短了十厘米，得重做。
厘米.en: The curtain is ten centimeters short, needs to be remade.

话费.en: My phone credit is used up.

话费.zh: 这个月话费怎么比上个月多了这么多？
话费.en: Why is this month's phone bill so much more than last month's?

话费.zh: 如果你不交话费，手机就会停机。
话费.en: If you don't pay the phone bill, your phone will be suspended.

话费.zh: 我刚充了五十块钱话费。
话费.en: I just topped up 50 yuan of phone credit.

话费.zh: 话费太贵了，我想换个套餐。
话费.en: The phone bill is too expensive, I want to change my plan.

日用品.en: I'm going to the supermarket to buy daily necessities.

日用品.zh: 这些日用品在打折，你可以多囤一点。
日用品.en: These daily necessities are on sale, you can stock up a bit.

日用品.zh: 虽然日用品不贵，但每个月加起来也不少钱。
日用品.en: Although daily necessities are not expensive, they add up to a lot each month.

日用品.zh: 搬家的时候，日用品都要重新买。
日用品.en: When moving, daily necessities all need to be bought again.

日用品.zh: 这家店只卖日用品，没有食品。
日用品.en: This store only sells daily necessities, no food.

扇子.zh: 夏天的时候，奶奶总爱拿着一把扇子扇风。
扇子.en: In summer, grandma always likes to hold a fan and fan herself.

扇子.zh: 因为停电了，我们只能用手摇扇子。
扇子.en: Because the power went out, we had to use hand fans.

扇子.zh: 这把扇子是我从杭州旅游时买的。
扇子.en: This fan is one I bought while traveling in Hangzhou.

扇子.zh: 老人轻轻摇着扇子，很悠闲。
扇子.en: The old man gently waved his fan, very leisurely.

虚心.zh: 他虽然很厉害，但一直很虚心向别人请教。
虚心.en: Although he is very capable, he always modestly asks others for advice.

虚心.zh: 只有虚心学习，才能不断进步。
虚心.en: Only by learning with an open mind can you keep improving.

虚心.zh: 虚心使人进步，骄傲使人落后。
虚心.en: Modesty helps one go forward, conceit makes one lag behind.
The teacher praised him for being modest.

个儿.en: This apple is really big in size.

个儿.zh: 你俩个儿差不多，可以穿同一件衣服。
个儿.en: You two are similar in height, can wear the same clothes.

个儿.zh: 虽然个儿小，但他力气很大。
个儿.en: Although he is small in stature, he is very strong.

个儿.zh: 他个儿高，打篮球有优势。
个儿.en: He is tall, has an advantage in basketball.

个儿.zh: 这个西瓜个儿不大，但是很甜。
个儿.en: This watermelon is not big in size, but very sweet.

闭幕.zh: 这次展览会在今晚八点正式闭幕。
闭幕.en: This exhibition will officially close at 8pm tonight.

闭幕.zh: 虽然闭幕了，但大家还在会场拍照。
闭幕.en: Although it ended, everyone was still taking photos at the venue.

闭幕.zh: 闭幕式上，演员们一起谢幕。
闭幕.en: At the closing ceremony, the actors took a curtain call together.

闭幕.zh: 电影节闭幕之后，很多明星离开了。
闭幕.en: After the film festival closed, many stars left.

叉子.zh: 吃西餐的时候，左手拿叉子，右手拿刀。
叉子.en: When eating Western food, left hand holds fork, right hand holds knife.

叉子.zh: 你如果用不惯筷子，可以用叉子。
叉子.en: If you can't get used to chopsticks, you can use a fork.

叉子.zh: 这把叉子是银的，很贵重。
叉子.en: This fork is silver, very valuable.

叉子.zh: 叉子掉地上了，换一把吧。
叉子.en: The fork fell on the floor, change to another one.

姥爷.en: My maternal grandfather is 70 this year.

姥爷.zh: 姥爷喜欢下棋，经常和邻居在公园里下。
姥爷.en: Grandpa likes to play chess, often plays with neighbors in the park.

姥爷.zh: 因为姥爷身体不好，妈妈每周都去看他。
姥爷.en: Because grandpa is not in good health, mom goes to see him every week.

姥爷.zh: 小时候我经常跟姥爷去钓鱼。
姥爷.en: When I was young, I often went fishing with grandpa.

姥爷.zh: 姥爷给我讲了很多故事。

省会.en: Guangzhou is the capital of Guangdong Province.

省会.zh: 每个省会城市都有它的特色小吃。
省会.en: Every provincial capital city has its own specialty snacks.

省会.zh: 虽然北京是首都，但不是省会城市。
省会.en: Although Beijing is the capital, it is not a provincial capital.

省会.zh: 我们这次出差要去三个不同的省会。
省会.en: We are going to three different provincial capitals on this business trip.

省会.zh: 他从小在省会长大，所以对大城市很熟悉。
省会.en: He grew up in a provincial capital, so he is very familiar with big cities.

烤鸭.zh: 我们今晚一起去吃烤鸭吧。
烤鸭.en: Let's go eat roast duck together tonight.

烤鸭.zh: 这家店的烤鸭皮特别脆，我很喜欢。
烤鸭.en: The skin of the roast duck at this restaurant is especially crispy, I really like it.

烤鸭.zh: 虽然他以前不吃鸭肉，但尝了烤鸭之后爱上了。
烤鸭.en: Although he didn't eat duck before, he fell in love with it after trying roast duck.

烤鸭.zh: 妈妈做的烤鸭虽然没有饭店那么正宗，但味道也不错。
烤鸭.en: Although Mom's roast duck isn't as authentic as restaurant's, it still tastes good.

水灾.zh: 今年夏天南方发生了严重水灾。
水灾.en: There was a severe flood in the south this summer.

水灾.zh: 水灾过后，很多农田都被淹了。
水灾.en: After the flood, many farmlands were submerged.

水灾.zh: 政府正在帮助水灾地区的居民重建家园。
水灾.en: The government is helping residents in the flood-affected areas rebuild their homes.

水灾.zh: 因为连下了几天暴雨，所以有些地方出现了水灾。
水灾.en: Because it rained heavily for several days, flooding occurred in some places.

水灾.zh: 上次水灾的时候，他们的房子被水淹了一米多深。
水灾.en: During the last flood, their house was submerged in over a meter of water.

高科技.zh: 这家公司主要做高科技产品。
高科技.en: This company mainly makes high-tech products.

高科技.zh: 现在很多高科技设备都越来越智能了。
高科技.en: Nowadays, many high-tech devices are becoming more and more intelligent.

高科技.zh: 他大学学的是计算机，毕业后进了高科技行业。
高科技.en: He studied computer science in college and entered the high-tech industry after graduation.

高科技.zh: 虽然高科技让生活更方便，但也带来了一些隐私问题。
高科技.en: Although high technology makes life more convenient, it also brings some privacy issues.

高科技.zh: 我们工厂引进了几台高科技机器，生产效率提高了很多。
高科技.en: Our factory introduced several high-tech machines, and production efficiency has increased a lot.

挂号.en: Have you registered (for a doctor's appointment)?
You need to register first before seeing a doctor at the hospital.

挂号.zh: 因为病人太多，所以挂号需要排很长的队。
挂号.en: Because there are too many patients, you have to wait in a long line to register.

挂号.zh: 他早上五点就去医院挂号了，结果还是没挂上。
挂号.en: He went to the hospital to register at five in the morning, but still didn't get a number.

读音.zh: 这个字怎么读？读音是什么？
读音.en: How do you read this character? What's the pronunciation?

读音.zh: 她的中文读音非常标准。
读音.en: Her Chinese pronunciation is very standard.

读音.zh: 很多汉字的读音和写法没有直接关系。
读音.en: The pronunciation of many Chinese characters is not directly related to their writing.

读音.zh: 如果你不确定读音，可以查一下字典。
读音.en: If you are not sure about the pronunciation, you can look it up in a dictionary.

读音.zh: 他学英语时最大的困难就是单词的读音记不住。
读音.en: His biggest difficulty in learning English is remembering the pronunciation of words.

五颜六色.zh: 花园里开满了五颜六色的花。
五颜六色.en: The garden is full of colorful flowers.

五颜六色.zh: 她买了一条五颜六色的围巾。
孩子们喜欢五颜六色的气球。
夜市上摆着五颜六色的灯笼，特别好看。
五颜六色.en: The night market is decorated with colorful lanterns, which look especially beautiful.

五颜六色.zh: 虽然这些糖果五颜六色的，但吃多了对身体不好。
五颜六色.en: Although these candies are colorful, eating too many is bad for your health.

夜市.en: Let's go to the night market tonight.

夜市.zh: 这个夜市的烤串特别有名。
夜市.en: The skewers at this night market are especially famous.

夜市.zh: 夜市里人很多，非常热闹。
夜市.en: There are a lot of people in the night market, it's very lively.

夜市.zh: 他每次去旅行都喜欢去当地的夜市看看。
夜市.en: Every time he travels, he likes to visit the local night market.

夜市.zh: 虽然夜市的东西便宜，但质量有时候不太好。
夜市.en: Although things at the night market are cheap, the quality is sometimes not very good.

用法.zh: 你知道这个软件的用法吗？
用法.en: Do you know how to use this software?

用法.zh: 说明书上写得很清楚它的用法。
用法.en: The manual clearly explains its usage.

用法.zh: 这个词的用法和那个词不太一样。
用法.en: The usage of this word is a bit different from that word.

用法.zh: 老师详细讲解了这种语法结构的用法。
用法.en: The teacher explained in detail the usage of this grammatical structure.

用法.zh: 如果你不确定洗衣机的用法，可以问我。
