用法.en: If you're not sure about how to use the washing machine, you can ask me.

主食.zh: 米饭是中国人常吃的主食。
主食.en: Rice is a common staple food for Chinese people.
What do you want for the main staple at dinner?

主食.zh: 北方人喜欢吃面食作为主食。
主食.en: Northerners like to eat noodles or bread as their staple food.

主食.zh: 减肥的时候可以少吃主食，但不能完全不吃。
主食.en: When losing weight, you can eat less staple food, but you can't skip it entirely.

主食.zh: 这家餐厅的主食种类很多，有米饭、面条和饺子。
主食.en: This restaurant has a wide variety of staple foods, including rice, noodles, and dumplings.

剪子.en: This pair of scissors is very sharp.

剪子.zh: 我用剪子把包装纸剪开了。
剪子.en: I cut the wrapping paper open with scissors.
She borrowed scissors to cut her hair.

剪子.zh: 因为剪子不好用，所以我换了一把新的。
剪子.en: Because the scissors weren't working well, I switched to a new pair.

剪子.zh: 做手工的时候，剪子、胶水和纸都是必备的。
剪子.en: When doing crafts, scissors, glue, and paper are all essential.

跳高.en: He is very good at high jump.

跳高.zh: 学校运动会有跳高比赛。
跳高.en: There is a high jump competition at the school sports meet.

跳高.zh: 她跳高的时候不小心扭了脚。
跳高.en: She twisted her ankle while doing high jump.

跳高.zh: 虽然跳高很难，但他每天都在练习。
跳高.en: Although high jump is difficult, he practices every day.

跳高.zh: 教练说跳高不仅需要弹跳力，还要掌握技巧。
跳高.en: The coach said high jump requires not only jumping power but also technique.

家电.en: The new home needs to buy a lot of appliances.

家电.zh: 我家最近换了一台新家电。
家电.en: My family recently replaced an old appliance with a new one.

家电.zh: 因为天气太热，家电销量比平时高很多。
家电.en: Because the weather is too hot, sales of household appliances are much higher than usual.

家电.zh: 买家电之前，最好先比较一下价格和功能。
家电.en: Before buying household appliances, it's best to compare prices and functions.

压岁钱.en: The child received New Year's gift money.
You should save the New Year's gift money well.

压岁钱.zh: 奶奶给了我一个大红包当压岁钱。
压岁钱.en: Grandma gave me a big red envelope as New Year's gift money.

压岁钱.zh: 每年春节，父母都会给孩子压岁钱。
压岁钱.en: Every Spring Festival, parents give their children New Year's gift money.

压岁钱.zh: 他打算用压岁钱买一本词典，剩下的存银行。
压岁钱.en: He plans to use the New Year's gift money to buy a dictionary and save the rest in the bank.

解说员.en: The commentator's voice is very pleasant.

解说员.zh: 比赛时解说员一直在分析战术。
解说员.en: During the match, the commentator kept analyzing tactics.

解说员.zh: 因为解说员说错了名字，观众都在笑。
解说员.en: Because the commentator said the wrong name, the audience was laughing.

解说员.zh: 好的解说员能让比赛变得更加精彩。
解说员.en: A good commentator can make the game even more exciting.

礼拜天.en: We go to the park on Sunday.
I have to work overtime this Sunday.

礼拜天.zh: 礼拜天早上我喜欢睡懒觉。
礼拜天.en: I like to sleep in on Sunday mornings.

礼拜天.zh: 如果礼拜天天气好，我们就去爬山。
礼拜天.en: If the weather is nice on Sunday, we'll go hiking.

礼拜天.zh: 他每个礼拜天都会去图书馆看书。
礼拜天.en: He goes to the library to read every Sunday.

西餐.en: I don't really like Western food.
Let's go eat Western food today.

西餐.zh: 这家西餐店的牛排很好吃。
西餐.en: The steak at this Western restaurant is delicious.

西餐.zh: 她喜欢西餐，但我更爱吃中餐。
西餐.en: She likes Western food, but I prefer Chinese food.

西餐.zh: 第一次吃西餐的时候，我不知道怎么用刀叉。
西餐.en: The first time I ate Western food, I didn't know how to use a knife and fork.

书柜.en: The bookshelf is full of books.

书柜.zh: 我在网上买了一个新书柜。
书柜.en: I bought a new bookshelf online.

书柜.zh: 书柜里的书按照分类放好了。
书柜.en: The books in the bookshelf are arranged by category.

书柜.zh: 因为书柜太小，很多书都放不下。
书柜.en: Because the bookshelf is too small, many books can't fit.

书柜.zh: 她打算把旧书柜卖掉，换一个更大的。
书柜.en: She plans to sell the old bookshelf and get a bigger one.

只见.en: I saw a person running past.

只见.zh: 打开门，只见桌上放着一封信。
只见.en: Opening the door, I saw a letter lying on the table.

只见.zh: 只见他笑了笑，什么也没说。
只见.en: He just smiled and said nothing.

只见.zh: 我走进教室，只见大家都在安静地看书。
只见.en: I walked into the classroom and saw everyone quietly reading.

只见.zh: 抬头一看，只见天空中飘着五颜六色的风筝。
只见.en: Looking up, I saw colorful kites floating in the sky.

短处.zh: 他的短处是不太会说话。
短处.en: His shortcoming is that he's not good at speaking.

短处.zh: 你要学会看到别人的长处和短处。
短处.en: You need to learn to see other people's strengths and weaknesses.

短处.zh: 虽然数学是他的短处，但他很努力在学。
短处.en: Although math is his weakness, he is working hard to learn it.

短处.zh: 不要总盯着别人的短处，要取长补短。
短处.en: Don't always focus on others' shortcomings; learn from their strengths to make up for your weaknesses.

酸甜苦辣.zh: 生活的酸甜苦辣都要尝尝。
酸甜苦辣.en: You have to taste all the ups and downs of life.

酸甜苦辣.zh: 创业这些年，我尝尽了酸甜苦辣。
酸甜苦辣.en: Over these years of starting a business, I have experienced all the joys and sorrows.

酸甜苦辣.zh: 虽然很辛苦，但酸甜苦辣都是回忆。
酸甜苦辣.en: Although it's hard, the bittersweet memories are all part of life.

酸甜苦辣.zh: 这道菜把人生的酸甜苦辣都融进去了。
酸甜苦辣.en: This dish incorporates all the flavors of life.

酸甜苦辣.zh: 他写的歌词里充满了酸甜苦辣的故事。
酸甜苦辣.en: The lyrics he wrote are full of stories of ups and downs.

便条.zh: 他在桌上放了一张便条就走了。
便条.en: He put a note on the table and left.

便条.zh: 我写个便条提醒自己明天要开会。
便条.en: I'll write a note to remind myself of the meeting tomorrow.

便条.zh: 她走之前留了便条，说晚上回来吃饭。
便条.en: She left a note before leaving, saying she'll be back for dinner.

便条.zh: 麻烦你帮我递一张便条给他，谢谢。
便条.en: Please help me pass a note to him, thank you.

闭幕式.zh: 奥运会的闭幕式在今晚八点。
闭幕式.en: The Olympic closing ceremony is at 8 p.m. tonight.

闭幕式.zh: 闭幕式结束后大家都去聚餐了。
闭幕式.en: After the closing ceremony, everyone went to have a group dinner.

闭幕式.zh: 我们正在为学校的闭幕式排练节目。
闭幕式.en: We are rehearsing a performance for the school's closing ceremony.

闭幕式.zh: 虽然不舍，但闭幕式标志着新的开始。
闭幕式.en: Although reluctant, the closing ceremony marks a new beginning.

厂长.en: The factory manager is on a business trip today.

厂长.zh: 厂长在会议上提出了新方案。
厂长.en: The factory manager proposed a new plan at the meeting.

厂长.zh: 老厂长退休后，新厂长上任了。
厂长.en: After the old factory manager retired, the new one took office.

厂长.zh: 厂长说这个月要赶订单，大家辛苦一下。
厂长.en: The factory manager said we need to rush orders this month, so everyone work hard.

厂长.zh: 他当厂长二十年，对厂里每台机器都很熟。
厂长.en: He has been the factory manager for twenty years and knows every machine in the plant.

桃树.en: There is a peach tree in the yard.

桃树.zh: 这棵桃树今年结了很多桃子。
桃树.en: This peach tree bore a lot of peaches this year.

桃树.zh: 春天的时候，桃树开满了粉色的花。
桃树.en: In spring, the peach tree is full of pink blossoms.

桃树.zh: 爷爷在屋后种了两棵桃树。
桃树.en: Grandpa planted two peach trees behind the house.

桃树.zh: 桃树需要经常修剪，才能长得更好。
桃树.en: Peach trees need regular pruning to grow better.

阅览室.en: The reading room is very quiet.

阅览室.zh: 他每天下午都去阅览室看书。
阅览室.en: He goes to the reading room every afternoon to read.

阅览室.zh: 学校阅览室开放到晚上十点。
阅览室.en: The school reading room is open until 10 p.m.

阅览室.zh: 阅览室里不能吃东西，只能喝水。
阅览室.en: You can't eat in the reading room, only drink water.

阅览室.zh: 我想借的书在阅览室二楼。
阅览室.en: The book I want to borrow is on the second floor of the reading room.

尺子.zh: 这把尺子是塑料的，很轻。
尺子.en: This ruler is made of plastic and is very light.
Drawing lines with a ruler will be straighter.

尺子.zh: 我找不到我的尺子了，你能帮我找找吗？
尺子.en: I can't find my ruler, can you help me look for it?

尺子.zh: 考试时别忘了带铅笔、橡皮和尺子。
尺子.en: Don't forget to bring pencils, an eraser, and a ruler for the exam.

毛笔.en: This brush pen is very nice to use.
Grandpa practices calligraphy with a brush every day.

毛笔.zh: 我买了三支毛笔，准备学书法。
毛笔.en: I bought three brush pens, ready to learn calligraphy.

毛笔.zh: 毛笔写字比钢笔难多了。
毛笔.en: Writing with a brush is much harder than with a pen.

毛笔.zh: 他用毛笔在红纸上写了一个“福”字。
毛笔.en: He wrote the character '福' on red paper with a brush.

豆制品.en: Soy products are very good for health.

豆制品.zh: 豆腐、豆浆都是常见的豆制品。
豆制品.en: Tofu and soy milk are common soy products.

豆制品.zh: 这家超市的豆制品种类很多。
豆制品.en: This supermarket has a wide variety of soy products.

豆制品.zh: 如果你对牛奶过敏，可以试试豆制品。
豆制品.en: If you are allergic to milk, you can try soy products.

占线.en: I called several times, but it was always busy.

占线.zh: 刚才客服一直占线，我等了十分钟。
占线.en: The customer service line was busy just now, and I waited ten minutes.

占线.zh: 你等一下再打吧，现在可能还在占线。
占线.en: Call again later; it might still be busy now.

占线.zh: 因为占线，我只好发短信给他。
占线.en: Because the line was busy, I had to send him a text message.

跳远.en: He got first place in the long jump.

跳远.zh: 我小时候最喜欢跳远，但现在不太行了。
跳远.en: I loved the long jump as a child, but now I'm not so good at it.
In PE class we practice the long jump.

跳远.zh: 虽然跳远很难，但他还是坚持练。
跳远.en: Although the long jump is hard, he still keeps practicing.

跳远.zh: 因为明天有跳远比赛，所以他早早就睡了。
跳远.en: Because there's a long jump competition tomorrow, he went to bed early.

没法儿.en: There's no way to handle this.

没法儿.zh: 他生病了，所以没法儿来上课。
没法儿.en: He's sick, so he can't come to class.

没法儿.zh: 手机没电了，我没法儿联系你。
没法儿.en: My phone died, I can't contact you.

没法儿.zh: 如果时间不够，我们没法儿完成。
没法儿.en: If there's not enough time, we can't finish.

没法儿.zh: 他说没法儿再等下去了，因为很急。
没法儿.en: He said he couldn't wait any longer because it was urgent.

脸盆.zh: 你把脸盆放在卫生间，我等会儿用。
脸盆.en: Put the basin in the bathroom, I'll use it later.

脸盆.zh: 这个脸盆太大了，不好拿。
脸盆.en: This basin is too big to carry easily.

脸盆.zh: 洗衣服的时候，我常用脸盆泡衣服。
脸盆.en: When doing laundry, I often soak clothes in a basin.

脸盆.zh: 因为脸盆破了，所以他买了一个新的。
脸盆.en: Because the basin was broken, he bought a new one.

中秋节.zh: 因为中秋节，公司给我们发了月饼。
中秋节.en: Because of Mid-Autumn Festival, the company gave us mooncakes.

中秋节.zh: 中秋节晚上，我们一家人赏月。
中秋节.en: On Mid-Autumn Festival night, our family watches the moon.

中秋节.zh: 虽然中秋节很热闹，但我还是想家。
中秋节.en: Although Mid-Autumn Festival is lively, I still miss home.

中秋节.zh: 今年中秋节，我打算和朋友一起吃饭。
中秋节.en: This Mid-Autumn Festival, I plan to have dinner with friends.

电子版.zh: 这个文件有电子版，你可以下载。
电子版.en: This file has a digital version, you can download it.

电子版.zh: 纸质书太贵了，所以我买了电子版。
电子版.en: Paper books are too expensive, so I bought the digital version.

电子版.zh: 电子版的资料更方便保存和查找。
电子版.en: Digital materials are more convenient to save and search.

电子版.zh: 如果你需要电子版，发邮件给我就行。
电子版.en: If you need the digital version, just email me.

连忙.zh: 看到老师来了，他连忙站起来问好。
连忙.en: Seeing the teacher come, he quickly stood up and said hello.

连忙.zh: 听到哭声，妈妈连忙放下手里的活儿。
连忙.en: Hearing crying, Mom hurriedly put down her work.

连忙.zh: 因为下雨了，我连忙把窗户关上。
连忙.en: Because it started raining, I quickly closed the window.

连忙.zh: 他发现自己说错了话，连忙道歉。
连忙.en: He realized he said something wrong and quickly apologized.

差一点儿.zh: 他差一点儿就迟到了，还好赶上了。
差一点儿.en: He was almost late, but luckily made it.

差一点儿.zh: 我差一点儿忘了带钥匙，还好想起来了。
差一点儿.en: I almost forgot to bring the keys, but luckily remembered.

差一点儿.zh: 因为路上堵车，我差一点儿没赶上飞机。
差一点儿.en: Because of traffic, I almost missed the flight.

差一点儿.zh: 她差一点儿就赢了比赛，可惜最后输了一分。
差一点儿.en: She almost won the game, but unfortunately lost by one point.

胡同儿.zh: 北京有很多有名的胡同儿，比如南锣鼓巷。
胡同儿.en: Beijing has many famous hutongs, like Nanluoguxiang.

胡同儿.zh: 他从小在胡同儿里长大，对这儿很熟。
胡同儿.en: He grew up in a hutong, so he knows this place well.

胡同儿.zh: 虽然胡同儿很旧，但很有生活气息。
胡同儿.en: Although the hutong is old, it's full of life.

胡同儿.zh: 我们一边逛胡同儿，一边听导游讲故事。
胡同儿.en: We strolled through the hutongs while listening to the guide tell stories.

便利店.zh: 我晚上饿了，就去便利店买点吃的。
便利店.en: When I'm hungry at night, I go to the convenience store to buy some food.

便利店.zh: 便利店虽然不大，但东西很全。
便利店.en: Although the convenience store is small, it has a wide selection.

便利店.zh: 因为便利店24小时营业，所以晚上也方便。
便利店.en: Because the convenience store is open 24 hours, it's convenient at night too.

便利店.zh: 你帮我从便利店带瓶水回来吧。
便利店.en: Can you bring me a bottle of water from the convenience store?

二维码.en: Scan the QR code to pay.

二维码.zh: 现在很多餐厅用二维码点餐，很方便。
二维码.en: Now many restaurants use QR codes for ordering, it's very convenient.

二维码.zh: 这个二维码扫不出来，可能坏了。
二维码.en: This QR code can't be scanned, maybe it's damaged.

二维码.zh: 因为要加好友，我让他给我扫了二维码。
二维码.en: Because I wanted to add him as a friend, I had him scan my QR code.

二维码.zh: 如果你有电子票，打开二维码就能入场。
二维码.en: If you have an e-ticket, open the QR code to enter.

使劲儿.zh: 他使劲儿工作了一整天。
虽然很累，他还在使劲儿搬东西。
使劲儿.en: Although very tired, he's still putting effort into moving things.

使劲儿.zh: 他使劲儿回忆，却什么都想不起来。
使劲儿.en: He tried hard to remember, but couldn't recall anything.
Stop exerting yourself, relax a bit.

微博.zh: 他刚发了一条微博，点赞很多。
微博.en: He just posted a Weibo, and it got a lot of likes.

微博.zh: 因为工作忙，他好几天没看微博了。
微博.en: Because of work, he hasn't checked Weibo for several days.

微博.zh: 微博上有很多有趣的视频，我经常刷。
微博.en: There are many interesting videos on Weibo, I often browse.

微博.zh: 她不玩微博，只喜欢逛小红书。
微博.en: She doesn't use Weibo, she only likes browsing Xiaohongshu.

系领带.zh: 他每天早上都要系领带上班。
系领带.en: He has to wear a tie to work every morning.

系领带.zh: 因为婚礼很正式，他穿西装系领带。
系领带.en: Because the wedding was formal, he wore a suit and tie.

系领带.zh: 系领带的时候，别忘了拉直一点。
系领带.en: When tying your tie, don't forget to straighten it a bit.

系领带.zh: 他学了很久才学会系领带。
系领带.en: He studied for a long time before learning how to tie a tie.
